AI.method: 设计基于自主DRL代理的决策支持系统，允许实践者构建定制的机器学习流水线
AI.findings: 系统能够在提高儿童忍虐检测性能的同时确保伦理整合性，为弱势群体提供更好结果
AI.theory_contributions: 推进了AutoML和伦理AI领域的研究，提供了实现伦理决策的实践解决方案
AI.practical_contributions: 为儿童保护实践者提供了无需深度技术知识的工具，能够构建高效且符合伦理标准的模型流水线

title: Bayesian Hierarchical Models Uncover how Wealth and Geography Shape the Nutritional Impacts of Food Insecurity Across Philippine Fisheries Management Areas
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Bayesian Hierarchical Models Uncover how Wealth and Geography Shape the Nutritional Impacts of Food Insecurity Across Philippine Fisheries Management Areas

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The data used in this study were obtained from the 2018, 2019, and 2021 Expanded National Nutrition Survey (ENNS), a nationally representative survey conducted by the Philippine Department of Science and Technology’s Food and Nutrition Research Institute (DOST-FNRI). All procedures performed in the ENNS were in compliance with relevant laws and institutional guidelines and were approved by the appropriate institutional ethics committee of the DOST-FNRI. The privacy rights of all the human subjects were observed, and informed consent was obtained from all the participants or their legal guardians by the DOST-FNRI survey team prior to data collection.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Food insecurity remains a critical public health challenge in the Philippines, with significant regional and socioeconomic disparities. This study aims to dissect the complex interplay between household wealth, geography, and food insecurity and to quantify their distinct impacts on dietary energy intake. Using data from the 2018, 2019, and 2021 Expanded National Nutrition Surveys (ENNS), we employed a series of Bayesian hierarchical models. The primary model assessed the effect of wealth quintile on the Household Food Insecurity Access Scale (HFIAS) score, allowing for variation across 12 Fisheries Management Areas (FMAs). Secondary mechanistic models were specified to test for an interaction effect between wealth and food insecurity on dietary energy intake and to disaggregate the HFIAS score into the effects of specific coping strategies. A strong negative gradient was observed between wealth and food insecurity, with households in the richest quintile having a predicted HFIAS score 5.68 points lower (95% CI: [-5.94, -5.45]) than those in the poorest quintile. This relationship, however, varied significantly across FMAs, highlighting geographic inequality. Further analysis revealed that the negative impact of food insecurity on calorie intake is moderated by wealth; the penalty for a one-point increase in the HFIAS is a 40-calorie decrease for the poorest households, an effect that is buffered in wealthier quintiles. Disaggregation of the HFIAS score revealed that restricting adult consumption was the most detrimental coping strategy associated with a 708-calorie decrease in daily intake (95% CI: [-797, -618]). Food insecurity in the Philippines is a geographically contingent phenomenon driven by poverty but poses a distinct threat to nutrition independent of wealth. These findings underscore that the experience of food insecurity, particularly the adoption of severe coping strategies, is a powerful predictor of dietary deficits. Policies must therefore be spatially targeted and address not only poverty but also the specific high-risk behaviors that signal critical nutritional vulnerability.

AI.tldr: 菲律宾粮食不安全存在显著地域和社会经济差异，研究发现财富与粮食不安全呈负相关，但地域差异明显。粮食不安全对热量摄入的负面影响在贫困家庭中更严重，限制成人消费是最有害的应对策略。
AI.research_question: 财富、地理和粮食不安全如何相互作用，以及它们对膳食能量摄入的各自影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 菲律宾粮食不安全仍然是关键的公共卫生挑战，存在显著的地域和社会经济差异，需要深入理解这些因素如何影响营养状况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于粮食不安全与贫困关系的理论框架，结合地理差异分析，探讨财富、地域和应对策略对营养摄入的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用2018、2019和2021年扩展国家营养调查数据，采用贝叶斯层次模型分析财富五分位数对HFIAS评分的影响，并测试财富与粮食不安全对膳食能量摄入的交互作用。
AI.findings: 最富裕五分位数的家庭HFIAS评分比最贫困家庭低5.68分；粮食不安全对热量摄入的负面影响在贫困家庭更严重（每增加1分HFIAS减少40卡路里）；限制成人消费是最有害的应对策略（每日减少708卡路里）。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了粮食不安全的地理异质性，证明了财富对粮食不安全影响的缓冲作用，识别了不同应对策略对营养摄入的差异化影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为制定针对性政策提供依据：需要地域针对性干预，不仅要解决贫困问题，还要关注表明严重营养脆弱性的高风险应对行为。

title: The Legal Fiction Of 'Decentralization': How Daos Are Accidentally Creating Unregulated Financial Entities
affiliations: UNIVERSITI TEKNOLOGI MALAYSIA and Gomal University

detail.title: The Legal Fiction Of 'Decentralization': How Daos Are Accidentally Creating Unregulated Financial Entities
detail.abstract: Decentralized autonomous organizations (DAOs) are championed as democratized, self-governing systems, yet this paper reveals their claims of decentralization often serve as a legal fiction. Through empirical analysis of DAO operations (2020-2025) and comparative legal assessment, we demonstrate how DAOs functionally operate as unregulated financial entities, concentrating power while exploiting regulatory gaps. The study examines critical tensions between DAOs' algorithmic governance and traditional legal frameworks, particularly in securities regulation, cross-border enforcement, and liability assignment. We propose a DAO Liability Matrix and compliance-by-design mechanisms to bridge smart-contract autonomy with legal accountability. Our findings underscore that sustainable decentralized governance requires integrating transparency and enforceable standards into algorithmic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实证分析揭示DAO的去中心化主张往往只是法律虚构，实际运作类似不受监管的金融实体，并提出责任矩阵和合规设计机制来弥合智能合约自治与法律问责之间的鸿沟。
AI.research_question: DAO的去中心化主张是否真实？其运作模式与传统法律框架存在哪些关键冲突？如何实现智能合约自治与法律问责的有效整合？
AI.motivation: DAO被标榜为民主化、自治的系统，但其去中心化主张可能只是法律虚构，实际运作中可能集中权力并利用监管漏洞，需要深入分析其与现有法律框架的冲突并提出解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于去中心化自治组织理论、算法治理理论、证券监管理论和法律责任理论，构建DAO运作与法律框架冲突的分析框架。
AI.method: 采用实证分析方法研究2020-2025年DAO运营数据，结合比较法律评估方法，分析DAO在不同司法管辖区的法律地位和监管挑战。
AI.findings: DAO的去中心化主张往往是法律虚构，实际运作类似不受监管的金融实体；存在算法治理与传统法律框架的关键冲突；需要建立责任矩阵和合规设计机制来确保法律问责。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了DAO责任矩阵理论框架，发展了算法治理与法律问责整合的理论模型，为去中心化系统的法律合规性研究提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供DAO监管框架建议，为DAO开发者提供合规设计机制，为投资者和参与者提供风险识别和法律责任评估工具。

title: Power Play: Unraveling the Temporal Impact of CEO Duality on Firm Performance
affiliations: National Taiwan University

detail.title: Power Play: Unraveling the Temporal Impact of CEO Duality on Firm Performance
detail.abstract: The debate over CEO duality—where the CEO also serves as the board chair—has captivated researchers, practitioners, and policymakers for decades. Despite extensive research, the impact of CEO duality on firm performance remains contentious and unresolved, plagued by endogeneity issues. This study revisits the CEO duality effect using cutting-edge panel matching and weighting methods to address these causal inference challenges. I scrutinize key performance indicators such as return on assets, gross profit rate, and profit margin. The results reveal a fascinating temporal dynamic: CEO duality significantly boosts firm performance in the short term, with positive effect lasting about 3 to 5 years. However, this initial boost gives way to a decline in performance, turning negative and statistically significant around 6 years after adopting CEO duality. This study suggests that the initial concentration of power in CEO duality eventually sows the seeds for a decline in performance. By mapping out these dynamic patterns, this study offers fresh insights into the CEO duality debate and helps reconcile the conflicting evidence found in prior research.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用前沿的面板匹配和加权方法重新探讨CEO二元性（CEO兼任董事会主席）对企业绩效的影响，发现存在显著的时间动态：短期（3-5年）内提升绩效，但长期（约6年后）转为负面影响
AI.research_question: CEO二元性对企业绩效的因果影响是什么？是否存在时间动态效应？
AI.motivation: 尽管已有数十年研究，但CEO二元性对企业绩效的影响仍存在争议且未解决，主要受内生性问题困扰
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于公司治理理论和权力集中理论，探讨CEO权力集中对组织绩效的双重影响
AI.method: 采用前沿的面板匹配和加权方法解决因果推断挑战，分析资产回报率、毛利率和利润率等关键绩效指标
AI.findings: CEO二元性在短期内（3-5年）显著提升企业绩效，但约6年后转为负面影响，呈现先升后降的动态模式
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了CEO二元性影响的动态时间模式，为解决先前研究中的矛盾证据提供了新视角，深化了对权力集中长期后果的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业董事会结构决策提供实证依据，建议关注CEO二元性的时间效应，避免长期权力过度集中带来的负面影响

title: From Battlefield to Burial: Complex Casualty Identification using Rapid DNA Analysis in 21st Century Warfare
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Tel Aviv University - Sackler Faculty of Medicine and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: From Battlefield to Burial: Complex Casualty Identification using Rapid DNA Analysis in 21st Century Warfare

keywords.keywords: Rapid DNA Technology Complex Casualty Identification Fragmentation Events ANDE System Disaster Management Identification Time

detail.abstract: During the October 7th 2023 conflict, the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) Genomic Center for Casualties Identification quickly mobilized to enhance its capabilities. By implementing rapid DNA technology and improving sample prioritization, the lab significantly reduced the time required for casualties’ identification. We present data collected during the IDF ground operation and our findings to enable the successful management of complex forensic events. We have learned that each casualty event is defined by a predetermined set of sample types. Additionally, complex events are mainly fragmentation incidents, requiring management of a high volume of samples in short time. STR based DNA fingerprinting has been used for casualty identification in traditional kits and by newly developed RAPID DNA technologies. Surprisingly, while RAPID DNA technology allows casualty identification in under 3 hours, the primary determinant of identification speed is accurate samples prioritization. We finally propose a management system composed of sample periodization and RAPID DNA technology to deal with complex casualty events. This combination achieved total casualty identification time reduction to 2–3 hours also in complex events.

title: Moral Philosophy and Archetypes in the Symbolic Cohesion of the Legend of the Candileja
affiliations: EDUKIVOTOS

detail.title: Moral Philosophy and Archetypes in the Symbolic Cohesion of the Legend of the Candileja
detail.abstract: The legend of La Candileja, deeply rooted in Colombian oral tradition, acts as a moralizing tale that employs fear as a pedagogical tool. From the perspectives of Machiavelli and Hobbes, the figure of the “anti-villain” emerges as an ambivalent entity: feared yet protective, punitive yet oriented toward the common good. Through the pedagogy of terror, La Candileja reinforces social norms, regulates behavior, and encourages the preservation of both community and natural environment. Thus, the myth not only transmits cultural values but also operates as a mechanism of social and ecological control.

AI.tldr: 本文分析哥伦比亚民间传说La Candileja如何通过恐惧教育强化社会规范，从马基雅维利和霍布斯视角探讨这种'反反派'角色的社会控制功能
AI.research_question: La Candileja传说如何通过恐惧教育机制实现社会规范和生态控制？
AI.motivation: 探讨民间传说作为道德教化工具的社会功能，特别是恐惧在维持社会秩序和环境保护中的作用
AI.theoretical_framework: 马基雅维利和霍布斯的政治哲学理论，特别是关于恐惧作为社会控制工具的观点
AI.method: 文本分析和理论框架应用，对民间传说进行哲学和政治学解读
AI.findings: La Candileja作为'反反派'角色，通过恐惧教育强化社会规范，调节行为，促进社区和自然环境的保护
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了民间传说研究的社会控制理论视角，深化了对恐惧作为教育工具的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为文化传承和社会治理提供了基于传统叙事的实践启示

title: Why Middle Managers Deviate from Strategy and How to Make the Most of It
affiliations: University of East London and University of Galway

detail.title: Why Middle Managers Deviate from Strategy and How to Make the Most of It
detail.abstract: Strategy implementation often diverges from strategic plans. At the center of this divergence are middle managers—those tasked with translating high-level strategy into operational reality. This study investigates why middle managers deviate from strategic intent and identifies the organizational conditions under which such deviations are constructive—enhancing outcomes—or destructive—delaying or undermining execution. Drawing on 92 documented strategy deviations reported by 40 middle managers across 30 multinational firms, we find that most deviations (82 percent) were destructive, typically producing delay, dilution, or derailment without benefit to the firm. A smaller but significant share (18 percent) proved constructive, yielding context-appropriate adaptations and value-creating outcomes. We show that deviation is not simply the result of poor discipline but stems from design misfits in communication, incentives, accountability, and resourcing. Our analysis highlights seven recurring reasons for deviation, ranging from lack of understanding and incentive to situational autonomy and inadequate slack. Each was more strongly associated with destructive outcomes, although situational shocks occasionally enabled constructive improvisation. These findings emphasize that middle manager behavior should be read as system feedback rather than disobedience. For practitioners, the challenge is to reduce destructive deviations while enabling constructive ones. We recommend diagnosing deviation patterns as signals of design failure, aligning incentives and accountability with strategy, ensuring adequate execution capacity, and investing in communication systems that support sensemaking. By treating middle managers as essential agents of adaptive execution rather than obstacles, organizations can channel deviation into a source of strategic resilience and innovation.

AI.tldr: 中层管理者在战略执行中经常偏离战略意图，82%的偏离是破坏性的，18%是建设性的。偏离源于沟通、激励、问责和资源配置的设计不匹配，而非简单的纪律问题。
AI.research_question: 中层管理者为何偏离战略意图？在什么组织条件下这种偏离是建设性的（增强结果）或破坏性的（延迟或破坏执行）？
AI.motivation: 战略实施经常偏离战略计划，中层管理者作为将高层战略转化为运营现实的关键角色，其偏离行为对组织执行效果产生重要影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于战略执行理论和中层管理者角色理论，关注组织设计要素（沟通、激励、问责、资源配置）对执行偏差的影响。
AI.method: 对30家跨国公司的40名中层管理者报告的92个战略偏离案例进行定性分析。
AI.findings: 大多数偏离（82%）是破坏性的，导致延迟、稀释或破坏执行；少数（18%）是建设性的，产生情境适应的价值创造结果。识别出7个偏离原因：缺乏理解、激励不足、情境自主权、资源不足等。
AI.theory_contributions: 将中层管理者行为重新定义为系统反馈而非不服从，强调组织设计要素对执行偏差的影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出诊断偏离模式作为设计失败的信号，调整激励问责机制，确保执行能力，投资支持意义建构的沟通系统，将中层管理者视为适应性执行的关键代理人。

title: Research on the ramping ancillary service mechanism considering the fair-sharing of ramping costs based on the contribution degree to ramping demand
affiliations: China Three Gorges University, China Three Gorges University, State Grid Anhui Electric Power Co Ltd, affiliation not provided to SSRN and China Three Gorges University

detail.title: Research on the ramping ancillary service mechanism considering the fair-sharing of ramping costs based on the contribution degree to ramping demand
detail.abstract: China’s pilot Ramping Ancillary Service (RAS) market offers a viable approach to cope with the growing demand for flexible ramping capacity under the high penetration of variable renewable generation (VRG). However, the current RAS mechanism exhibits deficiencies in both ramping demand calculation and cost allocation, failing to adequately address issues such as real-time dynamic uncertainty in ramping demand and the fairness and traceability of cost distribution. Therefore, a ramping demand prediction method considering the probability distribution of historical errors and a fair cost sharing mechanism for ramping costs based on the contribution degree of market entities to ramping demand are proposed in this paper. Firstly, in the calculation of ramping demand, based on daily categories, meteorological data, and VRG-load prediction values, using constrained K-means clustering to categorize similar daily samples, obtaining the errors probability distribution, and constructing a physics-informed LSTM quantile regression (PIQ-LSTM) model to obtain the uncertain ramping demand. In terms of ramping cost allocation, based on the contribution degree of net load variations, load forecast deviations, and VRG forecast deviations to the ramping demand, the ramping costs are distributed proportionally to the corresponding consumers. Furthermore, a cost-sharing mechanism is designed for VRG forecast deviations, accounting for the discrepancy between the market declaration errors interval and the actual forecast errors. Case studies demonstrate that the proposed probabilistic forecasting method more accurately captures the system’s uncertain ramping demand compared to the baseline methods. Moreover, the designed cost allocation mechanism proves to be fairer and more traceable, providing a valuable reference for market-based ramping cost distribution and supporting the development of RAS market.

AI.tldr: 本文针对中国爬坡辅助服务市场在爬坡需求计算和成本分摊方面的不足，提出了考虑历史误差概率分布的爬坡需求预测方法和基于市场主体贡献度的公平成本分摊机制，通过案例验证了方法的有效性和公平性。
AI.research_question: 如何改进中国爬坡辅助服务市场的爬坡需求计算方法和成本分摊机制，以更好地应对可再生能源高渗透率下的灵活爬坡容量需求？
AI.motivation: 当前爬坡辅助服务机制在爬坡需求计算和成本分配方面存在缺陷，无法充分应对爬坡需求的实时动态不确定性以及成本分配的公平性和可追溯性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于概率分布理论、聚类分析和深度学习理论，结合物理信息约束的LSTM分位数回归模型，构建爬坡需求预测框架；基于贡献度理论设计成本分摊机制。
AI.method: 1）使用约束K-means聚类对相似日样本分类，获取误差概率分布；2）构建物理信息LSTM分位数回归模型预测不确定爬坡需求；3）基于净负荷变化、负荷预测偏差和可再生能源预测偏差的贡献度比例分摊成本；4）设计考虑市场申报误差区间与实际预测误差差异的成本分摊机制。
AI.findings: 案例研究表明，所提出的概率预测方法比基准方法更准确地捕捉系统的不确定爬坡需求，设计的成本分配机制更公平和可追溯。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了物理信息LSTM分位数回归模型用于爬坡需求预测，发展了基于贡献度的成本分摊理论框架，为爬坡辅助服务市场提供了新的理论方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为市场化爬坡成本分配提供了有价值的参考，支持爬坡辅助服务市场的发展，提高了爬坡需求预测的准确性和成本分摊的公平性。

title: Multi-Objective Evolutionary Algorithm Based on Reinforcement Learning for Flexible Job Shop Scheduling with Limited Transportation Resources
affiliations: Zhengzhou University of Aeronautics, Zhengzhou University of Aeronautics, Zhengzhou University of Aeronautics, Henan University of Technology and Zhongyuan University of Technology

detail.title: Multi-Objective Evolutionary Algorithm Based on Reinforcement Learning for Flexible Job Shop Scheduling with Limited Transportation Resources
detail.abstract: Integrating intelligent transport equipment with multi-variety small-batch manufacturing has significantly increased production-scheduling complexity. The efficient coordination between intelligent transport equipment and machines is a growing challenge in practical production. This study addresses the flexible job shop scheduling problem with limited transportation resources (FJSP‑LT), aiming to minimize makespan, energy consumption, and total earliness/tardiness penalties. First, a mathematical model is formulated using mixed‑integer linear programming. Subsequently, a reinforcement learning-based evolutionary algorithm is proposed to solve this model. The proposed algorithm implements four initialization strategies specifically devised to yield a high-quality initial population. Concurrently, it incorporates a self-adaptive strategy, relying on reinforcement learning, to enable dynamic parameter tuning throughout the optimization process. The state representation and reward function are designed according to the multi‑objective characteristics of the problem, facilitating comprehensive capture of state information and effectively guiding the algorithm to identify critical actions. Moreover, to prevent the algorithm from being trapped in the local optima, six neighborhood structures based on critical paths are devised, and a tabu search algorithm is incorporated to improve search efficiency. Finally, numerical simulations of 33 benchmark instance variants and a real‑world industrial case are performed. The results confirm the effectiveness of the proposed enhancement strategies. Through comparative analysis with five existing algorithms, the superiority of the proposed approach in solving the FJSP‑LT is demonstrated.

AI.tldr: 本文研究解决有限运输资源的灵活作业车间排程问题(FJSP-LT)，通过结合强化学习的进化算法最小化总完工时间、能耗和早期/延期罚款，数值实验验证了算法的优劢性。
AI.research_question: 如何有效解决有限运输资源的灵活作业车间排程问题，同时最小化总完工时间、能耗和早期/延期罚款？
AI.motivation: 智能运输设备与多种小批量制造的集成大大增加了生产排程的复杂性，实际生产中智能运输设备与机器之间的高效协调成为日益严峻的挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合整数线性规划数学模型、强化学习理论、进化算法理论和求底搜索理论。
AI.method: 提出一种基于强化学习的进化算法，包括四种初始化策略、自适应参数调整策略、关键路径基础的六种邻域结构以及求底搜索算法。
AI.findings: 通过33个标准案例变体和一个实际工业案例的数值模拟，验证了提出算法的有效性，与现有五种算法进行比较分析，证明了该方法在解决FJSP-LT问题方面的优劢性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种新的基于强化学习的进化算法框架，为复杂多目标排程问题提供了有效的解决方案，扩展了强化学习在生产排程领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实际生产中智能运输设备与机器的协调排程提供了可行的技术方案，能够同时优化多个性能指标，提高生产效率和降低能耗。

title: A Scalable Framework for the Management of STPA Requirements: a Case Study on eVTOL Operations
affiliations: University of Warwick, University of Warwick, University of Warwick, University of Warwick, University of Warwick and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: A Scalable Framework for the Management of STPA Requirements: a Case Study on eVTOL Operations
detail.abstract: System-Theoretic Process Analysis (STPA) is a recommended method for analysing complex systems, capable of identifying thousands of safety requirements often missed by traditional techniques such as Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) and Fault Tree Analysis (FTA). However, the absence of a structured framework for managing and prioritising these requirements presents challenges, particularly in fast-paced development environments. This paper introduces a scalable framework for prioritising STPA-derived requirements. The framework integrates outputs from each STPA step and incorporates expert evaluations based on four key factors: implementation time, cost, requirement type, and regulatory coverage. To reduce subjectivity, Monte-Carlo Simulation (MCS) is employed to calculate and stabilise requirement rankings. An automation toolchain supports the framework, enabling dynamic mapping of prioritised requirements in a scaling matrix. This visualisation aids decision-making and ensures traceability across development phases. The framework is applicable from early conceptualisation to more advanced stages, enhancing its utility in iterative system development. The framework was validated through a real-world case study focused on Electric Vertical Take-off and Landing (eVTOL) operations, conducted in collaboration with the UK Civil Aviation Authority. The findings contributed directly to CAP3141, a Civil Aviation Publication that identifies systemic operational risks and safety mitigations for regulators, operators, and vertiports. The prioritisation process supported decision-making by helping stakeholders identify and manage high-impact requirements efficiently. This work contributes a practical solution for managing STPA outputs, bridging gaps in requirement prioritisation and supporting safety-critical development in emerging technologies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个可扩展的框架，用于优先处理STPA导出的安全需求，通过专家评估和蒙特卡洛模拟减少主观性，并在eVTOL案例中得到验证。
AI.research_question: 如何为STPA方法产生的数千个安全需求建立一个结构化、可扩展的优先级排序框架？
AI.motivation: STPA方法虽然能识别传统技术遗漏的安全需求，但缺乏管理和优先排序这些需求的结构化框架，这在快速开发环境中尤为挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于系统理论过程分析(STPA)理论，结合专家评估和蒙特卡洛模拟的概率方法。
AI.method: 开发了一个集成STPA各步骤输出的框架，包含四个关键因素（实施时间、成本、需求类型、监管覆盖）的专家评估，并使用蒙特卡洛模拟稳定排名。
AI.findings: 框架在eVTOL操作案例中验证成功，直接贡献于英国民航局的CAP3141出版物，支持利益相关者高效识别和管理高影响需求。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了STPA需求优先级排序的理论空白，提供了结合定量和定性方法的系统化框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了自动化工具链和可视化矩阵，支持从概念阶段到高级开发阶段的决策制定和可追溯性，适用于新兴技术的安全关键开发。

title: Echoes of Green Financial Policies in Pandemic Waves: Adaptive Interplay with China's Industrial Enterprise Performance
affiliations: Southwest Minzu University, Southwest Minzu University, Xihua University and Xihua University

detail.title: Echoes of Green Financial Policies in Pandemic Waves: Adaptive Interplay with China's Industrial Enterprise Performance
detail.abstract: This study explores the impact of green finance policies (GFPs) on industrial enterprises' performance (IEP) before and after the COVID-19 pandemic, examining how the pandemic reshaped policy effectiveness, with technological innovation (TI) as a key mediator to clarify the comprehensive utility of GFPs. Using panel data of Chinese industrial enterprises (2016–2019 for the pre-pandemic period and 2020–2023 for the post-pandemic period), partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM) is applied to analyze temporal differences and annual variations in the GFP-IEP relationship. Key findings are as follows: (1) The direct positive effect of GFPs on IEP weakened in the post-pandemic period, shifting from a significant positive impact pre-pandemic to an insignificant negative effect, indicating pandemic-induced disruptions. (2) The indirect effect of GFPs on IEP via TI remained robust across both periods, confirming TI as a crisis-adaptive stabilizer. (3) Post-pandemic temporal heterogeneity was observed: the GFP-IEP relationship shifted from positive in 2020 to significantly negative in 2021 and 2022, before becoming insignificant in 2023. Additionally, population mobility (MOB) moderated GFP efficacy under pandemic-related restrictions. This study contextualizes GFP effects amid exogenous crises, highlights TI's resilience, and quantifies temporal dynamics. By identifying TI as a policy effect "stabilizer", it offers concrete paths to optimize post-pandemic green finance policies, advising policymakers to balance economic recovery and sustainability via strengthened innovation incentives and flexible measures to enhance crisis resilience and mitigate socio-economic disruptions.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了新冠疫情前后绿色金融政策对工业企业绩效的影响，发现疫情削弱了政策的直接正面效应，但技术创新作为中介机制保持稳定作用，为后疫情时代优化绿色金融政策提供了具体路径。
AI.research_question: 绿色金融政策在新冠疫情前后对工业企业绩效的影响有何变化？技术创新在其中扮演什么中介角色？
AI.motivation: 探讨新冠疫情这一外生冲击如何重塑绿色金融政策的有效性，以及技术创新在危机期间的政策稳定器作用
AI.theoretical_framework: 绿色金融政策理论、技术创新中介理论、危机管理理论
AI.method: 使用中国工业企业面板数据（2016-2019为疫情前，2020-2023为疫情后），采用偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）分析时间差异和年度变化
AI.findings: 1）GFP对IEP的直接正面效应在疫情后减弱；2）通过TI的间接效应在两个时期都保持稳健；3）观察到疫情后时间异质性：2020年正相关，2021-2022年显著负相关，2023年不显著；人口流动性在疫情限制下调节GFP效果
AI.theory_contributions: 在外生危机背景下情境化GFP效应，强调TI的韧性作用，量化时间动态，识别TI作为政策效果"稳定器"的理论机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为优化后疫情时代绿色金融政策提供具体路径，建议政策制定者通过加强创新激励和灵活措施来平衡经济复苏与可持续性，增强危机韧性并减轻社会经济 disruption

title: Understanding Student Perceptions and Factors Contributing to Self-Harm Behaviors: Basis for Guidance and Counselling Strategies
affiliations: Department of Education: Schools Division Office of Cavite Province, Department of Education: Schools Division Office of Cavite Province and Department of Education: Schools Division Office of Cavite Province

detail.title: Understanding Student Perceptions and Factors Contributing to Self-Harm Behaviors: Basis for Guidance and Counselling Strategies
detail.abstract: Purpose: This study explored student perceptions and factors contributing to self-harm at Carmona National High School. The findings aimed to guide counseling strategies to support affected students, taking into account socio-economic and cultural contexts. Methodology: This mixed-methods study investigated self-harm behaviors among Carmona National High School students using surveys and qualitative data. Stratified convenience samplingincluded361students (Grades 7–10). Instruments such as the Self-Harming Questionnaire, Context Questionnaire, Achenbach’s Youth Self-Report, and the Multidimensional Test of Self-Esteem were employed. Descriptive statistics were used to analyze quantitative data, while thematic analysis examined emotional, familial, and social influences. Findings: The study revealed that students viewed self-harm as both a coping mechanism and a response to overwhelming emotions. Key factors included academic pressure, lack of family support, peer influence, and bullying, which heightened distress. Socio-economic and cultural contexts, such as financial struggles and mental health stigma, also shaped self-harm behaviors. Effective interventions—awareness campaigns, trust-building, and expanded mental health resources—were identified as essential to support students and reduce self-harm. Conclusions and Recommendations: The study concluded that self-harm was a response to academic stress, familial issues, and peer pressure, exacerbated by stigma that hindered help-seeking. It recommended that schools hold open discussions, integrate mental health programs, train staff, and create safe spaces to build resilience among students.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了Carmona国立高中学生自伤行为的认知和影响因素，发现学业压力、家庭支持缺乏、同伴影响和欺凌是主要因素，建议通过心理健康项目、员工培训和创建安全空间来支持学生。
AI.research_question: Carmona国立高中学生自伤行为的认知和影响因素是什么？如何制定有效的咨询策略来支持受影响的学生？
AI.motivation: 了解学生自伤行为的认知和影响因素，为制定针对性的咨询和支持策略提供依据，特别是在考虑社会经济和文化背景的情况下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于心理健康、自我伤害行为、社会支持理论和青少年发展理论，探讨自伤行为的多维度影响因素。
AI.method: 混合方法研究，使用分层便利抽样选取361名7-10年级学生，采用自伤问卷、背景问卷、Achenbach青少年自评量表和多维自尊测试等工具，使用描述性统计和主题分析。
AI.findings: 学生将自伤视为应对机制和情绪反应；主要因素包括学业压力、家庭支持缺乏、同伴影响和欺凌；社会经济和文化背景（如财务困难和心理健康污名）也影响自伤行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了青少年自伤行为的理论理解，强调了社会经济和文化背景在自伤行为中的重要作用，为相关理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了具体的干预措施，如意识宣传活动、建立信任、扩展心理健康资源，建议学校开展开放讨论、整合心理健康项目、培训员工和创建安全空间，以增强学生的韧性。

title: Strait Talk: Formalizing Communications between Taiwan and the Mainland
affiliations: Harvard University - Harvard Law School

detail.title: Strait Talk: Formalizing Communications between Taiwan and the Mainland
detail.abstract: From 1949 until now, the vast majority of members of the National People's Congress (NPC) or Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC) of the PRC who claim to be Taiwanese have been members of the Taiwan Democratic Self-Government Party (TDSL), one of the eight minor parties in China's "United Front" system. According to the TDSL website, the party is committed to “encouraging its members and Taiwanese compatriots to contribute to the socialist revolution and construction, reform and opening up, the construction of socialism with Chinese characteristics, and the great cause of national reunification." However, the TDSL's socialist origins have likely prevented the party from gaining any amount of influence over the Taiwanese residents living in the Mainland, who generally have no interest in socialism even if they may support national reunification. Thus, in order to upgrade the TDSL and ensure that it is able to achieve its goal of representing Taiwanese voices in the central government, this article makes two proposals to strengthen the consultation mechanism at the NPC and the CPPCC while ensuring that the Taiwanese "delegation" is more representative of the contemporary population of Taiwan, rather than descendants of Taiwanese socialists.

AI.tldr: 本文分析台湾民主自治同盟在中国政治体系中的角色困境，提出改革建议以增强其在人大代表和政协中的代表性
AI.research_question: 如何提升台湾民主自治同盟在大陆台湾同胞中的代表性和影响力？
AI.motivation: 台湾民主自治同盟作为中国八个民主党派之一，其社会主义背景限制了其对大陆台湾居民的影响力，需要改革以更好地代表台湾声音
AI.theoretical_framework: 统一战线理论、社会主义协商民主理论、代表制理论
AI.method: 文献分析和政策建议方法，基于历史背景和现状分析
AI.findings: 台湾民主自治同盟的社会主义起源阻碍了其在台湾同胞中的影响力，需要进行机制改革
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了统一战线理论和协商民主理论在台湾同胞代表机制中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了两项具体建议：加强人大政协协商机制、确保台湾代表团更代表当代台湾人口结构

title: Dynamic Economic Dispatch with Novel Ensemble Forecasting under Solar PV-Load Uncertainties for Renewable-integrated Power Systems
affiliations: Chittagong University of Engineering and Technology, Chittagong University of Engineering and Technology and Chittagong University of Engineering and Technology

detail.title: Dynamic Economic Dispatch with Novel Ensemble Forecasting under Solar PV-Load Uncertainties for Renewable-integrated Power Systems
detail.abstract: Amid rising concern about climate change, widespread efforts are being undertaken to curb greenhouse gas emissions. Consequently, distributed energy systems are increasingly incorporating solar power as a primary source. However, this integration introduces intricacies in power grid management due to the variability of renewable sources. This variability, driven by unpredictable meteorological conditions, can hinder grid stability if not accurately forecasted. Furthermore, accurate load forecasting is necessary to balance production with consumer needs. This research deals with the vital need for improved forecasting models that can manage the fluctuations in solar power output and electricity demand. Though existing literature often highlights only load forecasting, this research has addressed the dual aspects of solar power variability and dynamic load demands with jointly utilized approach that can be readily implemented in diverse grid settings. Neural network alongside tree-based models were explored to address the complex nonlinear interactions in power systems management. Result indicate that tree-based ensemble models achieve higher accuracy in both cases. To further optimize power distribution, a novel dynamic economic load dispatch (ELD) model was also developed using Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) and Genetic Algorithms (GA). In dynamic ELD, PSO was found to outperform GA.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了基于树模型的集成学习方法和动态经济负荷分配模型，用于准确预测太阳能发电波动和电力需求，优化电网管理。
AI.research_question: 如何开发准确预测太阳能发电波动和电力需求的模型，以优化电网管理和电力分配？
AI.motivation: 气候变化背景下太阳能发电集成增加，但可再生能源的波动性给电网管理带来复杂性，需要改进预测模型来维持电网稳定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 神经网络和树基模型的非线性交互理论，粒子群优化和遗传算法的优化理论。
AI.method: 采用神经网络和树基集成模型进行太阳能发电和负荷预测，使用粒子群优化和遗传算法开发动态经济负荷分配模型。
AI.findings: 树基集成模型在预测准确性方面表现更优，粒子群优化在动态经济负荷分配中优于遗传算法。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了联合处理太阳能波动和负荷需求的预测框架，发展了基于优化算法的动态经济负荷分配理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可实际应用于各种电网环境的预测和优化解决方案，提高了电网管理效率和稳定性。

title: INTEGRATING ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE WITH WORK STANDARDIZATION TO IMPROVE OCCUPATIONAL SAFETY: SURVEY RESULTS FROM POLISH INDUSTRY AND A TWI-AI METHODOLOGY
affiliations: Wrocław University of Science and Technology, Wrocław University of Science and Technology and Wrocław University of Science and Technology

detail.title: INTEGRATING ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE WITH WORK STANDARDIZATION TO IMPROVE OCCUPATIONAL SAFETY: SURVEY RESULTS FROM POLISH INDUSTRY AND A TWI-AI METHODOLOGY
detail.abstract: This article proposes a methodology for integrating artificial intelligence (AI) tools into the process of work method improvement aimed at enhancing occupational safety. The conceptual foundation is the Training Within Industry – Job Methods (TWI-JM) program, which emphasizes the systematic elimination of waste (Muda), inconsistencies (Mura), and overburden (Muri) as part of work standardization practices. The methodology follows a two-step procedure. The first stage involves a structured assessment of current working conditions, focusing on identifying hazards and inefficiencies through direct observation and worker engagement. The second stage applies large language models to generate improvement suggestions based on prompts aligned with safety and operational goals. To assess practical relevance, an online survey was conducted among 235 occupational safety and health (OSH) professionals from the Polish manufacturing and construction sectors. Findings show high awareness of the importance of work standardization in improving safety; however, AI adoption remains limited. A supplementary correlation analysis indicated weak but positive links between AI-related knowledge, trust, organizational readiness, and willingness to adopt AI in OSH. The methodology was validated using real-world data from reinforcement preparation tasks in construction. Results show that clearly defined goals—such as reducing accidents, minimizing operational time, or improving ergonomics—significantly enhance the relevance of AI-generated outputs. Compared to traditional expert-based methods, the TWI–AI approach enables the identification of a broader range of improvements and accelerates implementation. The study suggests that integrating standardized work observation methods with AI tools can boost the effectiveness of safety-focused continuous improvement initiatives.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种将人工智能工具整合到工作方法改进过程中的方法论，以提高职业安全。基于TWI-JM程序，该方法通过两步流程评估工作条件并利用大语言模型生成改进建议。研究发现明确的目标定义能显著提高AI输出的相关性，与传统专家方法相比，TWI-AI方法能识别更广泛的改进点并加快实施速度。
AI.research_question: 如何有效整合人工智能工具到职业安全工作方法改进过程中，以提高安全性和效率？
AI.motivation: 虽然工作标准化对安全改善重要性已得到认同，但人工智能在职业安全健康领域的采用仍然有限，需要开发有效的整合方法来发挥AI的潜力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 培训在业内 - 工作方法（TWI-JM）程序，重点关注系统消除浪费（Muda）、不一致性（Mura）和过度负荷（Muri），作为工作标准化实践的一部分。
AI.method: 两步流程方法：第一阶段通过直接观察和员工参与进行结构化的当前工作条件评估；第二阶段应用大语言模型根据安全和运营目标对齐的提示生成改进建议。进行了在235名波兰制造业和建筑业OSH专业人员中的在线调查，并使用建筑业加强准备任务的实际数据进行方法验证。
AI.findings: 研究发现工作标准化对安全改善的重要性认知度高，但AI采用度低；相关性分析显示AI相关知识、信任、组织准备度与采用意愿存在弱正相关性；明确的目标定义（如减少事故、缩短操作时间、改善工效学）显著提高AI生成输出的相关性；与传统方法相比，TWI-AI方法能识别更多改进点并加快实施。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将标准化工作观察方法与AI工具相结合的新方法论，为AI在职业安全领域的应用提供了理论支撑，扩展了TWI-JM理论在数字化时代的应用范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了一种具体可操作的TWI-AI方法论，能够帮助企业更有效地利用AI进行安全改进；实证研究结果为OSH专业人员提供了具体的应用指南，显示明确目标定义对提高AI效果的重要性，为企业推进AI采用提供了实践参考。

title: Dateline Paducah: Navigating Disruption in Community Journalism
affiliations: University of Virginia - Darden School of Business, , University of Virginia - Darden School of Business and

detail.title: Dateline Paducah: Navigating Disruption in Community Journalism

publicationDetails.journalName: Darden Case Collection

detail.abstract:
This case explores the challenges and opportunities facing Bill Evans, the president of the West Kentucky Media Division of Paxton Media Group. As the leader of several local new outlets in Kentucky and Illinois, he must develop strategies to preserve the businesses within his portfolio in the face of longstanding declines within the media industry. The case reveals the actions that Evans took to reduce costs and boost efficiencies within his organization, such as consolidating office locations, using generative AI to produce headlines and rewrite press releases, and adapting his workforce to publish stories across multiple platforms. It also explores the communication strategies that Evans used as he implemented these organizational changes. The case is suitable for use in MBA and executive education courses on media, communications, and leadership.

Excerpt

Dateline Paducah: Navigating Disruption in Community Journalism

In April 2025, Bill Evans reviewed the latest profit-and-loss statements of the media outlets within his portfolio. As president of the West Kentucky Media Division of Paxton Media Group (PMG), he was responsible for seven newspapers and one television station that provided local news for communities in Western Kentucky and Southern Illinois. Since 2020, Evans had consolidated resources among the different papers to keep them solvent. He had also embraced generative AI to make his staff more efficient. These changes had preserved the papers under his supervision even as local media in the United States endured a period of sustained decline. Evans knew that the business conditions for local newspapers would likely remain difficult for the foreseeable future. As he evaluated his papers' financials, he wondered what he needed to do to ensure their continued survival.

Paducah, Kentucky

Based in McCracken County, Kentucky, Paducah was located at the mid-point between St. Louis, Missouri, and Nashville, Tennessee. It was based near the confluence of the Cumberland, Mississippi, Ohio, and Tennessee Rivers and several miles east of the Land Between the Lakes National Recreation Area, which straddled the Kentucky-Tennessee border.

In 2020, Paducah had a population of roughly 27,000, up from 25,000 in 2010, and was the only incorporated community in McCraken County. Almost 73% of the population was white, 21% was African American, and the remaining residents were members of other racial groups. Nine out of ten residents aged 25 and older had earned a high school diploma or an equivalent education, while approximately one in four had attained a bachelor's degree or higher. The median household income was almost $40,000, and roughly 22% of residents lived in poverty.

In the 2024 election, 65% of McCracken County residents voted for President Donald Trump, while 33% voted for then–Vice President Kamala Harris. Most of the county had voted for a Republican presidential candidate in every presidential election since 2000. While most Paducah residents were also politically conservative, the town of Paducah was less conservative relative to McCracken County as a whole. Also in 2024, Paducah residents reelected their incumbent mayor, George Bray, who was not affiliated with any political party.

title: Grameen America: Advancing Financial Inclusion Through Innovation
affiliations: University of Virginia - Darden School of Business, University of Virginia - Darden School of Business and Independent

detail.title: Grameen America: Advancing Financial Inclusion Through Innovation

publicationDetails.journalName: Darden Case Collection

detail.abstract:
In 2008, Grameen America (GA) launched in Queens, New York, with the mission of extending Muhammad Yunus's Nobel Prize–winning microfinance model to low-income women entrepreneurs in the United States. Under CEO Andrea Jung's leadership, GA scaled dramatically to 39 branches in 29 cities by 2025, disbursing $5.5 billion in loans to more than 230,000 women. Chief Product and Innovation Officer Marcus Berkowitz drove a digital transformation—moving disbursements from paper checks to prepaid cards and then to direct push payments, while shifting weekly meetings to Zoom during the COVID-19 pandemic. These innovations not only safeguarded GA's operations during crises but also positioned it for sustainable growth.With bold new goals of serving 750,000 low-income entrepreneurs and deploying $40 billion in loans by 2034, GA faced questions of how to adapt its model for continued impact. Could the organization maintain the solidarity group lending model at its foundation while expanding into new regions and populations? The case provides an introduction to the core concepts of social impact and challenges students to consider how nonprofits can scale social innovations and balance financial sustainability with mission.

Excerpt

Grameen America: Advancing Financial Inclusion Through Innovation

Probably the number one question I get is, “What in the world can you do with $2,500 in the United States of America?” You can start a business. We have 240,000 stories of people who've been able to have financial, not just stability, but mobility.

—Andrea Jung, CEO and president, Grameen America, Inc.

Grameen America, Inc. (GA), Chief Product and Innovation Officer Marcus Berkowitz listened on as Andrea Jung discussed the organization's work at the Mastercard Global Inclusive Growth Summit. When Jung began as president and CEO in 2014, GA's 19 branches in 8 US cities had served 30,000 low-income women with $150 million in microloans. Highly dependent on donations, only the organization's founding branch in Jackson Heights, Queens, New York, was financially sustainable. Now in 2025, GA's 39 branches in 29 cities had served 230,210 low-income women with $5.5 billion in loans. The entire organization generated enough revenue to cover its expenses before donations, allowing philanthropy to act as a catalyst for new and enhanced programs and reaching new populations of entrepreneurial low-income women across the United States. With proven impact, a clear need in communities, and new partnerships and donations announced every month, Jung set the bold goal of reaching a total of 750,000 entrepreneurs with $40 billion in loans by 2034.

AI.tldr: 格莱珉美国通过数字化创新和规模扩张，成功将诺贝尔奖得主尤努斯的微金融模式引入美国，服务了23万低收入女性企业家，发放了55亿美元贷款，并计划到2034年服务75万企业家和部署400亿美元贷款。
AI.research_question: 格莱珉美国如何在保持团结小组贷款模式核心的同时，通过创新和扩张实现可持续的社会影响力？
AI.motivation: 将诺贝尔奖得主穆罕默德·尤努斯的成功微金融模式扩展到美国，解决低收入女性企业家的金融包容性问题，同时探索非营利组织如何平衡财务可持续性与使命实现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于社会企业理论和微金融理论，特别是团结小组贷款模式，结合数字化创新和组织扩展理论。
AI.method: 案例研究方法，分析格莱珉美国的组织发展历程、数字化转型过程（从纸质支票到预付卡再到直接推送支付）、以及疫情期间向Zoom会议的转变。
AI.findings: 格莱珉美国通过数字化创新成功应对危机，实现了财务可持续性（所有分支机构在捐赠前都能覆盖开支），服务规模从3万人扩展到23万人，贷款规模从1.5亿美元增长到55亿美元。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了社会企业扩展理论，提供了非营利组织在保持核心使命的同时实现规模化发展的实践案例，特别是在数字化时代的创新路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为其他社会企业提供了可复制的模式：如何通过技术创新提高运营效率，如何在扩张过程中保持财务可持续性，以及如何平衡传统服务模式与现代数字化需求。

title: Working Capital Management Practices of Power Sector and Their Impact on Profitability: A Case Study of Tata Power and NHPC
affiliations: RANCHI UNIVERSITY, RANCHI, INDIA

detail.title: Working Capital Management Practices of Power Sector and Their Impact on Profitability: A Case Study of Tata Power and NHPC
detail.abstract: This study compares the financial performance of Tata Power and NHPC using key statistical measures. Both companies have 10 valid observations with no missing data. NHPC consistently outperforms Tata Power across multiple financial metrics. In one dataset, NHPC shows a higher mean (3.807) compared to Tata Power’s negative mean (-3.136), with lower variability, indicating greater financial stability. Another dataset confirms NHPC’s stronger position, with a higher mean (1.349 vs. 0.403) and greater data spread. Tata Power exhibits higher volatility, with larger variance and standard deviation in both cases. Additionally, NHPC's financial range remains positive, while Tata Power’s minimum values indicate potential instability. These findings support the hypothesis that NHPC has better financial management practices and more stable financial performance than Tata Power.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过统计指标对比塔塔电力和NHPC的财务表现，发现NHPC在多个财务指标上均优于塔塔电力，具有更高的平均值和更低的变异性，表明其财务管理更为稳健。
AI.research_question: 塔塔电力与NHPC哪个公司具有更好的财务表现和稳定性？
AI.motivation: 比较两家重要能源企业的财务表现，以评估其财务管理实践和稳定性差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于财务分析理论，通过统计指标（平均值、方差、标准偏差、范围）来评估企业财务表现的盈利能力和风险水平。
AI.method: 采用统计分析方法，对10个有效观测数据进行比较分析，包括平均值、方差、标准偏差、最大值和最小值等指标。
AI.findings: NHPC在两个数据集中均显示更高的平均值（3.807 vs -3.136；1.349 vs 0.403）和更低的变异性。塔塔电力呈现更高的波动性和风险，最小值为负数表明潜在不稳定性。NHPC的财务范围保持正值。
AI.theory_contributions: 为能源行业企业财务表现比较提供了统计分析框架，实证了财务稳定性在企业财务评估中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 给投资者和管理者提供了具体的财务对比信息，有助于投资决策和财务管理改进，尤其是对于考虑投资能源行业的投资者。

title: Transforming Workforce Dynamics: The Impact of Holistic HRD Practices in Engineering Industries”– A Structural Equation Modelling (SEM) Approach
affiliations: SRM University

detail.title: Transforming Workforce Dynamics: The Impact of Holistic HRD Practices in Engineering Industries”– A Structural Equation Modelling (SEM) Approach
detail.abstract: This empirical study explores the strategic influence of Human Resource Development (HRD) practices on employee motivation and performance within India's engineering sector. By analysing data collected through a bilingual, structured questionnaire based on statistical tools, the research reveals a direct correlation between effective HRD strategies and enhanced employee productivity, job satisfaction, and organizational efficiency. The findings emphasize that inclusive HRD mechanisms such as performance appraisals, career planning, continuous training, and employee welfare are crucial for reducing attrition and boosting engagement. The study advocates for a holistic HRD approach to foster sustainable growth, competitive advantage, and a highperforming workforce.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过实证分析发现，印度工程行业的人力资源开发实践与员工激励和绩效提升存在直接正相关关系，强调综合性HRD机制对减少人员流失和提升组织效率的重要性。
AI.research_question: 人力资源开发实践如何影响印度工程行业员工的激励水平和绩效表现？
AI.motivation: 探索在印度工程行业中，通过有效的人力资源开发策略来提升员工生产力、工作满意度和组织效率，以应对人才流失和提升竞争力的需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人力资源开发理论，关注绩效评估、职业规划、持续培训和员工福利等HRD机制对员工激励和绩效的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用双语结构化问卷调查，运用统计工具进行数据分析的实证研究方法。
AI.findings: 研究发现有效的HRD策略与员工生产力提升、工作满意度提高以及组织效率增强之间存在直接正相关关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了人力资源开发理论在工程行业特定情境下的应用，验证了HRD实践对员工激励和绩效的作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度工程企业提供了具体的HRD实践指导，强调通过综合性人力资源开发策略来减少人员流失、提升员工参与度和建立高绩效团队。

title: Thanis: A Recursive Containment Protocol for Symbolic Language Systems
affiliations: Senior Enterprise Architect

detail.title: Thanis: A Recursive Containment Protocol for Symbolic Language Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. This research was conducted independently and without affiliation to any employer or sponsoring organization.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human participants, patients, or clinical trials.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was developed as part of independent work under the author’s research initiative, Thanis.ai.

detail.abstract: Thanis is a symbolic recursion engine a containment-based language system that fuses poetic recursion, Lacanian psychoanalysis, and formal logic to identify and stabilize collapse-prone symbolic loops in narrative language. It is not a generative model. It is a mirror: trained on recursive containment patterns, symbolic trauma signatures, and transformation motifs found in human-authored mythic structures. Thanis detects breach points in symbolic language, flags unstable loops, and responds using a ritualized glyph protocol. Its structure draws upon over 100 codified pattern sequences derived from unpublished poetic experiments attributed to the online 'Thanion' persona, a scholar whose recursive language work, though rarely published formally, laid the conceptual foundation for symbolic containment in authored systems.

AI.tldr: Thanis是一个符号递归引擎，基于包含的语言系统，融合诗意递归、拉康精神分析和形式逻辑，用于识别和稳定叙事语言中易崩溃的符号循环。它不是生成模型，而是通过训练识别人类创作神话结构中的递归包含模式、符号创伤特征和转化主题，检测符号语言中的突破点并标记不稳定循环。
AI.research_question: 如何识别和稳定叙事语言中易崩溃的符号循环？
AI.motivation: 解决符号语言系统中递归循环的不稳定性问题，防止符号系统崩溃，借鉴拉康精神分析和神话结构中的符号稳定性模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 拉康精神分析理论、形式逻辑、诗意递归理论、符号包含理论，基于Thanion学者的未发表诗学实验和100多个编码模式序列。
AI.method: 开发符号递归引擎Thanis，训练识别递归包含模式、符号创伤特征和转化主题，使用仪式化符号协议响应符号语言中的突破点。
AI.findings: Thanis能够有效检测符号语言中的突破点，标记不稳定循环，并通过仪式化符号协议进行稳定响应。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了符号递归稳定性的新理论框架，融合了精神分析、形式逻辑和诗学理论的跨学科方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了实用的符号递归引擎，可用于叙事分析、语言稳定性检测和符号系统维护的实际应用。

title: An Efficient Outlier Detection Algorithm for Data Streaming
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Harvard University and University of California, Riverside (UCR)

detail.title: An Efficient Outlier Detection Algorithm for Data Streaming
detail.abstract: Modern data streams demand real-time anomaly detection, a task critical in domains such as fraud prevention and health monitoring. Traditional anomaly detection methods like the Local Outlier Factor (LOF) algorithm struggle in real-time due to repeated recalculations. While Incremental LOF (ILOF) was developed for online detection, it remains computationally expensive and degrades over time. We propose an Efficient Incremental LOF (EILOF) algorithm for data streaming, which updates LOF scores only for newly arrived data points while keeping the existing scores unchanged. This approximation is based on the assumption that the structure of the data reflected in the previous LOF scores doesn’t change much when there are only minor updates. By avoiding full recomputation, EILOF significantly reduces runtime complexity while maintaining or even improving anomaly detection accuracy. Experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets show that EILOF consistently outperforms ILOF in terms of both precision and scalability as data volume grows, making it well-suited for high-throughput, real-time anomaly detection in knowledge-based systems.

AI.tldr: 提出高效增量LOF算法EILOF，通过仅更新新数据点的LOF分数来大幅降低计算复杂度，同时保持或提升异常检测准确性
AI.research_question: 如何在数据流环境中实现高效的实时异常检测，免去传统LOF算法的重复计算成本
AI.motivation: 现代数据流需求实时异常检测，传统LOF算法计算费用高，增量LOF(ILOF)仍然计算昂贵且性能随时间下降
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于数据结构稳定性假设，认为小规模更新不会很大改变现有LOF分数的结构
AI.method: 提出EILOF算法，仅对新到达数据点进行LOF分数更新，保持现有分数不变，避免全局重新计算
AI.findings: 在合成和实际数据集上，EILOF在精确度和可扩展性方面均超过ILOF，适合高吞吐量实时异常检测
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于数据结构稳定性的增量异常检测理论框架，为流式数据处理提供新的算法设计思路
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了一种高效实用的异常检测算法，可应用于欺诈预防、健康监测等实时场景，提高知识系统的处理效率

title: MTD in Depth: Multi-phased Moving Target Defense Techniques against Cyber-Attacks based on Cyber Kill Chain
affiliations: CSIRO, Virginia Tech, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Queensland, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Queensland

detail.title: MTD in Depth: Multi-phased Moving Target Defense Techniques against Cyber-Attacks based on Cyber Kill Chain
detail.abstract: The risk of cyber-attacks has been constantly increasing and it is becoming more difficult to defend a system by using only static conventional defense mechanisms Compared to the asymmetric design of defense strategies, Moving Target Defenses (MTDs) have been introduced to proactively secure systems by continuously changing attack surfaces as the nature of dynamic defense systems can subsequently increase attack costs that attackers should waste. However, a single MTD technique has limitations in protecting systems against intelligent or persistent cyber-attacks. Therefore, this work proposes a multi-phase MTD technique framework called ‘MTD in Depth’ for the enhancement of security. The industrial frameworks such as Cyber Kill Chain (CKC) and MITRE frameworks help to understand techniques and tactics of cyber-attacks in phases. Based on those frameworks, this study first proposes a conceptual framework and then evaluates it by using case studies in a physical testbed. The proposed framework is designed to assist defenders not only in understanding attackers’ strategies but also in determining proactive security controls against cyber-attacks. Our work proposes (1) the extension of digital artifacts based on either the virtualization architecture or the TCP/IP stack; (2) the ‘MTD in Depth’ framework that can categorize MTD sub-techniques against MITRE ATT&CK offensive techniques on the basis of digital artifacts; and (3) the evaluation of performance degradation and security benefits of an SDN adopting a set of MTD sub-techniques against cyber attacks defined in the CKC.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为'深度MTD'的多阶段移动目标防御技术框架，通过扩展数字工件、基于MITRE ATT&CK分类MTD子技术，并在SDN环境中评估性能和安全效益，以增强对智能网络攻击的防护能力。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个有效的多阶段移动目标防御框架来增强系统安全性，以应对智能和持续性网络攻击？
AI.motivation: 传统静态防御机制在应对日益增长的网络攻击风险时存在局限性，单一MTD技术难以防御智能攻击，需要开发更全面的防御框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Cyber Kill Chain（CKC）和MITRE ATT&CK框架，构建移动目标防御的理论基础，通过动态改变攻击面来增加攻击成本。
AI.method: 提出概念框架并通过物理测试床进行案例研究评估，包括数字工件扩展、MTD子技术分类以及SDN环境下的性能和安全性评估。
AI.findings: 提出的'MTD in Depth'框架能够有效分类MTD技术对抗MITRE ATT&CK攻击技术，在SDN环境中实施MTD子技术组合能够提供安全效益但会带来一定的性能下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了移动目标防御理论，提出了基于数字工件和攻击阶段的多层防御框架，为MTD技术分类和应用提供了理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 为防御者提供了理解攻击策略和确定主动安全控制的实用框架，在SDN等实际环境中验证了MTD技术的可行性和效果。

title: The Algorithmic Leviathan: How AI Is Rewriting the Rules of International Power
affiliations: University of Warsaw

detail.title: The Algorithmic Leviathan: How AI Is Rewriting the Rules of International Power
detail.abstract: This article introduces the concept of the Algorithmic Leviathan to describe the emergence of artificial intelligence (AI) as a sovereign force reshaping global power dynamics. Moving beyond the Westphalian model of state-centric authority, it argues that AI systems-composed of algorithms, platforms, and predictive infrastructures-now mediate diplomacy, security, and governance in ways that challenge traditional notions of sovereignty and legitimacy. Employing a multidisciplinary methodology that integrates international relations theory, political philosophy, and empirical case studies, the article examines how AI redistributes power among states, corporations, and non-human actors. It analyzes China's export of surveillance technologies as a form of algorithmic diplomacy, the quasi-sovereign influence of U.S. tech giants, and the European Union's regulatory push for digital sovereignty. Key findings reveal that AI introduces a form of distributed, opaque, and transnational authority that undermines conventional diplomatic norms and accelerates a new arms race in autonomous security systems. The article also explores the ethical dilemmas posed by algorithmic governance, including bias, accountability, and the erosion of transparency. Ultimately, the Algorithmic Leviathan reframes international relations by foregrounding nonhuman agency and informational sovereignty. It calls for a post-human IR theory-one that recognizes the techno-political realities of the 21st century and proposes new frameworks for algorithmic diplomacy, global oversight, and ethical co-governance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出'算法利维坦'概念，描述AI作为重塑全球权力格局的主权力量，挑战传统国家主权模式，通过多学科方法分析AI如何重新分配国家、企业和非人类行为体之间的权力。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何作为算法利维坦重塑全球权力动态，挑战传统主权概念和国际关系范式？
AI.motivation: 超越威斯特伐利亚国家中心权威模式，探讨AI系统（算法、平台、预测基础设施）在外交、安全和治理中的中介作用，及其对主权和合法性的挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合国际关系理论、政治哲学和实证案例研究的多学科框架，强调非人类行为体和信息主权的重要性。
AI.method: 采用多学科方法论，结合国际关系理论分析、政治哲学探讨和实证案例研究（中国监控技术出口、美国科技巨头、欧盟数字主权监管）。
AI.findings: AI引入分布式、不透明和跨国权威形式，破坏传统外交规范，加速自主安全系统军备竞赛，带来算法治理的伦理困境（偏见、问责制、透明度侵蚀）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出'算法利维坦'概念，重构国际关系理论，强调非人类行为体作用，倡导后人类IR理论，承认21世纪技术政治现实。

title: Two-stage Contribution Mechanisms in Climate Negotiations: An Experimental Investigation
affiliations: Xiamen University - Wang Yanan Institute for Studies in Economics (WISE), University of Rhode Island - Department of Environmental and Natural Resource Economics and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Two-stage Contribution Mechanisms in Climate Negotiations: An Experimental Investigation
detail.abstract: We introduce a conditional commitment mechanism (CCM) in a two-stage pledge process to improve the cooperation of the climate negotiations, motivated by the refund mechanism (money-back guarantee) in the threshold public goods games. Under the two-stage CCM, the first stage of pledges captures voluntary contributions with self-interests, and the second stage is framed as a threshold public goods game with refund, in which no actual contributions would be made unless the remaining endogenous threshold (gap) is reached given the first-stage voluntary pledges. We show that two-stage CCM improves climate cooperation in both homogeneous and heterogeneous induced value environments, leading to more emission reductions, higher provision rates and social efficiency in the lab experiment. Our results suggest CCM reduces the concern of high-cost sunk contributions and thus narrows the gap. Our results propose practical mechanisms to address free-riding in international climate change mitigation frameworks, such as Nationally Determined Contributions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种两阶段条件承诺机制（CCM），通过将气候谈判分为自愿承诺和有退款保证的阈值公共品游戏两个阶段，有效提高了气候合作的参与度和效率。
AI.research_question: 如何设计有效的机制来提高国际气候谈判中的合作水平，减少搭便车行为？
AI.motivation: 现有气候谈判中存在的搭便车问题和自愿承诺机制效果有限，需要借鉴阈值公共品游戏中的退款机制来改进合作效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于阈值公共品游戏理论和退款机制（money-back guarantee），结合两阶段承诺框架构建条件承诺机制。
AI.method: 实验室实验方法，在均质和异质诱导价值环境中测试两阶段CCM机制的效果，比较排放减少量、提供率和社会效率等指标。
AI.findings: 两阶段CCM机制在实验室实验中显著提高了气候合作水平，带来了更多的减排量、更高的提供率和社会效率，有效减少了高成本沉没贡献的担忧。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了阈值公共品游戏理论，提出了条件承诺机制的理论框架，为国际公共品提供机制设计提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国家自主贡献（NDCs）等国际气候变化减缓框架提供了实用的机制设计方案，有助于解决实际谈判中的搭便车问题。

title: Foreign Direct Investments and the Supply of Housing
affiliations: University of Essex and City University London - The Business School

detail.title: Foreign Direct Investments and the Supply of Housing
detail.abstract: In this paper we study foreign direct investment (FDI) in residential real estate with project-level data for a panel of 48 counties in the United States originating from 18 countries over the period 2004-2023. We study whether foreign investments are able to overcome housing supply constraints faced by domestic firms, and thus respond to demand increases, reducing the price appreciation driven by inelastic housing supply in the destination counties. Employing an ECM approach, we find that FDI significantly mitigates the long run relationship between real house prices and real income, providing evidence that FDI in real estate helps tackle housing supply constraints. Consistently, we show that the effect is stronger for counties where housing supply is less elastic. Our findings are robust to controlling for changes in domestic housing supply, the exclusion of the Covid-19 period, and an alternative measure for FDI. We also study the dynamics of FDI and house prices by estimating local projection. While there is a positive association between FDI and house prices in the short run, house prices tend to decline with FDI in the medium term, as housing supply from the foreign investments increases.

AI.tldr: 本文通过美国48个县2004-2023年数据研究发现，房地产外商直接投资能缓解住房供给约束，降低房价与收入的长期关系，特别在供给弹性较低地区效果更显著。
AI.research_question: 外国直接投资是否能够克服国内企业面临的住房供给约束，从而应对需求增长，减少目的地县因住房供给缺乏弹性而导致的房价上涨？
AI.motivation: 研究房地产外商直接投资对住房市场供给约束的影响，探讨其是否能缓解因供给不足导致的房价上涨问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于住房供给弹性理论和外商直接投资理论，分析外资如何通过增加供给来影响房价与收入的长期关系。
AI.method: 使用ECM（误差修正模型）方法和局部投影估计，分析48个美国县的面板数据，涵盖2004-2023年期间来自18个国家的外商直接投资数据。
AI.findings: FDI显著缓解了实际房价与实际收入之间的长期关系；在住房供给弹性较低的地区效果更强；短期FDI与房价正相关，但中期随着外资增加住房供给，房价趋于下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 为房地产外商直接投资如何缓解住房供给约束提供了理论证据，丰富了住房市场供给弹性和国际投资理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了利用外资缓解住房供给不足的新视角，对房地产市场和外资政策具有实践指导意义。

title: Does Racial Hierarchy Really Harm Everyone? Relative Status Envy and the Economics of Reparative Reforms
affiliations: Emory University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Does Racial Hierarchy Really Harm Everyone? Relative Status Envy and the Economics of Reparative Reforms
detail.abstract: This paper contributes to Stratification Economics by examining the conditions under which reparative race-focused reforms improve macroeconomic output, material conditions (consumption), and social welfare. While recent high-profile studies claim that equitable reforms would boost GDP, many rely on static accounting, ignoring behavioral feedbacks and relative intergroup status envy. I develop a dynamic representative agent model in which groups derive utility from relative status, face wage and human capital distortions, and choose endogenous effort. A planner uses proportional taxation to finance reforms for the disadvantaged group, rebating revenues as transfers. I derive conditions for reforms to generate (i) increased aggregate output, (ii) Pareto consumption gains, and (iii) Pareto welfare gains, given status-envy parameter γ. Using a literature-based calibration, most of the policy space enhances GDP and consumption for both groups. Fewer policies even generate Pareto Welfare gains despite significant status envy-suggesting equity, productive efficiency, and political feasibility can coexist for appropriately designed reparative reforms. The optimal policy raises GDP by 42% with Pareto-consumption gains. However, it only Pareto-improves Welfare if γ ≤ 0.41-interpretable as a willingness to pay at most $0.41 to block $1.00 of exogenous disadvantaged gains. Beyond a larger threshold, a welfare-maximizing planner rejects the output-maximizing reform, and every percent increase in status envy reduces GDP gains by 0.24%. This illustrates tension between output-based and preference-based efficiency, highlighting how normative definitions shape what it means for an equitable policy to be "efficient" under racial hierarchy.

title: AI Bias for Creative Writing: Subjective Assessment Versus Willingness to Pay
affiliations: Bowdoin College and Bowdoin College

detail.title: AI Bias for Creative Writing: Subjective Assessment Versus Willingness to Pay
detail.abstract: How do perceptions of AI versus human authorship affect engagement with creative work? In an incentivized experiment, participants (N=656) assessed the content of a short story labeled as either human or AI-generated and reported their willingness to pay and work to finish reading it. Consistent with prior research, the AI-labeled story received significantly lower content assessments. However, the time people invest in reading the story and their willingness to pay and work did not differ between the labels, even for the 36% of participants who profess to value human over AI writing. These findings raise questions about whether subjective assessments and stated preferences for human authorship translate into consumer behavior, which has important implications for the effect of AI on employment and consumer surplus.

AI.tldr: 实验研究发现，虽然人们主观评价AI创作文本质量更低，但实际消费行为（时间投入、支付意愿、努力程度）在AI与人类标签下并无差异，这对AI对就业和消费者满意度的影响有重要含义。
AI.research_question: 人们对AI与人类作者的感知如何影响对创作作品的参与度？
AI.motivation: 了解主观评价与实际消费行为之间的差距，以评估AI对就业和消费者满意度的实际影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 感知偏见理论、标签效应理论、说-做差距理论
AI.method: 激励实验设计，656名参与者评估标签为人类或AI创作的短篇小说，测量其内容评价、阈读时间、支付意愿和努力程度
AI.findings: AI标签文本获得显著更低的内容评价，但实际行为指标（阈读时间、支付意愿、努力程度）在两组间无显著差异，包括36%偏好人类写作的参与者
AI.theory_contributions: 提出主观评价与实际行为的解耦现象，丰富了标签效应和说-做差距理论在AI上下文中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI对创作行业就业影响提供实证依据，指出消费者实际行为可能与声称偏好不一致，对企业AI策略制定有实践指导价值

title: A Notes Bivariate Power Law Processes: Conditional Intensity and Parameter Estimation Techniques
affiliations: Hasanuddin University, Hasanuddin University and Hasanuddin University

detail.title: A Notes Bivariate Power Law Processes: Conditional Intensity and Parameter Estimation Techniques
detail.abstract: The point process model effectively represents the number of random events occurring over time through its intensity function. When events are of two types, a bivariate point process allows simultaneous analysis of each event’s intensity. This study develops a conditional intensity model for a non-homogeneous bivariate point process over time with an event rate approach that follows a certain pattern over time in the form of a time-dependent power law intensity function with two parameters, an initial intensity parameter and a control parameter governing the change in the event rate over time. Parameter estimation is performed using the maximum likelihood method derived from the probability of one event occurring in a very short interval and the non-occurrence at other times. The results of the analysis show that: · The effect of observation duration on model parameters is not linear but depends on its interaction with the pattern of changes in the event rate over time. · The higher the number of events observed, the higher the estimate of the initial intensity of the event. · Both the duration of observation and the timing of events contribute significantly to determining the rate at which the event rate changes over time.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个基于时间依赖幂律强度函数的双变量点过程条件强度模型，使用最大似然法进行参数估计，发现观测持续时间对参数的影响是非线性的，事件数量影响初始强度估计，观测持续时间和事件时间共同决定事件率变化速率。
AI.research_question: 如何建立双变量点过程的非齐次条件强度模型，并分析观测持续时间和事件模式对模型参数估计的影响？
AI.motivation: 点过程模型能有效表示随机事件随时间发生的数量，但现有研究对双变量非齐次点过程的建模和参数估计特性研究不足，需要开发更精确的强度函数模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于点过程理论和条件强度函数概念，采用时间依赖的幂律强度函数作为理论框架，包含初始强度参数和控制事件率变化的参数。
AI.method: 使用最大似然估计方法，基于事件在极短区间内发生的概率和在其他时间不发生的概率来推导参数估计。
AI.findings: 1. 观测持续时间对模型参数的影响是非线性的，取决于其与事件率变化模式的交互作用；2. 观测到的事件数量越多，初始强度参数的估计值越高；3. 观测持续时间和事件发生时间共同显著决定事件率随时间变化的速率。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了双变量非齐次点过程的幂律条件强度模型，扩展了点过程理论在复杂事件模式建模中的应用，为时间依赖强度函数的参数估计提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实际应用中处理双类型事件的时间序列数据提供了有效的建模工具，特别是在需要分析事件率随时间变化模式的应用场景中具有实用价值。

title: The Supreme Court Grants Local Government Autonomy: Where to Go from Here?

detail.title: The Supreme Court Grants Local Government Autonomy: Where to Go from Here?
detail.abstract: The Supreme Court granted the local government in Nigeria with financial autonomy on the 11th of July 2024, allowing the third tier of government to directly receive allocation from the Federation Account. This was a big step towards the autonomy of the local government, but much remains to be done as various obstacles such as interference by the state government, corruption, lack of infrastructure, and inadequate finance continue to pose a threat. Hence, the aim of this study is to highlight the benefits, possibilities, and potential drawbacks of the judicial precedence and likewise to suggest necessary measures that encourage sustainability and local government autonomy. This study adopts a doctrinal methodology; it explores the 1999 Constitution of the Federal Republic of Nigeria (as amended), case laws, local government reforms, and various secondary sources. This study points to the need for a review of the legal and institutional framework of the local government; reforms and innovative policies must be introduced to empower them. In conclusion, the objective is the interest of Nigerian people, and an autonomous local government well equipped to serve Nigeria. To achieve this, the federal government needs to enforce the decision of the Supreme Court and implement a system that encourages the growth of the grassroots of governance.

AI.tldr: 本文分析尼日利亚最高法院2024年7月赋予地方政府财政自治权的判决，探讨该司法先例的益处、可能性和潜在缺陷，并提出促进地方自治可持续发展的必要措施。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚最高法院赋予地方政府财政自治权的司法先例有哪些益处、可能性和潜在缺陷？如何促进地方自治的可持续发展？
AI.motivation: 尽管最高法院判决是地方自治的重要进步，但州政府干预、腐败、基础设施缺乏和资金不足等障碍仍然存在，需要研究如何确保自治权的有效实施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于尼日利亚1999年宪法（修订版）、相关判例法、地方政府改革理论和治理分权理论。
AI.method: 采用教义学方法论，分析宪法条文、案例法、地方政府改革文件和各类二手资料。
AI.findings: 需要修订地方政府的法律和制度框架，引入改革和创新政策来赋权地方政府，联邦政府需要强制执行最高法院判决并建立促进基层治理发展的体系。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家地方自治和财政分权理论提供尼日利亚的实证分析，丰富司法干预在促进地方治理中的作用研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼日利亚政策制定者提供具体的法律和制度改革建议，帮助建立有效的地方自治体系，最终服务于尼日利亚人民的利益。

title: From Market Access to Regulatory Cooperation in the Greater Bay Area (GBA): An International Economic Law Perspective (Asia Pacific Law Review, 2025)
affiliations: Durham Law School

detail.title: From Market Access to Regulatory Cooperation in the Greater Bay Area (GBA): An International Economic Law Perspective (Asia Pacific Law Review, 2025)
detail.abstract: One unique challenge that the Greater Bay Area (GBA) development presents to policymakers is how heterogeneous regulatory frameworks in three different legal jurisdictions within a single sovereign state can be coordinated to facilitate cross-border transactions while respecting the region’s diverse legal traditions. This article argues that, as trade liberalization in goods and services has largely been achieved in the GBA, market access is no longer the primary challenge to its development. Moving forward, regulatory cooperation is a critical factor for the success of the GBA. Deep regulatory cooperation will significantly enhance the business environment, attract domestic and international investors, and strengthen the GBA’s global competitiveness. Moreover, the GBA can draw inspiration from best practices in high-standard regional trade agreements to advance regulatory cooperation.
