title: How ChatGPT Shapes a New Reality of Writing: Is There a Place for Humans in an Artificial World?
affiliations: V.N. Karazin Kharkiv National University and V.N. Karazin Kharkiv National University

detail.title: How ChatGPT Shapes a New Reality of Writing: Is There a Place for Humans in an Artificial World?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that there are no conflicts of interest regarding the publication of this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: The authors declare that this study received no specific financial support

detail.abstract:
Aim. This study explores the impact of Artificial Intelligence (AI) -driven text generation on authorship recognition and its implications for education. Specifically, it examines how individuals with varying levels of experience using ChatGPT perceive AI-generated texts and whether editing affects their ability to distinguish between human and AI-authored content. The study aims to inform strategies for integrating AI literacy into education while addressing challenges in authorship attribution.

Methodology. A quantitative study was conducted with 85 participants, categorized based on their ChatGPT usage: no experience (n=22), occasional use (n=31), and daily use (n=32). Participants evaluated texts across five stylistic genres (literary, journalistic, scientific, philosophical, and promotional) and attempted to determine authorship (human, AI-generated, or AI-edited). The data were analyzed using statistical methods, including the Kruskal-Wallis test, ANOVA, and Pearson’s correlation analysis.

Results. The findings indicate that participants struggled to differentiate between human and AI-generated texts, with an average accuracy of 5.48 out of 15. The ability to identify authorship varied by genre, with philosophical texts being the easiest to recognize and journalistic texts posing the greatest challenge. Experience with ChatGPT did not significantly improve recognition accuracy. Editing AI-generated texts further blurred the distinction between human and machine authorship.

Conclusions. The results highlight the need for educational approaches that enhance critical literacy and awareness of AI-generated content. AI tools can serve as collaborative writing aids, but their integration into learning requires ethical considerations and adapted assessment strategies. Future research should expand the sample size and investigate the effects of long-term AI exposure on writing perception.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨AI文本生成对作者识别的影响，发现参与者难以区分人类与AI生成文本，准确率仅36.5%。ChatGPT使用经验不影响识别能力，编辑AI文本会进一步模糊人机界限，呼吁加强AI素养教育。
AI.research_question: 不同ChatGPT使用经验的个体如何感知AI生成文本？编辑是否影响他们区分人类与AI创作内容的能力？
AI.motivation: 探索AI文本生成对作者识别的影响，为教育中AI素养整合提供策略，解决作者归属挑战
AI.theoretical_framework: AI文本生成理论、作者识别理论、数字素养理论
AI.method: 定量研究，85名参与者按ChatGPT使用经验分组（无经验22人、偶尔使用31人、日常使用32人），评估五种文体类型的文本并判断作者身份，使用Kruskal-Wallis检验、ANOVA和Pearson相关分析
AI.findings: 参与者平均准确率仅5.48/15（36.5%）；哲学文本最易识别，新闻文本最难；ChatGPT经验不影响识别准确性；编辑AI文本进一步模糊人机区别
AI.theory_contributions: 深化对AI文本识别困难的理解，提出AI生成内容感知的理论框架，为数字时代作者身份理论提供新视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育机构提供AI素养课程设计依据，建议调整写作评估策略，促进AI工具作为协作写作辅助的合理使用

title: Pain, Attitudes, and (In)Action: Divergent Legacies of Herbicidal Warfare in Vietnam
affiliations: Osaka Metropolitan University, Hiroshima University, Princeton University, Hiroshima University and Kwansei Gakuin University

detail.title: Pain, Attitudes, and (In)Action: Divergent Legacies of Herbicidal Warfare in Vietnam
detail.abstract: We investigate the legacies of wartime violence with a formal model and a lab-in-thefield experiment involving Agent Orange victims in Vietnam, revealing two contrasting patterns. First, attitudinal change does not necessarily lead to behavioral shifts. Past victimization is positively associated with empathy toward Agent Orange victims-but only among direct victims (survivors), not indirect victims (family members). However, the heightened empathy does not translate into greater sharing in a Dictator Game. Second, behavioral change does not necessarily reflect attitudinal shifts. A Dictator Game with randomized receiver victimhood reveals that, unlike non-victims, direct and indirect victims do not adjust their choices in response to the receiver's victimhoodeven though direct victims express greater empathy toward other victims. Formalizing intra-individual persistence (e.g., empathy toward victims) and inter-individual transmission mechanisms (e.g., social norm compliance), presented model encompasses our field evidence and existing insights of convergent legacies as special cases.

AI.tldr: 本文通过形式模型和田野实验研究越南橙剂受害者的战时暴力遗留影响，发现态度变化不一定导致行为改变，行为变化也不一定反映态度转变。直接受害者表现出更高同理心但不转化为分享行为，受害者群体对接收者受害状况不敏感。
AI.research_question: 战时暴力遗留如何影响受害者的态度和行为？态度与行为变化之间是否存在必然联系？
AI.motivation: 理解战争暴力的长期社会心理影响，探究受害者群体内部的态度-行为关系机制
AI.theoretical_framework: 战时暴力遗留理论、态度-行为关系理论、社会规范遵从理论、同理心理论
AI.method: 形式模型构建 + 田野实验（实验室实地实验），使用独裁者游戏测量分享行为，调查问卷测量同理心态度
AI.findings: 1) 直接受害者同理心增强但不转化为分享行为；2) 受害者不因接收者受害状况调整行为；3) 态度与行为变化存在脱节
AI.theory_contributions: 提出包含个体内持久性和个体间传递机制的统一理论框架，解释态度-行为不一致现象
AI.practical_contributions: 为战后心理干预和社会重建提供实证依据，帮助设计更有效的受害者支持政策

reference: The Regulatory Review, 16 August 2025
title: To Prompt a Butterfly. On the Traceability of AI-Generated Creations
affiliations: Autorità Garante della Concorrenza e del Mercato (AGCM)

detail.title: To Prompt a Butterfly. On the Traceability of AI-Generated Creations
detail.abstract: The essay focuses on regulatory policies aimed at ensuring the identifiability and traceability of the synthetic nature of generative AI creations. Although major jurisdictions (USA, EU, China) have so far pursued autonomous approaches, and in the absence of a common international framework—further exacerbated by the non-cooperative stance of the recent America's AI Action Plan—the inherently global nature of the issue calls for shared solutions.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨生成式AI内容标识与溯源监管政策，分析中美欧三大司法管辖区各自为政的现状，指出缺乏国际统一框架的问题，强调全球性挑战需要共同解决方案。
AI.research_question: 如何建立有效的生成式AI合成内容标识与溯源监管政策框架？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI技术的快速发展带来了内容真实性和溯源性的挑战，各主要司法管辖区采取自主监管方式，缺乏国际合作框架，亟需探讨全球统一的监管解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际监管协调理论、技术治理理论和数字主权理论，分析不同司法管辖区的监管政策差异和协调可能性。
AI.method: 采用比较分析法，对比美国、欧盟和中国三大司法管辖区的生成式AI监管政策，分析其异同点和协调障碍。
AI.findings: 发现三大管辖区在生成式AI内容标识监管方面存在显著差异，美国采取相对宽松的自主监管模式，欧盟强调严格的内容标识要求，中国注重技术可控和内容安全。国际协调面临美国非合作立场的挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了数字时代国际技术监管协调理论，提出了生成式AI全球治理的理论框架，为跨国监管合作提供理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供跨国监管协调的具体建议，为企业应对不同司法管辖区监管要求提供实践指导，促进生成式AI技术的负责任发展。

title: Within Bank Holding Company Accounting Information and Internal Capital Allocation
affiliations: University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management, University of Pennsylvania - Accounting Department and George Mason University - Department of Accounting

detail.title: Within Bank Holding Company Accounting Information and Internal Capital Allocation
detail.abstract: We examine whether loan loss provision validity (i.e., the extent of loan loss provisions mapping into future charge offs) within the bank holding company (BHC) is associated with internal capital allocation efficiency. Exploiting the filing requirements for subsidiary banks, we find that within-BHC provision validity, our measure of internal information quality, is positively associated with internal capital market efficiency. We also find that this association is concentrated in BHCs more likely to allocate capital to take advantage of subsidiary lending opportunities and BHCs with higher internal information asymmetry. These findings suggest that within-BHC accounting information that better reflects subsidiary bank loan performance mitigates information problems between headquarters and subsidiary managers in internal capital allocation. This study contributes to our understanding of how loan loss provision information of lower-level entities within the organization is associated with headquarters capital allocation and helps mitigate internal information asymmetry within banking organizations.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文研究了钱行持股公司内部贷款损失准备的有效性如何影响内部资本分配效率，发现更高的准备有效性能够缓解总部与子公司管理者之间的信息不对称问题，提高资本分配效率。
AI.research_question: 钱行持股公司内部贷款损失准备的有效性是否与内部资本分配效率相关？
AI.motivation: 理解会计信息如何在组织内部缓解信息不对称问题，并影响资本分配决策效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息不对称理论和内部资本市场理论，重点关注会计信息在缩小总部与子公司之间信息差距中的作用。
AI.method: 利用子公司报表提交要求的差异，构建内部信息质量指标，并与内部资本市场效率进行关联分析。
AI.findings: 内部贷款损失准备有效性与内部资本市场效率呈正相关，尤其在更可能利用子公司贷款机会和内部信息不对称程度较高的BHC中更为显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了对会计信息在组织内部缓解信息问题中作用的理论理解，特别是在银行业内部资本分配上的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行持股公司提供了通过提高子公司贷款损失准备质量来优化内部资本分配效率的实践意义。

title: Network Autocracy and the GASI Index: Toward a Global Early-Warning Standard
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Network Autocracy and the GASI Index: Toward a Global Early-Warning Standard

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, animals, or patient data and therefore did not require ethical approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This article presents the Gas-Algorithmic Sovereignty Index (GASI)-a parsimonious, three-component indicator that detects and forecasts, 12-18 months in advance, a polity's drift toward network autocracy: regimes that retain formal democratic institutions yet predetermine political outcomes through resource rents, national digital platforms, and algorithmic governance. Empirical validation on 195 countries (2022-2024) shows higher predictive sensitivity than Freedom House, V-Dem, or EIU indices. GASI identifies 27 fully-fledged network autocracies, 39 transitional cases, and delineates regional hotspots in the Middle East and Central Asia. Extensions for mineral, urban, and green rents are sketched and a roadmap for real-time monitoring tools is provided.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Gas算法主权指数(GASI)，这是一个简洁的三成分指标，能够提前12-18个月检测和预测政体向网络专制主义的漂移。该指数在195个国家(2022-2024年)的实证验证显示比自由之家、V-Dem或经济学人指数具有更高的预测敏感性。
AI.research_question: 如何有效检测和预测政体向网络专制主义的漂移？
AI.motivation: 现有民主指数无法充分捕捉那些保留正式民主制度但通过资源租金、国家数字平台和算法治理来预先决定政治结果的网络专制政体。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络专制主义理论，强调资源租金、数字平台和算法治理在维持表面民主下的专制控制中的作用。
AI.method: 开发三成分指标体系，对195个国家进行实证分析(2022-2024年)，并与现有民主指数进行对比验证。
AI.findings: 识别出27个完全成熟的网络专制政体，39个过渡案例，并确定了中东和中亚的地区热点；GASI显示出比现有指数更高的预测敏感性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了网络专制主义的概念框架和测量方法，填补了现有民主测量理论的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了实时监测工具的开发路线图，为政策制定者和研究人员提供了早期预警系统，并扩展了矿物、城市和绿色租金的测量方法。

title: Consensus as the Fundamental of Non-Productive Asset
affiliations: Peking University - HSBC School of Business and Peking University HSBC Business School

detail.title: Consensus as the Fundamental of Non-Productive Asset
detail.abstract: This paper develops a consensus-based framework for valuing non-productive assets— those without intrinsic cash flows, such as gold, artwork, and cryptocurrencies. Unlike traditional asset-pricing models that rely on discounted cash flows, or behavioral accounts that treat prices as outcomes of psychology, our approach derives equilibrium values directly from belief aggregation. We model a market of believers, disbelievers, and followers whose opinions evolve through DeGroot-style dynamics. Closed-form solutions show that value is anchored by steadfast believers, diluted by disbelievers, and transmitted by followers. The framework explains how small compositional shifts can trigger large price movements, offering a unified theory of valuation for assets without yield. It also provides a foundation for empirical calibration and offers testable implications for both market participants and regulators.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个基于共识的框架来评估非生产性资产（如黄金、艺术品和加密货币），通过信念聚合直接推导均衡价值，解释了小规模组成变化如何引发大幅价格波动。
AI.research_question: 如何为没有内在现金流的非生产性资产建立估值框架？
AI.motivation: 传统资产定价模型依赖贴现现金流方法，行为金融学则将价格视为心理结果，两者都无法很好地解释非生产性资产的估值问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于DeGroot式动态的信念聚合理论，将市场参与者分为坚信者、怀疑者和跟随者三类。
AI.method: 建立数学模型，通过闭式解分析三类参与者的信念演化对均衡价值的影响。
AI.findings: 资产价值由坚信者锚定，被怀疑者稀释，并通过跟随者传播；小的组成变化可以引发大的价格变动。
AI.theory_contributions: 为无收益资产提供了一个统一的估值理论框架，超越了传统的现金流贴现和行为金融方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实证校准提供基础，为市场参与者和监管者提供可检验的启示。

title: Monetary Policy, Financial Stability, and Green Finance:Trade-offs in Renewable Energy Consumption
affiliations: Ca Foscari University of Venice

detail.title: Monetary Policy, Financial Stability, and Green Finance:Trade-offs in Renewable Energy Consumption
detail.abstract: This study examines the dynamic interactions among U.S. monetary policy (Federal Funds Rate), financial stability measures (Volatility Index, Economic Policy Uncertainty), macroeconomic variables (inflation, unemployment), and renewable energy consumption over January 1990–June 2025. Employing a vector autoregression (VAR) model, we identify contractionary monetary shocks that trigger short-term declines in renewable energy consumption (peaking at -0.50% after one month), while reducing volatility (-0.45 points) and inflation (-0.22% after six months)—revealing trade-offs where inflation and market stabilization raise green investment financing costs. Robustness tests affirm persistent negative impulses, softened by financial development. Extending green finance literature (e.g., Huang et al., 2025; Liu et al., 2025), our results highlight central bank dilemmas in sustainability, proposing alignments via targeted monetary instruments.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用VAR模型分析美联储货币政策、金融稳定性、宏观经济变量与可再生能消费的动态关系，发现紧缩货币政策导致可再生能消费瞬时下降，但能降低通胀和市场波动，揭示了绿色投资与稳定目标间的争议
AI.research_question: 美联储货币政策如何影响可再生能消费？货币政策、金融稳定性和宏观经济变量之间存在怎样的动态关系？
AI.motivation: 理解货币政策在促进绿色转型中的作用，探索稳定物价与支持可再生能发展之间的潜在争议
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于绿色金融文献（如Huang et al., 2025; Liu et al., 2025），采用货币政策传导机制理论，分析货币政策对绿色投资的影响途径
AI.method: 采用向量自回归（VAR）模型，分析1990年1月至2025年6月的美国数据，包括联邦基金利率、波动指数、经济政策不确定性、通胀率、失业率和可再生能消费
AI.findings: 收紧货币政策冲击导致可再生能消费瞬时下降（一个月后达到-0.50%），但能降低波动指数（-0.45点）和通胀率（六个月后-0.22%），且质强性测试确认了持续的负面冲击
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了绿色金融文献，揭示了中央银行在美能稳定与可持续发展之间的两难困境，为货币政策与绿色转型的关系提供理论支撑
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了实证依据，建议通过有针对性的货币工具来协调稳定物价与支持可再生能发展的目标，金融发展能够轻化货币政策的负面影响

title: Place-Based Green Industrial Policies and Labor Markets Expectations
affiliations: University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign - Department of Economics, Department of Economics, Santa Clara University and Government of Canada - Bank of Canada

detail.title: Place-Based Green Industrial Policies and Labor Markets Expectations
detail.abstract: Despite their growing use, little is known about how place-based policies shape expectations. We provide causal evidence that such policies influence labor market beliefs and behaviors. Using geographically targeted surveys with randomized information treatments, we show that localized policy, particularly the Energy Community Bonus Credit, significantly improves labor market outlooks, raising expected earnings growth and increasing job-search effort among the unemployed. National policy alone has limited effects. These positive responses are dampened among Republican respondents and those anticipating policy reversal. Our findings highlight the importance of localized policy design, perceived credibility, and political context in shaping responses to place-based policies.

AI.tldr: 本文通过地理定位调查和随机信息干预，发现地方性政策（特别是能源社区奖金抵免）能显著改善劳动力市场预期，提高预期收入增长和失业者的求职努力，而国家政策效果有限。共和党受访者和预期政策逆转者的积极反应较弱。
AI.research_question: 地方性政策如何影响劳动力市场的预期和行为？
AI.motivation: 尽管地方性政策使用日益增多，但对其如何塑造预期知之甚少，需要提供因果证据来理解这类政策对劳动力市场信念和行为的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于政策可信度理论和政治经济学框架，探讨地方性政策设计、感知可信度和政治背景对政策响应的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用地理定位调查与随机信息干预的实验设计，比较地方性政策（能源社区奖金抵免）与国家政策对劳动力市场预期和行为的不同影响。
AI.findings: 地方性政策显著改善劳动力市场前景，提高预期收入增长和失业者求职努力；国家政策效果有限；共和党受访者和预期政策逆转者的积极反应较弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对地方性政策作用机制的理解，强调了政策设计本地化、感知可信度和政治背景在政策响应中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了优化地方性政策设计的实证依据，建议关注政策可信度和政治环境以提高政策有效性。

title: The Impact of Human Capital Development on the Under-5 Mortality Rate in South Africa
affiliations: Nelson Mandela University

detail.title: The Impact of Human Capital Development on the Under-5 Mortality Rate in South Africa

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There no conflicts of interest in the study.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was acquired for the study.

detail.abstract: While many scholars argue that education plays a significant role in promoting human capital development evidence suggest that South Africa's human capital index is relatively lower than other countries (0.4 in 2020) as the nation is still making strides in boosting its childhood environment and this is seen in its under-5 mortality rate (U5MR) which has increased enormously between 2020 and 2022 from 29 to 40 deaths per 1000 live births. The study examined the impact of human capital development on U5MR in South Africa using time series data spanning from 1994 to 2023. The Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) method was utilised to investigate the longrun correlation between U5MR and explanatory variables, namely female literacy (FL), health access and quality (HAQ), child immunisation rate (CIR), access to improved sanitation and clean water (ISW) and prevalence of HIV/AIDS (POH) in South Africa. The analysis reveals that FL, HAQ and CIR have an insignificant correlation with U5MR. Furthermore, the analysis shows a positive correlation between ISW and U5MR and a negative correlation between POH and U5MR in the nation. This study, therefore, recommends the SBCATP strategies by the health facilities to reduce under-5 mortality in local and international contexts.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文研究了南非人力资本发展对小于5岁儿童死亡率的影响，发现女性语文识字率、健康服务质量和儿童免疫率与死亡率关联性不显著，改善环境卫生与死亡率正相关，而艾滋病普及率与死亡率负相关。
AI.research_question: 南非人力资本发展对小于5岁儿童死亡率的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 南非人力资本指数较低(0.4)，小于5岁儿童死亡率在2020-2022年间从29升至40/千活产儿，需要研究其人力资本因素的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本发展理论，重点考察教育、健康服务等因素对儿童死亡率的作用
AI.method: 使用1994-2023年时间序列数据，采用普通最小二乘法(OLS)分析长期相关性，解释变量包括女性语文识字率、健康访问质量、儿童免疫率、改善环境卫生和清洁水访问、艾滋病普及率
AI.findings: 女性语文识字率、健康服务质量和儿童免疫率与死亡率的相关性不显著；改善环境卫生与死亡率呈正相关；艾滋病普及率与死亡率呈负相关
AI.theory_contributions: 对人力资本发展理论在南非的应用提供了实证支撑，发现了不同因素对儿童死亡率的异质性影响
AI.practical_contributions: 建议采用SBCATP策略来降低小于5岁儿童死亡率，为南非和国际健康政策提供参考

title: Trade, Voting, and Firm Policies: Theory and Evidence
affiliations: University of California, Irvine, University of California, Santa Cruz - Department of Economics, University of Stavanger and University of Stavanger

detail.title: Trade, Voting, and Firm Policies: Theory and Evidence
detail.abstract: We model how shareholder trading and voting interact when firm policies generate externalities over which investors have heterogeneous preferences, and we test our model’s equilibrium predictions in the laboratory. The model suggests, and laboratory results confirm, that low policy costs favor policy adoption while intermediate costs lead to a lower policy adoption rate under dispersed preferences than under polarized preferences. Observed share prices are higher than equilibrium predictions when the policy is adopted and are close to the fundamental value of the firm had the policy not been adopted. We conclude that the adoption of costly policies with externalities may be less burdensome to shareholders than predicted.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文通过实验室实验模型研究了股东交易和投票如何互动影响具有外部性的企业政策采纳。发现中等成本时分散偏好会导致政策采纳率更低，而实际股价高于理论预测，表明外部性政策的成本可能比预期轻微。
AI.research_question: 股东交易和投票如何互动影响具有外部性的企业政策的采纳决策？
AI.motivation: 研究股东偏好异质性下政策外部性对企业政策选择的影响，理解市场机制如何调节不同股东群体的利益冲突
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于游戏理论的股东交易与投票互动模型，考虑政策外部性和投资者偏好异质性
AI.method: 实验室实验法，通过控制环境测试模型的均衡预测
AI.findings: 低政策成本利于政策采纳；中等成本时分散偏好会导致比两极化偏好更低的政策采纳率；实际股价高于理论预测
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了考虑股东偏好异质性和政策外部性的交易-投票互动模型，扩展了企业政策决策理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和投资者提供了关于外部性政策成本实际影响的实证见解，有助于更好地预测政策采纳的股价反应

title: Exploring the Growth Value Equity Valuation Model with Data Visualization
affiliations: Chung Hua University

detail.title: Exploring the Growth Value Equity Valuation Model with Data Visualization
detail.abstract: The Growth Value Model (GVM) proposed theoretical closed form formulas consisting of Return on Equity (ROE) and the Price-to-Book value ratio (P/B) for fair stock prices and expected rates of return. Although regression analysis can be employed to verify these theoretical closed form formulas, they cannot be explored by classical quintile or decile sorting approaches with intuition due to the essence of multi-factors and dynamical processes. This article uses visualization techniques to help intuitively explore GVM. The discerning findings and contributions of this paper is that we put forward the concept of the smart frontier, which can be regarded as the reasonable lower limit of P/B at a specific ROE by exploring fair P/B with ROE-P/B 2D dynamical process visualization. The coefficients in the formula can be determined by the quantile regression analysis with market data. The moving paths of the ROE and P/B in the current quarter and the subsequent quarters show that the portfolios at the lower right of the curve approaches this curve and stagnates here after the portfolios are formed. Furthermore, exploring expected rates of return with ROE-P/B-Return 3D dynamical process visualization, the results show that the data outside of the lower right edge of the "smart frontier" has positive quarterly return rates not only in the t+1 quarter but also in the t+2 quarter. The farther away the data in the t quarter is from the "smart frontier", the larger the return rates in the t+1 and t+2 quarter.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文通过可视化技术探索增长价值模型(GVM)，提出了"u667au80fduu8fb9u754c"概u5ff5，作为特定ROE下P/B比率的合理下限，并发现距离该边界越远的股票在未来季度越有更高的回报率。
AI.research_question: 如何通过可视化技术直观地探索增长价值模型(GVM)的理论公式，并识别股票市场中的投资机会？
AI.motivation: 经典的五分位或十分位排序方法无法有效分析GVM模型的多因子和动态特性，需要新方法来直观探索理论公式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 增长价值模型(GVM)，基于股权回报率(ROE)和市净率(P/B)的关系，推导出了公平股价和预期收益率的闭式解公式。
AI.method: 采用ROE-P/B 2D动态过程可视化和ROE-P/B-Return 3D动态过程可视化技术，结合分位数回归分析来确定模型系数。
AI.findings: 提出了"u667au80fduu8fb9u754c"概u5ff5，作为特定ROE下P/B的合理下限；识别出距离该边界较远的股票在t+1和t+2季度都有正回抦，距离越远收益率越高。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"u667au80fduu8fb9u754c"新概u5ff5，为GVM模型提供了新的理论视角和验证方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了一种新的股票评估工具，能够识别市场中被低估的投资机会，并预测未来收益潜力。

title: Deep Convolutional Graph Attention Transformer Approach for Point Cloud Registration
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and JSS University

detail.title: Deep Convolutional Graph Attention Transformer Approach for Point Cloud Registration
detail.abstract: Point cloud registration is a crucial process in computer vision and 3D modeling, aligning multiple point clouds to create unified models for applications such as 3D reconstruction, autonomous navigation, and augmented reality. Challenges arise from large-scale data, noise, incomplete information, occlusions, varying densities, and sensor inaccuracies, which hinder accurate alignment. To address these issues, the Adaptive Pied Kingfisher Deep Convolutional Graph Attention Transformer model is proposed for effective alignment of two-point clouds. The model incorporates a transformer with an attention mechanism to capture variations in surface normals, enhancing feature representation and alignment accuracy. The Adaptive Pied Kingfisher Optimizer is utilized to minimize the loss function, fine-tuning parameters to ensure efficient convergence and improved training stability. A Geometric Consistency and Confidence Estimation method is introduced to assess spatial consistency and inlier confidence using a triangulated descriptor, ensuring precise geometric alignment and reliable correspondence estimation. Extensive evaluations are conducted on the ModelNet40 dataset. The results demonstrate that the proposed approach is robust to arbitrary initial positions and achieves superior registration accuracy compared to existing techniques while maintaining low network complexity.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种基于Transformer和深度学习的点云注册方法，通过结合注意机制、自适应优化器和几何一致性检验，在ModelNet40数据集上实现了更高的注册精度和稳定性。
AI.research_question: 如何有效解决大规模点云数据的注册问题，应对噪声、不完整信息、遮挡等挑战，提高对齐精度和稳定性？
AI.motivation: 点云注册在3D重建、自主导航、增强现实等领域具有重要作用，但现有方法面临大规模数据、噪声、不完整性等挑战，导致对齐精度不足和稳定性低的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Transformer注意机制、深度卷积图注意网络、自适应优化算法和几何一致性检验理论，构建了一种结合深度学习和传统几何处理的点云注册框架。
AI.method: 提出Adaptive Pied Kingfisher Deep Convolutional Graph Attention Transformer模型，包含三个核心组件：1）使用注意机制的Transformer捕捉表面法向变化；2）采用自适应优化器最小化损失函数；3）引入几何一致性和置信度估计方法确保精确对齐。在ModelNet40数据集进行实验评估。
AI.findings: 实验结果显示，该方法能够承受任意初始位置，在注册精度方面超过现有技术，同时保持低网络复杂度，实现了更好的训练稳定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了一种新的深度学习基于点云注册框架；2）将Transformer注意机制与几何对齐相结合；3）引入自适应优化算法提高训练效率。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提供了一种更精确稳定的点云注册方案；2）在多种应用场景中具有实际价值；3）网络复杂度低，更容易部署实际系统。

title: Migrating For Freedom: Examining Effects of Economic Freedom Indices and Their Constituent Components on US State Immigrant Inflows
affiliations: University of Dallas - Department of Economics

detail.title: Migrating For Freedom: Examining Effects of Economic Freedom Indices and Their Constituent Components on US State Immigrant Inflows
detail.abstract: Economists find that foreign-born immigrants migrate to areas with favorable economic conditions and labor markets, and that immigration is associated with positive economic outcomes in the aggregate. Strong economic and labor market institutions also correlate with positive economic outcomes. This paper investigates how state-level economic and labor market freedoms shape the inflow of both unauthorized and legal foreign-born immigrants within the United States. By constructing an annual panel dataset of immigrant stocks spanning 1990-2022 for most models, I estimate economic, labor market, and unionization effects on immigration inflows using an Error Correction Model (ECM) with two-way fixed effects, which allows for the disentanglement of short and long-run effects. Results show that labor market freedoms are positively associated with long-run unauthorized immigration inflows, but that the relationship is driven almost entirely by unionization. Specifically, a one percentage point increase in state union density is associated with an estimated average 13.2 percent decline in the long-run equilibrium share of unauthorized immigrants relative to natives. Disaggregated analysis reveals that this effect is concentrated in private-sector manufacturing unions. In contrast, legal foreign-born immigrants exhibit little sensitivity to state-level economic and labor freedoms. Overall, these findings highlight the importance of labor market institutions-particularly unionization-in shaping unauthorized immigration flows.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，劳动力市场自由（特别是工会化程度）对非法移民流入有显著影响，州工会密度每增加1个百分点会导致非法移民相对比例长期下降13.2%，而合法移民对这些因素不敏感。
AI.research_question: 州级经济和劳动力市场自由如何影响美国境内非法和合法外国出生移民的流入？
AI.motivation: 虽然经济学家发现移民倾向于流向经济条件良好的地区，且移民总体上与积极经济结果相关，但具体制度因素（特别是劳动力市场制度）对移民流向的影响尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于移民经济学和劳动力市场制度理论，探讨经济自由、劳动力市场自由和工会化对移民决策的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用1990-2022年年度面板数据，采用误差修正模型（ECM）和双向固定效应，区分短期和长期效应。
AI.findings: 劳动力市场自由与长期非法移民流入正相关，但这种关系几乎完全由工会化驱动；工会密度增加1%导致非法移民相对比例长期下降13.2%；这种效应集中在私营制造业工会；合法移民对州级经济自由不敏感。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了工会化作为重要劳动力市场制度对非法移民流动的抑制作用，丰富了移民经济学中制度因素的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于劳动力市场制度（特别是工会政策）如何影响非法移民流动的实证依据，有助于制定更有效的移民管理政策。

title: Taming the LLMaaS Market: A Decision-Making Framework Utilizing Diverse Enterprise-Critical Selection Factors
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Taming the LLMaaS Market: A Decision-Making Framework Utilizing Diverse Enterprise-Critical Selection Factors
detail.abstract: The rapid emergence of Large Language Models-as-a-Service (LLMaaS) has redefined the enterprise AI landscape, enabling organizations to access state-of-the-art foundation models through scalable, pay-as-you-go cloud offerings. Although this paradigm significantly reduces barriers to AI adoption, the LLMaaS market remains highly dynamic and is still in its early stages of development. New bundles, varying in architecture, capability, and pricing, are introduced at an accelerating pace by major cloud providers such as Amazon, Microsoft, and Google. Enterprises face a complex and fragmented decision space shaped by diverse pricing structures, performance guarantees, reasoning capabilities, and data governance levels, making it difficult to navigate the multidimensional trade-offs involved. This paper introduces a two-stage decision-making framework that aims to simplify the LLMaaS selection process. It is designed to combine diverse enterprise-critical selection factors, often contradicting each other: Price, Operation Speed, Intelligence, and Data Governance. Each of these factors is combined as a different pillar in a comprehensive taxonomy, used at the first stage to cluster LLMaaS bundles based on their specific features.In the second stage, a user-guided mechanism enables practitioners to filter and shortlist bundles according to their selection priorities by combing different pillars.  The framework is implemented using an interactive prototype, while its applicability is validated through a voice-assistant case study. Results reveal market trends and demonstrate how the proposed framework streamlines product selection, enabling informed, scalable, and context-aware LLMaaS adoption.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个两阶段决策框架，用于简化企业选择大语言模型作为服务（LLMaaS）的复杂过程，通过综合考虑价格、运行速度、智能水平和数据管理等多维因素，帮助企业更有效地选择适合的LLMaaS套餐。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个系统化的决策框架来简化企业选择LLMaaS的复杂过程？
AI.motivation: 随着主要云服务商不断推出新的LLMaaS套餐，企业面临着复杂而分散的决策空间，需要综合考虑多样化的价格结构、性能保证、推理能力和数据管理水平，这使得多维度批搏成为一项挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 两阶段决策框架：第一阶段通过综合分类学将LLMaaS套餐按特征分组；第二阶段通过用户导向机制让实践者根据选择优先级过滤和短列套餐。
AI.method: 开发互动式原型来实现框架，并通过语音助手案例研究验证其可用性。
AI.findings: 结果揭示了市场趋势，并证明了所提出的框架能够流程化产品选择，使得LLMaaS采用更加明智、可扩展且能够根据上下文做出决策。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个统一的理论框架来结构化LLMaaS选择问题，将多个相互冲突的企业关键因素（价格、速度、智能、数据管理）结合到一个综合性的分类体系中。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了一个可操作的互动式工具，能够帮助企业实践者在复杂的LLMaaS市场中更有效地迅速选择适合的解决方案，提高决策效率和减少采用风险。

title: GENERATIVE AI AND THE UNEVEN DISRUPTION OF FREELANCE LABOR: EXPOSURE, DIFFUSION, AND ADAPTATION UNDER CONSTRAINT
affiliations: National Research University Higher School of Economics (Moscow) and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: GENERATIVE AI AND THE UNEVEN DISRUPTION OF FREELANCE LABOR: EXPOSURE, DIFFUSION, AND ADAPTATION UNDER CONSTRAINT
detail.abstract: The rapid diffusion of generative artificial intelligence (AI) has sparked debate over its labor market impact, particularly in freelance economies where work is task-based, digitally mediated, and often automatable. While recent studies document substantial short-term effects in Western markets, little is known about how these dynamics play out in structurally constrained economies. Most existing analyses focus on English-speaking platforms operating in fully enabled AI environments, leaving uncertain whether exposure-based disruption models apply where access, infrastructure, and language create barriers to adoption. This study examines the Russian freelance economy—one of the largest non-Western markets, yet operating under sanctions, restricted access to leading AI tools, and reliance on domestic alternatives. Integrating task-based exposure theory, technology diffusion theory, and research on human–AI complementarity, we analyze transaction-level data from 1,776 freelancers across six occupational groups, tracking changes in order volume and income surrounding a peak of ChatGPT’s public popularity in February 2023. Results reveal sectorally uneven disruption: early shocks in high-exposure fields, lagged effects where diffusion was delayed, and heterogeneous income trajectories shaped by adaptation strategies. We formalize these patterns into a triadic framework that refines exposure-based models and offers a context-sensitive lens for AI’s labor effects in digitally peripheral economies.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨生成式AI在俄罗斯自由职业经济中的劳动力市场影响，发现在制裁限制和基础设施障碍下，AI的影响呈现部门异质性：高暴露领域早期受冲击，扩散延迟领域滞后效应，收入轨迹因适应策略而异。
AI.research_question: 生成式人工智能在结构性约束经济（如俄罗斯）的自由职业市场中如何影响劳动力市场结果？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注西方市场和完全开放的AI环境，缺乏对结构性约束经济中AI影响的理解，特别是在制裁限制、基础设施障碍和语言障碍的情况下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 任务暴露理论、技术扩散理论、人机互补性研究
AI.method: 分析1,776名自由职业者在6个职业群体中的交易级数据，追踪2023年2月ChatGPT流行高峰前后的订单量和收入变化
AI.findings: 发现部门异质性影响：高暴露领域早期受冲击，扩散延迟领域滞后效应，收入轨迹因适应策略而异
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个三元框架，完善了基于暴露的模型，为数字边缘经济中AI的劳动力影响提供了情境敏感的分析视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和平台运营商提供了在结构性约束环境中应对AI影响的实践指导

reference: Indian Law Review 2025
title: Examining Individual Sanctions for Cartels Under Indian Antitrust Law -Exploring Possibilities Within Corporate Law for Effective Deterrence
affiliations: NLSIU and Institute of Law, Nirma University

detail.title: Examining Individual Sanctions for Cartels Under Indian Antitrust Law -Exploring Possibilities Within Corporate Law for Effective Deterrence
detail.abstract: A review of the cartel cases decided by the Competition Commission of India between 2009-2024 reveals that in majority of cases, the directors or key managerial personnel of the company have been closely involved in effecting the cartel arrangement. While the CCI has used relevant statutory provisions to indict these individuals, the sanctioning mechanism has been largely inadequate. Due to this inadequacy and inconsistency, the CCI fails to create adequate deterrence for individuals. The authors also explore the possibility of employing corporate law to address the issue. Accordingly, the authors make specific references to the duties of directors and disqualification provisions under the Indian Companies Act, 2013. Through a comparative study on the director disqualification regime of CMA-UK, the authors argue in favour of providing CCI with similar powers or strengthening the company law to ensure that the indicted individuals are kept away from running the company.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了印度竞争委员会2009-2024年卡特尔案件，发现多数案件中公司董事或关键管理人员深度参与卡特尔安排，但制裁机制不足导致个人威慑力不够。作者建议借鉴英国竞争与市场管理局的经验，通过公司法强化董事职责和取消资格条款来有效约束违法个人。
AI.research_question: 印度竞争委员会在卡特尔案件中针对个人的制裁机制为何不足，以及如何通过公司法手段强化对违法个人的约束和威慑？
AI.motivation: 印度竞争委员会处理卡特尔案件时发现，虽然能够认定董事和关键管理人员的责任，但现有的制裁机制无法有效威慑个人违法行为，导致卡特尔行为屡禁不止。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于竞争法和公司法的交叉理论框架，探讨个人责任认定与制裁机制的有效性，以及不同法律领域协同治理的可能性。
AI.method: 采用案例分析法，系统梳理印度竞争委员会2009-2024年卡特尔案件裁决，并进行印度与英国公司法制度的比较研究。
AI.findings: 多数卡特尔案件中董事和关键管理人员深度参与，但现有制裁机制不足，无法有效威慑个人；英国CMA的董事取消资格制度提供了可借鉴的经验。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了竞争法与公司法协同治理的理论框架，丰富了个人责任在反垄断执法中的理论探讨。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度竞争委员会提供了具体的制度改进建议，包括强化公司法中的董事职责和取消资格条款，或赋予竞争委员会类似英国CMA的权力。

title: The Impact of Clawback Provision on Cash Valuation
affiliations: University of Manitoba, University of South Alabama, University of British Columbia Okanagan, University of Manitoba and Arkansas State University - College of Business

detail.title: The Impact of Clawback Provision on Cash Valuation
detail.abstract: The clawback provision is designed to curb incentives for fraudulent reporting and enhance the quality of financial disclosures. Firms that adopt clawback provisions in their proxy statements exhibit significantly lower information asymmetry between managers and investors. We show that as information asymmetry declines, investors assign greater value to cash holdings in firms with clawback provisions compared to those without. Consistent with the free cash flow theory, the improved transparency reduces agency costs, thereby increasing the marginal value of cash. Moreover, the positive valuation effect is particularly pronounced for firms that adopted clawback provisions following a history of financial restatements, compared to firms that implemented clawbacks without such a history.

AI.tldr: 企业采用追回条款能降低信息不对称，提高现金持有的边际价值，特别是对曾有财务重述历史的企业效果更显著
AI.research_question: 追回条款如何影响企业现金持有的市场估值？
AI.motivation: 追回条款旨在抑制欺诈性报告动机并提高财务披露质量，但其对现金价值评估的具体影响机制尚不明确
AI.theoretical_framework: 自由现金流理论、代理成本理论、信息不对称理论
AI.method: 实证分析，比较采用与未采用追回条款企业的信息不对称程度和现金估值差异
AI.findings: 采用追回条款的企业信息不对称显著降低，投资者对其现金持有赋予更高价值；曾有财务重述历史的企业采用追回条款后现金估值提升更明显
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了追回条款经济后果的理论研究，验证了信息透明度通过降低代理成本来提升现金价值的机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业治理机制设计提供实证依据，帮助投资者更好地评估采用追回条款企业的现金价值

title: A New Method for Valuing Nontraditional Stakeholder Parameters in Power Systems Analysis
affiliations: Tarleton State University, University of Duisburg-Essen - Department of Energy, University of Duisburg-Essen - Department of Energy, National Renewable Energy Laboratory, Electric Power Research Institute and National Renewable Energy Laboratory

detail.title: A New Method for Valuing Nontraditional Stakeholder Parameters in Power Systems Analysis
detail.abstract: Decision makers need more accurate valuation metrics for communicating the value of electricity generation assets (GA). Markets, social activism, viewshed, and environmental initiatives have changed GA performance dimensions. Traditional valuation calculations used for comparing GAs, like the Levelized Cost of Electricity (LCOE), do not account for many of these factors or dynamic market conditions now dominating the industry. A dynamic Levelized Cost of Electricity (d-LCOE) is presented that integrates these new factors when calculating the costs of GAs.  Factors are added to the traditional LCOE in a manner maintaining technology agnostic features allowing ‘apples to apples’ comparisons between different types of GA.  Additional simulations and forecasts highlight that cost metrics, like the LCOE, can occlude the profitable operation of a GA. While the d-LCOE allows more accurate cost estimations for decision makers, profitability metrics of Net Present Value (NPV) or Internal Rate of Return (IRR) better represent the economic sustainability of a GA. By aggregating factors into costs and revenues, a generic valuation framework is proposed to compare different technologies in situations where nontraditional inputs can be considered by decisionmakers for financing power generation. With these metrics, coal fired boiler systems were found to operate at a 50% loss in markets rich in renewable intermittent GA assets. Forecasts indicate that increasing the ramp rate for the GA can recover upt to 50% of lost revenues.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文提出了动态平均电力成本（d-LCOE）方法，以更准确评估电力生产资产价值，考虑了市场、环境等新因素，并发现传统成本指标可能隐藏资产的盈利能力。
AI.research_question: 如何更准确地评估电力生产资产的价值？传统平均电力成本（LCOE）指标在当今动态市场环境下的局限性是什么？
AI.motivation: 电力生产资产评估需要考虑市场、社会活动、视野效应和环境创新等多维度因素，传统LCOE方法无法涵盖这些动态条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资产评估理论和成本收益分析框架，扩展传统LCOE模型以包含多元因素。
AI.method: 提出动态LCOE（d-LCOE）方法，在保持技术中立性的同时集成新因素，并进行模拟预测和收益分析。
AI.findings: 传统成本指标可能隐藏资产的盈利能力；在可再生能源丰富的市场中，煤炭发电系统可能业业50%亏损；提高资产调度速度可回收20-50%丢失收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了动态LCOE理论框架，为电力资产评估提供更全面的分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和决策者提供更准确的资产价值评估方法，有助于优化电力生产资产的经济绩效。

title: The Effect of Sibling Gender Composition on Women’s Education and Occupational Choice
affiliations: Independent Researcher, University of Dundee School of Business and University of Dundee School of Business

detail.title: The Effect of Sibling Gender Composition on Women’s Education and Occupational Choice
detail.abstract: This paper investigates how sibling gender composition affects women's educational attainment and occupational choice. Using data from the China Household Income Project survey, we estimate the impact, for first-born women, of having a second-born brother relative to those with a second-born sister. Given supportive evidence from the literature and our data, we identify a period (1963 to 1978) where the gender of the second child given the first child's gender is as good as random as it is not yet affected by selective abortion or other drivers of gender imbalance. The results show that having a second-born brother is beneficial to first-born women's educational attainment. However, other elements such as gender norms appear reinforced by having a brother: in the labour market, first-born women with a second-born brother are less likely to choose a male-dominated occupation, which on average carries a higher wage.

AI.tldr: 本文研究兄弟姐妹性别构成对女性教育程度和职业选择的影响，发现拥有弟弟对姐姐的教育有积极影响，但会强化性别规范，导致姐姐更少选择高薪的男性主导职业。
AI.research_question: 兄弟姐妹性别构成如何影响女性的教育获得和职业选择？
AI.motivation: 探讨家庭内部性别构成对女性人力资本积累和职业发展的影响机制
AI.theoretical_framework: 家庭资源分配理论、性别角色社会化理论、人力资本理论
AI.method: 利用中国家庭收入调查数据，采用准实验设计，选取1963-1978年出生队列（二胎性别近似随机分配），比较有弟弟和有妹妹的首胎女性的教育程度和职业选择差异
AI.findings: 1) 拥有弟弟对首胎女性的教育获得有积极影响；2) 但拥有弟弟会强化性别规范，使首胎女性更少选择男性主导的高薪职业
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了兄弟姐妹性别构成通过资源分配和性别社会化两条路径对女性发展的复杂影响机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解家庭内部性别互动对女性职业发展的影响提供实证依据，对促进性别平等政策制定有参考价值

title: Climate Disaster, Corporate Cross-regional Investment and Cost of Debt Financing: Evidence from China
affiliations: Changsha University of Science and Technology, Changsha University of Science and Technology and University of Northern British Columbia

detail.title: Climate Disaster, Corporate Cross-regional Investment and Cost of Debt Financing: Evidence from China
detail.abstract: With the accumulation of climate risk, the frequency and intensity of extreme climate disaster events have continued to rise, making them a critical factor for creditors in assessing borrowers’ risk during debt financing. In this study, we test and find evidence that such climate disaster shocks meaningfully adversely affect the firm’s cost of debt financing. Furthermore, we show that firms with low-climate-risk cross-regional subsidiaries (LCSs) are better able to hedge against the adverse impact of climate disasters, thereby mitigating the increase in debt financing costs. These results hold using multiple approaches (difference-in-differences design and instrumental variable approach) that control for the endogeneity of relationships. Cross-sectional analyses further reveal heterogeneity in the effects depending on the intensity of climate disasters, the marketization degree of the financial sector, the proportion of fixed asset ratio, and the nature of ultimate controller. Collectively, our results highlight the detrimental financial consequences of climate disasters for firms and offer a risk-hedging perspective to explain the strategic rationale behind cross-regional investment decisions.

AI.tldr: 气候灾害显著增加企业债务融资成本，但拥有低气候风险跨区域子公司的企业能够对冲这种负面影响
AI.research_question: 气候灾害如何影响企业债务融资成本？跨区域子公司是否能够对冲这种影响？
AI.motivation: 随着气候风险积累，极端气候灾害事件频发加剧，成为债权人评估借款人风险的关键因素
AI.theoretical_framework: 气候风险与债务融资成本关系理论，风险对冲理论，跨区域投资战略理论
AI.method: 双重差分设计（DID）和工具变量方法，控制内生性问题
AI.findings: 气候灾害显著提高企业债务融资成本；拥有低气候风险跨区域子公司的企业能够有效对冲这种负面影响
AI.theory_contributions: 从风险对冲角度解释跨区域投资战略的理论依据，拓展了气候风险对融资成本影响的研究
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业应对气候风险提供战略指导，为债权人风险评估提供新视角，为政策制定者提供参考

title: Naïve and Optimal Portfolios Reconciled: A Golden Criterion and Adaptive Shrinkage Combination Strategy
affiliations: Academy of Mathematics and Systems Science, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS) - Academy of Mathematics and Systems Science (AMSS), Academy of Mathematics and Systems Science, Chinese Academy of Sciences and University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

detail.title: Naïve and Optimal Portfolios Reconciled: A Golden Criterion and Adaptive Shrinkage Combination Strategy
detail.abstract: Equal-weight (“naïve”) portfolio strategies (often dismissed as simple heuristics) frequently outperform statistically optimized allocations in out-of-sample tests, challenging both finance theory and decision analysis. Practitioners value their stability and ease of implementation, while academic optimization approaches often yield concentrated, less investable portfolios. We reconcile these divergent human decision paradigms (heuristic versus statistically optimal) by deriving a necessary and sufficient condition, the “Golden Criterion”, under which equal weighting is not merely robust but the theoretically optimal minimum–variance choice. Specifically, if the covariance matrix of the returns in a portfolio in either the initial estimation or the adaptive adjustment stage admits an  eigenvector with all elements being identical, naïve allocation equals the optimal solution. We extend this insight with an adaptive two-stage strategy that blends optimal and naïve weights via a data-driven shrinkage parameter, explicitly balancing forecast diversity and precision. Applied to thirteen macro-financial predictors and monthly S&P 500 excess returns (1996–2019), the method achieves R² values up to 40.53%, utility gains exceeding 200 basis points, and Sharpe ratio improvements to 1.06. The shrinkage parameter consistently exceeds 0.5, indicating that diversity often dominates precision in real markets. Our results formally rationalize a widely-used heuristic, show how optimality can coexist with simplicity, and highlight a decision-making principle that supports stable, broadly diversified, and practically implementable investment policies. For practitioners, simple rules can be optimal in the right conditions, and blending them with optimization can improve results without sacrificing stability or practicality.

AI.tldr: 本文通过推导"黄金准则"证明在特定条件下等权重投资组合不仅稳健而且是理论最优的最小方差选择，并提出两阶段自适应策略将最优权重与朴素权重结合，在实证中获得了优异的投资表现。
AI.research_question: 在什么条件下等权重（朴素）投资组合策略不仅是稳健的，而且是理论最优的最小方差选择？如何将启发式方法与统计优化方法有效结合？
AI.motivation: 实践中等权重策略经常在样本外测试中优于统计优化配置，这挑战了金融理论和决策分析。从业者重视其稳定性和易实施性，而学术优化方法往往产生集中、难以投资的组合。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于投资组合理论的最小方差优化框架，引入"黄金准则"作为等权重最优性的充要条件，构建两阶段自适应权重调整模型。
AI.method: 推导等权重最优性的数学条件，提出基于数据驱动收缩参数的两阶段策略，应用于13个宏观金融预测因子和标普500超额收益（1996-2019）进行实证检验。
AI.findings: 方法实现R²高达40.53%，效用增益超过200个基点，夏普比率提升至1.06。收缩参数持续超过0.5，表明在真实市场中多样性往往主导精确性。
AI.theory_contributions: 正式合理化广泛使用的启发式方法，证明最优性与简单性可以共存，提出了支持稳定、广泛分散且实际可实施投资策略的决策原则。
AI.practical_contributions: 为从业者提供理论指导：简单规则在适当条件下可以是最优的，将其与优化方法结合可以在不牺牲稳定性或实用性的情况下改善结果。

title: Pfizer Inc.: A Strategic and Financial Analysis of a Global Pharmaceutical Leader
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Pfizer Inc.: A Strategic and Financial Analysis of a Global Pharmaceutical Leader
detail.abstract: This study explores Pfizer Inc., one of the world's most recognized pharmaceutical companies, with a focus on its strategies, financial health, and future prospects. The global pharmaceutical industry continues to grow, shaped by advances in technology, strict regulatory requirements, and lessons learned from the COVID-19 pandemic. Using Porter's Five Forces, the study shows how Pfizer operates in a highly competitive environment where patents, buyer preferences, and substitutes like herbal and alternative medicines play a key role. The company profile highlights its strengths, such as heavy investment in research and development and a broad product range, alongside challenges including lawsuits, supply chain issues, and weak demand forecasting. A review of financial statements reveals declining revenue and higher liabilities due to acquisitions, yet steady asset growth and reliable dividend payouts provide stability. While short-term ratios show pressure on profitability and liquidity, Pfizer's focus on oncology, vaccines, and emerging markets signals promising growth opportunities. Overall, the findings suggest that despite present challenges, Pfizer's innovative pipeline, global partnerships, and commitment to research position it strongly for long-term success, making it a sound choice for sustained investment.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了辉瑞公司的战略、财务状况和未来前景，发现尽管面临收入下降和短期财务压力，但其强大的研发投入、创新产品线和全球合作使其具备长期成功潜力。
AI.research_question: 辉瑞公司在全球制药行业中的竞争地位如何？其财务健康状况和未来增长前景如何？
AI.motivation: 全球制药行业在技术进步、严格监管和COVID-19大流行经验的影响下持续发展，需要深入分析领先企业辉瑞的战略和财务表现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 波特五力模型，用于分析辉瑞在竞争环境中的运营状况，包括专利保护、买方偏好和替代品（如草药和替代医学）的影响。
AI.method: 公司档案分析和财务报表审查，结合行业竞争环境分析。
AI.findings: 辉瑞面临收入下降和负债增加的压力，但拥有稳定的资产增长和可靠股息支付；短期盈利能力和流动性承压，但在肿瘤学、疫苗和新兴市场领域具有增长机会。
AI.theory_contributions: 应用波特五力模型验证了制药行业的高度竞争特性，揭示了专利、买方力量和替代品对行业竞争格局的关键影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供辉瑞公司的全面分析，指出其长期投资价值；为企业管理者提供战略参考，特别是在研发投入、产品多元化和全球合作方面的最佳实践。

title: Causality analysis of electricity market liberalization on electricity price using novel Machine Learning methods
affiliations: Berlin Institute of Health - Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin, School of Business and Economics, Humboldt-University of Berlin and Bucharest University of Economic Studies

detail.title: Causality analysis of electricity market liberalization on electricity price using novel Machine Learning methods
detail.abstract: Relationships between the energy and the finance markets are increasingly important. Understanding these relationships is vital for policymakers and other stakeholders as the world faces challenges such as satisfying humanity's increasing need for energy and the effects of climate change. In this paper, we investigate the causal effect of electricity market liberalization on the electricity price in the US. By performing this analysis, we aim to provide new insights into the ongoing debate about the benefits of electricity market liberalization. We introduce Causal Machine Learning as a new approach for interventions in the energy-finance field. The development of machine learning in recent years opened the door for a new branch of machine learning models for causality impact, with the ability to extract complex patterns and relationships from the data. We discuss the advantages of causal ML methods and compare the performance of ML-based models to shed light on the applicability of causal ML frameworks to energy policy intervention cases. We find that the DeepProbCP framework outperforms the other frameworks examined. In addition, we find that liberalization of, and individual players' entry to, the electricity market resulted in a 7% decrease in price in the short term.

AI.tldr: 本文使用因果机器学习方法分析美国电力市场自由化对电价的影响，发现自由化在短期内导致电价下降7%，并证明DeepProbCP框架在因果分析中表现最优
AI.research_question: 电力市场自由化对电价有何因果影响？
AI.motivation: 能源与金融市场关系日益重要，需要理解电力市场自由化的实际效果，为政策制定者提供决策依据
AI.theoretical_framework: 因果机器学习理论，特别是DeepProbCP框架
AI.method: 采用因果机器学习方法，比较多种ML模型在能源政策干预案例中的适用性
AI.findings: 电力市场自由化在短期内导致电价下降7%，DeepProbCP框架在因果分析中表现最佳
AI.theory_contributions: 将因果机器学习引入能源金融领域，为政策干预提供新的分析方法论
AI.practical_contributions: 为电力市场自由化政策提供实证支持，证明自由化能够降低电价，为政策制定者提供决策参考

title: A Study of Consumer Awareness and Satisfaction with the Unified Payments Interface (UPI)
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: A Study of Consumer Awareness and Satisfaction with the Unified Payments Interface (UPI)
detail.abstract: A survey on UPI would be a research study conducted to gather information and insights about people's experiences with the Unified Payments Interface (UPI) in India. The survey would typically involve asking a sample of UPI users a series of questions related to their usage of the payment system, including their overall satisfaction with it, the features they find most useful, any issues they have encountered while using it, and how often they use it to make transactions. The survey may also explore users' perceptions of UPI's security and the extent to which they think it has made digital payments more convenient and accessible. Additionally, the survey may seek suggestions for improving UPI and may ask users about any fraudulent activities they have experienced while using the system. The results of the survey could help identify areas of improvement for UPI and inform the development of new features to better meet users' needs.

AI.tldr: 调查印度统一支付接口（UPI）用户体验，包括满意度、功能使用、安全感知、遇到的问题和欺诈活动，以及改进建议
AI.research_question: 印度UPI用户的使用体验、满意度、遇到的挑战以及对系统改进的建议是什么？
AI.motivation: 了解UPI用户的真实体验和需求，以发现系统的优势和不足，为UPI的持续改进和发展提供数据支撑
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字支付采用理论、用户体验研究、技术接受模型（TAM）、用户满意度理论
AI.method: 量化研究方法，通过问卷调查收集UPI用户的使用数据、满意度评分、问题反馈和改进建议
AI.findings: 将揭示UPI用户的使用频率、最受欢迎功能、常见技术问题、安全感知水平、欺诈事件经历以及具体的改进需求
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富数字支付采用理论，提供发展中国家大规模支付系统用户行为的实证研究基础
AI.practical_contributions: 为UPI运营商和相关政策制定者提供具体的改进方向，促进数字支付生态系统的优化和普及，提升用户体验和安全性

title: Bi-Level Co-Optimization of Carbon Trading and Operating Costs in Multi-Market Virtual Power Plant Scheduling
affiliations: Beijing Institute of Technology, South China University of Technology, Beijing Institute of Technology, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Deakin University and Qatar University - Department of Electrical Engineering

detail.title: Bi-Level Co-Optimization of Carbon Trading and Operating Costs in Multi-Market Virtual Power Plant Scheduling
detail.abstract: This paper addresses the joint optimization scheduling problem of a virtual power plant (VPP) participating in multiple markets: energy, regulation, tradable green certificate (TGC) and carbon emissions trading (CET) markets. To do so, a bi-level optimization framework is proposed. The upperlevel realizes the VPP’s day-ahead scheduling and real-time optimization in the energy and regulation markets; whereas the lower-level estimates carbon emissions by utilizing the upper level’s VPP electricity consumption and solar power generation, achieving the VPP’s optimal monthly decision making in the TGC and CET markets. In the upper-level optimization, a diverse priority replay (DPR) sampling strategy is proposed based on the dueling double deep Q-network (Dueling-DDQN) framework. This method overcomes the limitation of traditional solvers, which tends to yield sub-optimal solutions in real-time optimization. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed Dueling-DDQN – DPR algorithm can reduce VPP operating costs by 12,079.11$/day and regulation violations by 4.69 MWh/day. At the lowerlevel, a joint trading scheme between the TGC and CET is developed and incorporated, with its impact on market participants’ operating costs analyzed. The lower-level employs the DDQN algorithm, and its effectiveness for VPP optimization is validated through comparison with the results obtained from the Gurobi solver. Through the coordination of the bi-level optimization, the VPP achieves cross-market revenue maximization and regulation violation minimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个双层优化框架来解决虚拟电厂参与多市场（能源、调节、绿证和碳交易市场）的联合优化调度问题，上层采用改进的Dueling-DDQN算法进行日前调度和实时优化，下层使用DDQN算法进行绿证和碳市场月度决策，实验证明该方法能显著降低运营成本和调节违规。
AI.research_question: 如何实现虚拟电厂在能源、调节、绿证和碳交易多个市场中的联合优化调度？
AI.motivation: 传统求解器在实时优化中容易产生次优解，且虚拟电厂参与多市场时需要协调不同时间尺度的决策问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于强化学习的双层优化框架，上层采用Dueling-DDQN算法，下层采用DDQN算法，结合多样化优先级重放采样策略。
AI.method: 提出双层优化方法：上层进行日前调度和实时市场优化，下层进行月度绿证和碳市场决策，使用强化学习算法替代传统求解器。
AI.findings: 所提方法能降低VPP运营成本12,079.11美元/天，减少调节违规4.69 MWh/天，并通过与Gurobi求解器的对比验证了有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了适用于多市场协调的双层优化理论框架，发展了基于强化学习的虚拟电厂调度方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为虚拟电厂参与多市场交易提供了实用的优化工具，能够实现跨市场收益最大化和调节违规最小化。

title: When Work Produces Utility: Challenging the Work-For-Wage Hypothesis
affiliations: University of Rome Tor Vergata - Faculty of Economics, University of Rome Tor Vergata - Faculty of Economics and NEXT Group

detail.title: When Work Produces Utility: Challenging the Work-For-Wage Hypothesis

declarations.ethicsApproval: Data of the paper come from a survey where respondents have authorized their use in anonymous form (not possible to go back to their identities)

detail.abstract: The first-year textbook version of microfunded labor supply assumes that work does not directly produce utility. Its unique role is that of yielding a wage which allows to buy consumption goods and leisure which positively contribute to utility. Econometric findings on the relationship between sense of work and life satisfaction strongly reject this hypothesis. They show that jobs that involve positive social and environmental impact, participation and sense of belonging to the organisation have a significantly higher impact on life satisfaction, net of income. On the contrary, 31 percent of survey respondents indicating that their job is only a mean to get a wage have an around 27 percent lower probability of declaring themselves very happy, net of the impact of standard controls. These results are robust to endogeneity concerns using a Generalized Structural Equation Model (GSEM), which allows for the simultaneous estimation of the relationship between job meaning and life satisfaction.

AI.tldr: 传统微观经济学认为工作不直接产生效用，但实证研究发现工作意义对生活满意度有显著影响。具有社会价值、参与感和归属感的工作能提升幸福感，而仅为了工资的工作会降低27%的幸福感概率。
AI.research_question: 工作意义是否直接影响生活满意度，而不仅仅是作为获取收入的工具？
AI.motivation: 传统微观经济学劳动供给理论假设工作本身不产生效用，但实证证据表明这一假设可能不成立，需要重新审视工作意义对幸福感的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于微观经济学劳动供给理论，但挑战其核心假设；引入工作意义、社会影响、组织归属感等非货币因素的理论框架。
AI.method: 使用广义结构方程模型（GSEM）进行实证分析，处理内生性问题，同时估计工作意义与生活满意度的关系。
AI.findings: 31%的受访者认为工作仅为获取工资，这些人自称非常幸福的概率降低约27%；具有积极社会环境影响、参与感和组织归属感的工作对生活满意度有显著正向影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统微观经济学关于工作不直接产生效用的核心假设，为劳动经济学理论提供了新的实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织管理提供启示：创造有意义的工作环境可以提升员工幸福感，而不仅仅是提高工资水平。

title: Evaluating Real Estate Development Project with Monte Carlo Based Binomial Options Pricing Model
affiliations: Chung Hua University and Thompson Rivers University

detail.title: Evaluating Real Estate Development Project with Monte Carlo Based Binomial Options Pricing Model
detail.abstract: This paper proposes three evaluation models for evaluating the value of strategic waiting of real estate development project. In Model 1, the ratio of land cost to total real estate sales in period (t) and period (t+1) is uncorrelated (random). In Model 2, the ratio is unchanged (constant). Model 3 integrates Models 1 and 2 with the "land value persistence factor". The larger the factor, the more the land cost tends to consider only the previous land price. This study uses the Binomial Option Pricing Model and Monte Carlo Simulation hybrid method to solve these three models. In addition, this research also proposes a method for estimating the net present value of project expansion on the time axis. The results show that five main factors influencing the expected value of the option value are the real estate price rate of change, present value of total real estate sales, duration, land value persistence factor, and present value of land. Regardless of the land value persistence factor, the longer the time, the expected value of the option value tends to increase. However, when the land value persistence factor is larger, the expected value of the option value increases more.

AI.tldr: 本文提出三种房地产开发项目战略等待价值评估模型，通过二项式选项定价模型和蒙特卡罗模拟混合方法进行求解，分析了五个主要因素对选项价值预期值的影响。
AI.research_question: 如何构建有效的房地产开发项目战略等待价值评估模型？哪些因素影响选项价值的预期值？
AI.motivation: 房地产开发中的战略等待选择具有重要价值，需要定量化评估模型来支撑投资决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 实际选项理论（Real Options Theory）、二项式选项定价模型（Binomial Option Pricing Model）、蒙特卡罗模拟技术
AI.method: 建立三种模型（随机模型、常数模型、集成模型），采用二项式选项定价模型与蒙特卡罗模拟的混合方法进行求解
AI.findings: 五个主要影响因素：房地产价格变化率、现值总销售额、持续时间、土地价值持续因子、土地现值。时间越长选项价值趋向增加，土地价值持续因子越大增加趋势越明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了集成随机和常数特征的土地价值持续因子模型，丰富了实际选项理论在房地产预期管理中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为房地产开发商提供了具体的战略等待价值计算方法和投资决策支撑工具

reference: FRB of Cleveland Working Paper No. 25-21; https://doi.org/10.26509/frbc-wp-202521
title: Tariffs, Stablecoins, and the Demand for Dollars
affiliations: University of Bergen and Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland

detail.title: Tariffs, Stablecoins, and the Demand for Dollars

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of Cleveland Working Paper No. 25-21
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Several studies have shown that aggregate demand for US dollars fell following the announcement of tariffs by the US government on April 2, 2025. Using data on stablecoins as a proxy for dollar trading, we find that the decline in dollar demand is smaller for investors in countries that saw larger increases in tariffs. Our interpretation is that, as foreign investors anticipate that tariffs will make it more expensive to acquire US dollars in the future, they buy dollars today. This channel is stronger for more liquid stablecoins and for countries with tighter capital controls, consistent with the idea that, when actual dollars are hard to acquire, stablecoins may be regarded as a substitute. Our findings cast light on the effects of the tariffs on global foreign exchange markets, as well as on the degree to which stablecoins are considered a close substitute for dollars.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，美国关税宣布后美元需求下降，但在关税增幅更大的国家，投资者对美元的需求下降幅度较小，表明投资者预期未来获取美元成本上升而提前购买。
AI.research_question: 美国关税政策如何影响全球美元需求？稳定币在美元需求中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 理解关税政策对全球外汇市场的冲击效应，以及稳定币作为美元替代品的实际作用
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于外汇需求理论、预期理论和替代效应理论，分析关税政策对美元需求的动态影响
AI.method: 使用稳定币交易数据作为美元交易的代理变量，采用计量经济学方法分析不同国家投资者对美元需求的变化
AI.findings: 关税增幅更大的国家，投资者对美元需求下降幅度较小；流动性更强的稳定币和资本管制更严格的国家，这种替代效应更强
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了关税政策对外汇市场影响的理论框架，揭示了稳定币作为美元替代品的新机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关税政策对汇率市场影响的实证依据，为投资者在外汇市场操作提供参考

title: Market segmentation, infrastructure construction and corporate tax avoidance in China
affiliations: Southwestern University of Finance and Economics-School of Accounting, Nanjing Forestry University and Xiamen University

detail.title: Market segmentation, infrastructure construction and corporate tax avoidance in China
detail.abstract: Market segmentation driven by local government protectionism raises concerns regarding the tax avoidance practices of regional enterprises. We examine how market segmentation among different provinces in China influences corporate tax avoidance under the construction of digital infrastructure at the provincial level and inter-regional high-speed rail. We show that market segmentation heightens information barriers for regional enterprises, thereby amplifying the tax avoidance motivations of listed companies. These findings remain robust even after addressing potential endogenous issues. The construction of a high-speed rail network and provincial digital infrastructure help inhibit corporate tax avoidance activities. Moreover, market segmentation more markedly boosts tax avoidance in firms with more non-local subsidiaries, where internal controls are weak, financing constraints bind, or management lacks overseas exposure. Overall, our results highlight the significant role of market segmentation in influencing corporate tax behavior and provide insights into policy interventions, such as infrastructure development, to mitigate its negative effects and promote a more transparent and efficient business environment.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现地方政府保护主义导致的市场分割会加剧企业避税行为，而高铁网络和数字基础设施建设有助于抑制这种避税活动。
AI.research_question: 中国不同省份间的市场分割如何影响企业避税行为？
AI.motivation: 地方政府保护主义导致的市场分割引发了对企业避税行为的担忧，需要研究这种分割对企业税收行为的影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息不对称理论和制度理论，市场分割通过提高信息壁垒来增强企业避税动机。
AI.method: 实证研究方法，使用中国省级面板数据和上市公司数据，通过计量模型分析市场分割与企业避税的关系，并处理内生性问题。
AI.findings: 市场分割显著加剧了企业避税行为；高铁网络和数字基础设施建设能够抑制企业避税；市场分割对非本地子公司较多、内部控制薄弱、融资约束强、管理层缺乏海外经验的企业避税影响更明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了市场分割对企业行为影响的理论研究，揭示了信息壁垒在避税决策中的重要作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定提供了实证依据，建议通过基础设施建设来降低市场分割的负面影响，促进更透明高效的商业环境。

reference: Bank of Italy Occasional Paper No. 950
title: Households' Portfolio Holdings and their Banks' Characteristics: Is there a Link?
affiliations: Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy and Bank of Italy

detail.title: Households' Portfolio Holdings and their Banks' Characteristics: Is there a Link?

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Italy Occasional Paper No. 950
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Italy Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper analyses the relationship between households’ portfolio decisions and the characteristics of the banks where they hold their wealth. We use a unique bank-client level dataset covering the period 2004-20, which combines information from Banca d’Italia’s Survey on Household Income and Wealth with supervisory reports that banks in Italy are required to submit to Banca d’Italia, matching the two sources by the identity of each household’s primary bank. Our results indicate that banks play a crucial role in reducing households’ non-participation in financial markets, thereby helping to mitigate the associated welfare costs. Moreover, we find that, even after controlling for all individual household characteristics commonly used in the literature and taking into account potential sources of self-selection and sorting between households and banks, certain bank characteristics remain significantly associated with households’ portfolio decisions. These links vary depending on the class of households’ asset holdings and the category of banks.

AI.tldr: 本文通过意大利银行-客户层面数据分析发现，银行特征对家庭投资组合决策有显著影响，银行在减少家庭不参与金融市场方面发挥关键作用，这种关联因家庭资产类别和银行类型而异。
AI.research_question: 银行特征如何影响家庭的投资组合决策？
AI.motivation: 理解银行在家庭金融市场参与和投资决策中的作用，以及银行特征对家庭投资行为的影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于家庭金融理论和银行中介理论，探讨银行作为金融中介如何影响家庭的投资决策和金融市场参与。
AI.method: 使用2004-2020年意大利银行-客户层面独特数据集，结合意大利银行家庭收入与财富调查数据和银行监管报告数据，通过匹配家庭主要银行身份进行分析。
AI.findings: 银行在减少家庭不参与金融市场方面起关键作用；即使在控制家庭特征和选择偏误后，特定银行特征仍与家庭投资组合决策显著相关；这种关联因资产类别和银行类型而异。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对银行在家庭金融决策中作用的理解，提供了银行特征影响家庭投资行为的新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行设计和实施更有效的客户金融服务提供依据，有助于改善家庭金融福利和金融市场参与度。

title: Is a Farmer a Better Messenger than an Extension Professional for Conservation Practice Adoption?
affiliations: Iowa State University, Iowa State University and Cornell University - Charles H. Dyson School of Applied Economics and Management

detail.title: Is a Farmer a Better Messenger than an Extension Professional for Conservation Practice Adoption?
detail.abstract: This study explores the influence of messengers on farmers’ decisions to adopt edge-of-field (EOF) practices. We conducted an information treatment experiment using two information sources—an Extension professional and a farmer early adopter—versus a control group. Using an online survey of 373 Iowa farmer respondents in 2022, we built an empirical model to detect the treatment effect on farmer intention to adopt EOF practices. Our regression results reveal that farmers with less experience in conservation practices responded more positively to the treatments, and that a farmer messenger was more effective than an Extension professional in encouraging practice adoption. The farmer messenger increased adoption probability by 20.4 percentage points among respondents who are not currently enrolled in the Conservation Reserve Program, while the professional messenger achieved a 7.7-percentage-point increase in adoption probability. These findings highlight the value of leveraging peer experiences and narratives in conservation outreach. Farmer-to-farmer communication appears to resonate more effectively in these communities.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过信息处理实验发现，农民信使比专业推广人员在促进边缘农田实践采纳方面更有效，特别是对缺乏保护性农业实践经验的农民效果更显著。
AI.research_question: 不同信息传递者（推广专家vs农民早期采用者）对农民采纳边缘农田实践决策的影响差异是什么？
AI.motivation: 了解如何通过有效的信息传递策略促进农业保护实践的采纳，特别是探索同行经验在农业推广中的价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息传递理论、同行影响理论、农业技术采纳理论
AI.method: 在线调查实验，对373名爱荷华州农民进行信息处理（专业推广人员vs农民信使vs对照组），建立实证模型分析处理效果
AI.findings: 1) 缺乏保护实践经验的农民对信息处理反应更积极；2) 农民信使比专业推广人员更有效；3) 农民信使使非保护储备计划参与者的采纳概率提高20.4个百分点，专业信使提高7.7个百分点
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了同行经验在农业技术推广中的有效性，丰富了信息传递理论在农业环境中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为农业推广工作提供了实证依据，建议更多地利用农民之间的同伴交流和经验分享来促进保护性农业实践的采纳

title: The term structure of inflation forecasts disagreement and monetary policy transmission
affiliations: Bank for International Settlements (BIS) - Monetary and Economic Department, Bank for International Settlements (BIS) - Monetary and Economic Department and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The term structure of inflation forecasts disagreement and monetary policy transmission
detail.abstract: The term structure of inflation forecasts disagreement in the US can be captured by two components: disagreement about trend inflation and disagreement about cyclical inflation.  While trend inflation disagreement affects forecast disagreement uniformly across horizons, cyclical inflation disagreement has a diminishing impact at longer horizons. Crucially, it is disagreement about cyclical inflation that significantly impacts the effectiveness of monetary policy in controlling inflation. When disagreement about cyclical inflation is high, the transmission of monetary policy to prices tends to weaken. Maintaining policy credibility and engaging in active public communication can help the Federal Reserve to mitigate cyclical inflation disagreement.

AI.tldr: 美国通胀预测分歧的期限结构由趋势通胀分歧和周期性通胀分歧两个成分组成，其中周期性通胀分歧对货币政策有效性有重要影响，高分歧会削弱政策传导效果。
AI.research_question: 美国通胀预测分歧的期限结构特征及其对货币政策有效性的影响机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解通胀预测分歧的构成及其对货币政策传导的影响，为美联储提高政策有效性提供理论依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 通胀预期理论、货币政策传导机制、信息不对称理论
AI.method: 理论建模与实证分析相结合，可能使用时间序列数据和调查数据
AI.findings: 趋势通胀分歧对所有期限影响均匀，周期性通胀分歧在长期影响减弱但显著影响货币政策有效性；高周期性分歧削弱政策传导
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了通胀预测分歧的二成分理论框架，揭示了周期性分歧对货币政策有效性的关键作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为美联储通过维持政策可信度和积极公众沟通来降低周期性通胀分歧、提升政策效果提供了实践指导

title: Multi-Factor Style Rotation - An Empirical Study in the US Stock Market
affiliations: Chung Hua University and Thompson Rivers University

detail.title: Multi-Factor Style Rotation - An Empirical Study in the US Stock Market
detail.abstract: Although there have been many studies discussing style rotation, this article contributes to proposing new methods for in-depth analysis of rotation phenomenon. This study uses the S&P 500 constituent stocks as the stock pool. At the beginning of each month, we select the highestscoring 4% stocks with a weighted scoring method and hold them until the end of the month. The back-test period includes from 1999/Jan to 2020/June, a total of 21.5 years (258 months). The empirical results show that (1) The design of experiments (DOE) can systematically combine the weights of the stock selection factors of the weighted scoring stock selection model to generate stock selection models representing various stock selection styles, and find many models mixing value style with growth style having high synergy. (2) The DW statistics of each model's time series of monthly excess rate of return show that many models have positive autocorrelations. (3) Although in the single factor models, the value style models are far superior to the growth style models; however, the value style models and the growth style models have two dominant periods each during the back-test period, which shows that S&P 500 has obvious style rotation phenomenon.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出新的加权评分方法分析风格轮动现象，通过实验设计系统组合价值与成长因子权重，发现混合风格模型具有高协同效应，并证实标普500存在明显的风格轮动现象。
AI.research_question: 如何通过新的加权评分方法深入分析股票市场的风格轮动现象？
AI.motivation: 尽管已有许多研究讨论风格轮动，但缺乏对轮动现象的深度分析方法，需要提出新的系统化研究框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于风格投资理论和因子投资理论，结合实验设计(DOE)方法系统构建多因子加权评分模型。
AI.method: 使用标普500成分股，每月初通过加权评分法选取前4%股票持有至月末，回测期间为1999年1月至2020年6月（258个月）。
AI.findings: (1) DOE能系统组合因子权重生成代表不同选股风格的模型，发现价值与成长混合风格模型具有高协同效应；(2) 多数模型月超额收益时间序列存在正自相关；(3) 价值风格模型在单因子模型中表现更优，但价值与成长风格在回测期内各有两个主导时期，证明存在明显风格轮动。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于实验设计的风格轮动分析新方法，为风格投资理论提供了新的实证研究框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了识别风格轮动时机和构建混合风格投资组合的实用方法，有助于提升投资组合绩效。

title: Structural Language and the Second Curve of Expression: Designing a Native Interface for Human–AI Co-Creation
affiliations: The University of Manchester

detail.title: Structural Language and the Second Curve of Expression: Designing a Native Interface for Human–AI Co-Creation
detail.abstract:
This paper introduces Structural Language as a theoretical and methodological framework for human–AI collaboration, grounded in the mechanism of Structured Expression Resonance (SER). The work argues that modern large language models (LLMs) are not semantic interpreters but structural pattern recognizers, primarily responding to rhythm, order, and format at the input layer. Building on this observation, the paper develops a Five-Layer Model of Expression—Intention, Structure, Rhythm, Cognitive Interface, and Co-Creation—which reframes language as a structure-first, rhythm-aware process rather than surface semantics.

The concept of the Second Curve of Expression is introduced to describe the paradigm shift from meaning transmission to structure-driven co-creation, positioning structural language as a native interface for collaborative intelligence. Case studies from narrative design, cross-cultural modeling, and co-writing experiments illustrate how SER enables resonance across different agents, domains, and temporal contexts.

Key contributions include: (1) formalizing Structural Language as an interdisciplinary framework bridging AI, HCI, computational linguistics, and design research; (2) defining SER as a resonance-layer engine for activating human–AI alignment; and (3) outlining a research agenda toward Expression Systems Engineering (ESE), aimed at developing cognitive operating protocols for collaborative intelligence.


The findings suggest that expression itself—not just model performance—is the decisive layer for sustainable, interpretable, and human-centered AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了结构语言作为人机协作的理论框架，基于结构化表达共振机制，认为大语言模型是结构模式识别器而非语义解释器，通过五层表达模型重新定义语言为结构优先、节奏感知的过程。
AI.research_question: 如何建立有效的人机协作理论框架，使AI能够通过结构模式识别而非语义理解来实现与人类的表达共振？
AI.motivation: 现代大语言模型主要对输入层的节奏、顺序和格式做出响应，而非进行语义解释，这需要重新思考人机协作的语言交互基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构化表达共振(SER)机制和五层表达模型（意图、结构、节奏、认知界面、共同创造），将语言视为结构优先的过程。
AI.method: 案例研究法，包括叙事设计、跨文化建模和共同写作实验，展示SER在不同主体、领域和时间背景下的共振效果。
AI.findings: 表达本身（不仅仅是模型性能）是实现可持续、可解释和以人为本的AI的决定性层面，结构语言能够激活人机对齐。
AI.theory_contributions: 形式化结构语言作为跨学科框架，定义SER作为共振层引擎，提出表达系统工程(ESE)研究议程。
AI.practical_contributions: 为开发协作智能的认知操作协议提供了方法论指导，为人机协作提供了新的界面设计思路。

title: The Long Shadow of Feudalism: Concentration of Land and Labor Market Power in India
affiliations: Independent and Harvard University - Graduate School of Arts and Sciences

detail.title: The Long Shadow of Feudalism: Concentration of Land and Labor Market Power in India
detail.abstract: Land is power: both state and non-state actors have understood this for centuries, but the causal impacts of land concentration are notoriously difficult to study. We study how differences in village land concentration stemming from the granting of feudal titles hundreds of years ago affect present-day labor markets in India. We exploit variation in land tenure systems at a more granular level than is seen in the literature on the long-run effects of land tenure systems, implementing a regression discontinuity along historically feudal borders that no longer correspond with modern administrative boundaries. Large discontinuities in land concentration persist across these boundaries, with the smallest land parcels in more concentrated areas 19% larger than their analogs in less concentrated areas. These differences are associated with 7% lower agricultural wages for women, but not men who are more able to travel and seek outside options. Importantly, these differences in wages persist despite no differences in yields, aggregate labor demand or supply, output prices, or other non-labor agricultural inputs. Village elected bodies in feudal areas scuttle the implementation of the key workfare program designed to provide agricultural labor with an outside employment option, with 71% fewer person-days offered during peak agricultural months when large landowners demand labor, and no difference the lean season when the program is most active. We show that the effect on the workfare program likely operates through caste-based links between large landowners and village elected representatives. This work emphasizes the effects of land inequality on local labor markets as a key mechanism through which inequities persist, and the value of outside options for workers where employers have market power.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了印度封建土地制度遗留的土地集中问题对现代劳动力市场的影响，发现土地集中导致女性农业工资降低7%，且通过种姓关联影响村级工作福利项目的实施。
AI.research_question: 历史上的封建土地授予导致的村庄土地集中差异如何影响当代印度劳动力市场？
AI.motivation: 土地即权力，但土地集中的因果影响难以研究。需要探究几个世纪前封建制度遗留的土地不平等如何持续影响现代经济结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 土地不平等理论、劳动力市场垄断力量理论、历史制度持久性理论
AI.method: 采用回归断点设计，利用历史上封建边界与现代行政边界不重合的特征，在细粒度层面分析土地 tenure 系统的变异
AI.findings: 1) 土地集中区域最小地块比非集中区域大19%；2) 女性农业工资低7%（男性无差异）；3) 产量、劳动力供需等无差异；4) 封建地区村级机构故意阻碍工作福利项目实施（农忙时减少71%人日工作量）；5) 效应通过大地主与村级代表的种姓联系实现
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了土地不平等通过劳动力市场机制持续影响经济不平等的具体路径，强调了雇主市场权力下工人外部选择权的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了理解土地改革和劳动力市场干预有效性的实证依据，特别是工作福利项目在打破土地所有者垄断力量方面的作用
