detail.title: On Migrating Framework Components in Web Applications: A State-of-the-Art and State-of-the-Practice Review
detail.abstract: The evolution of web technologies requires the continuous modernization of web applications, often necessitating the migration of existing components to newer frameworks, libraries, or architectures. This survey article addresses the critical need for effective migration strategies and tools by examining the academic and practical state-of-the-art with respect to tools and frameworks. Unlike related studies, this study synthesizes findings from the most recent scholarly literature and an extensive collection of currently available tools identified through a systematic internet-based investigation. By establishing a connection between theoretical advancements and real-world implementations, this survey contributes with a comprehensive understanding of the challenges, methodologies, and tooling landscape surrounding web application component migration. In addition to architectural details, our survey stands out by providing insights on the application of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) in contemporary contexts. In addiction, the article identifies emerging trends, benchmarks, best practices, and areas of potential future research and development in the critical field of software evolution. In conclusion, this integrated perspective equips researchers and practitioners with the knowledge necessary to navigate the complexities of component migration, select tools appropriately, and implement strategies for evolving web applications.

AI.tldr: 本论文通过系统性调查，综述了网页应用组件迁移领域的最新研究进展和工具实践，特别关注AI/ML技术在迁移过程中的应用，为研究人员和实践者提供全面的指导。
AI.research_question: 如何有效地进行网页应用组件向新框架、库或架构的迁移？当前有哪些先进的迁移策略、工具和最佳实践？
AI.motivation: 网络技术的迅速发展要求网页应用不断现代化，而组件迁移是这一过程中的关键挑战，需要有效的迁移策略和工具支持。
AI.theoretical_framework: 软件演化理论、系统迁移理论、人工智能和机器学习在软件维护中的应用理论
AI.method: 系统性文献综述和系统性网络调查相结合的方法，分析最新学术研究成果和当前可用的工具框架
AI.findings: 识别了网页应用组件迁移的关键挑战、方法论和工具景观，特别是AI/ML技术在当代迁移中的应用进展
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了理论进展与实际实现之间的联系，提供了对软件演化领域组件迁移的综合性理论理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究人员和实践者提供了工具选择指南、策略实施建议、最佳实践和未来研究方向，提高迁移效率和质量

title: Discovering Optimal Weights in Weighted-Scoring Stock-Picking Models: A Mixture Design Approach
affiliations: Chung Hua University and Tamkang University

detail.title: Discovering Optimal Weights in Weighted-Scoring Stock-Picking Models: A Mixture Design Approach
detail.abstract: Certain literature that constructs a multifactor stock selection model adopted a weighted-scoring approach despite its three shortcomings. First, it cannot effectively identify the connection between the weights of stock-picking concepts and portfolio performances. Second, it cannot provide stock-picking concepts' optimal combination of weights. Third, it cannot meet various investor preferences. Thus, this study employs a mixture experimental design to determine the weights of stock-picking concepts, collect portfolio performance data, and construct performance prediction models based on the weights of stock-picking concepts. Furthermore, these performance prediction models and optimization techniques are employed to discover stock-picking concepts' optimal combination of weights that meet investor preferences. The samples consist of stocks listed on the Taiwan stock market. The modeling and testing periods were 1997-2008 and 2009-2015, respectively. Empirical evidence showed (1) that our methodology is robust in predicting performance accurately, (2) that it can identify significant interactions between stock-picking concepts' weights, and (3) that which their optimal combination should be. This combination of weights can form stock portfolios with the best performances that can meet investor preferences. Thus, our methodology can fill the three drawbacks of the classical weighted-scoring approach.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种基于混合实验设计的新方法，用于解决传统积分法股票选择模型的三大缺陷，能够准确预测业绩、识别因子权重间的显著交互作用，并根据投资者偏好确定最优权重组合。
AI.research_question: 如何解决传统积分法股票选择模型的三大缺陷：无法识别权重与业绩关联、无法提供最优权重组合、无法满足多样化投资偏好？
AI.motivation: 传统积分法股票选择模型存在三个显著缺陷，影响了投资组合的性能和适用性，需要开发更有效的方法来解决这些问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合实验设计理论、业绩预测模型、优化技术
AI.method: 采用混合实验设计确定股票选择概念权重，收集投资组合业绩数据，建立基于权重的业绩预测模型，并使用优化技术找到满足投资者偏好的最优权重组合。样本为台湾股市上市股票，模型建立期1997-2008年，测试期2009-2015年。
AI.findings: 实证结果显示：(1)方法能够准确预测业绩；(2)能识别股票选择概念权重间的显著交互作用；(3)能确定最优权重组合，形成最佳业绩的股票组合满足投资者偏好。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种能够充分考虑因子权重与业绩关系的新方法论，补充了传统积分法模型的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种可行的实践方法，能够帮助投资者根据个人偏好构建最优股票组合，提高投资收益和满意度。

title: Image Restoration Model Compression via Mamba-oriented Heterogeneous Knowledge Distillation
affiliations: Nantong University, Nantong University, Nantong University, Hohai University and Griffith University

detail.title: Image Restoration Model Compression via Mamba-oriented Heterogeneous Knowledge Distillation
detail.abstract: Image Restoration (IR) community is currently dominated by transformers, usually requiring heavy computation and intensive parameters. To improve the efficiency of IR models in resource-constrained environments, we formally propose a strategy of knowledge distillation-based image restoration model compression, whilst designing an instantiate method of Mamba-oriented Heterogeneous Knowledge Distillation (MHKD). Specifically, we firstly pre-train a cumbersome yet high-quality IR model with advanced transformer blocks as the teacher network. Secondly, we construct a lightweight IR model with the efficient vision Mamba blocks as the student network. Subsequently, MHKD is used to transfer the heterogeneous knowledge from the teacher network to the student network. The key elements of MHKD are the feature filter module and feature interface module. The former is designed to reduce the redundant information from the transformer-based teacher network, and the latter aims to translate the heterogeneous feature of teacher network for the Mamba-based student network with the designed bi-direction knowledge transferring loss. Extensive experiments across multiple IR benchmarks confirm that MHKD can assist Mamba-based IR model with compact size (≈ 716K parameters) to achieve comparable or even better⋆This work was partially supported by National Nature Science Foundation of China (62372155, 62273188), Nantong Science and Technology Program Project (JC2024065).

AI.tldr: 提出基于知识蒸馏的图像修复模型压缩策略MHKD，使用Transformer教师网络指导轻量级Mamba学生网络，通过特征过滤和接口模块实现异构知识迁移，在参数极少（约716K）的情况下达到可比甚至更好的性能
AI.research_question: 如何在资源受限环境下提高图像修复模型的效率，同时保持高质量的性能？
AI.motivation: 当前图像修复领域主要被计算量大、参数密集的Transformer模型主导，需要开发更高效的模型压缩方法以适应资源受限环境
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于知识蒸馏理论，结合Transformer和Mamba架构的异构知识迁移框架
AI.method: 1) 预训练Transformer教师网络；2) 构建Mamba学生网络；3) 设计MHKD方法（含特征过滤模块和特征接口模块）进行异构知识迁移；4) 使用双向知识迁移损失
AI.findings: 在多个图像修复基准测试中，MHKD方法使仅716K参数的Mamba模型达到了与大型Transformer模型相当甚至更好的性能
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了面向Mamba的异构知识蒸馏理论框架，设计了特征过滤和特征接口模块来处理架构异构性问题
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了高效的图像修复模型压缩方案，大幅减少计算资源和参数需求，适用于资源受限的实际应用场景

title: The Words of Chairs in FOMC Press Conferences: Financial Text Analysis Using Language Model Ensembles
affiliations: Bentley University and Bentley University

detail.title: The Words of Chairs in FOMC Press Conferences: Financial Text Analysis Using Language Model Ensembles
detail.abstract: Financial scholars, analysts, and investors are increasingly utilizing text data when conducting academic research or making financial decisions. The advancements in natural language processing and generative AI technology have brought new opportunities and tools to financial text analysis applications. In this study, we create ensembles of different versions of FinBERT, GPT-4o, and dictionary-and keyword-based methods, and use the ensembles to identify sentiment, topics, and temporal directionality in FOMC chairs' remarks during the press conferences. The evaluation of the models shows that the performance of generaldomain GPT-4o and domain-specific FinBERT may vary, depending on the training and learning strategies. Including multiple models and methods into the ensembles leverages the strengths of these models and helps improve classification accuracy. Aligning the sentiment and topic indicators in FOMC press conferences with the market reaction data, we find that financial markets pay attention to not only the sentiment tones in the chairs' words but also the context of the sentiment.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过集成FinBERT、GPT-4o和词典方法，分析FOMC主席新闻发布会言论的情感、主题和时间方向性，发现市场不仅关注情感基调还关注情感上下文。
AI.research_question: 如何有效分析FOMC主席新闻发布会文本的情感、主题和时间方向性，以及这些文本特征如何影响金融市场反应？
AI.motivation: 金融文本分析在学术研究和投资决策中日益重要，NLP和生成式AI技术的发展为金融文本分析提供了新机遇和工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于自然语言处理理论、情感分析理论和金融市场信息反应理论
AI.method: 创建FinBERT、GPT-4o和词典方法的集成模型，用于识别FOMC主席言论的情感、主题和时间方向性，并与市场反应数据进行对齐分析
AI.findings: 1) GPT-4o和FinBERT的性能因训练和学习策略而异；2) 集成多个模型可提高分类准确性；3) 金融市场不仅关注情感基调，还关注情感上下文
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了金融文本分析的集成方法框架，深化了对金融市场信息处理机制的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融从业者提供了更准确的文本分析工具，有助于更好地理解央行沟通对市场的影响

title: From Networks to Performance: A Moderated-Mediation Model Linking Social Networking to Organizational Agility in Pakistani SMEs
affiliations: Independent, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Panzhihua University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: From Networks to Performance: A Moderated-Mediation Model Linking Social Networking to Organizational Agility in Pakistani SMEs
detail.abstract: While organizational agility is widely acknowledged as critical for navigating rapid environmental changes and enhancing firm performance, theoretical and empirical insights into its adoption mechanisms remain underexplored. Addressing this research gap, our study leverages social capital theory to propose a dual-path model that investigates (1) the mediating role of knowledge sharing in linking social networking to organizational agility and (2) the moderating effects of digital literacy and motivation drive. Using survey data from 590 Pakistani SMEs, structural equation modeling results reveal that sharing knowledge mediates the relationship between social networking and organizational agility. Digital literacy strengthens the relationship between social networking and sharing knowledge, while motivation drives enhance the association between sharing knowledge and organizational agility. This research advances the organizational agility literature by demonstrating how SMEs in resource-constrained environments can harness synergies between social capital (via networks and knowledge exchange) and digital-human capabilities (through technological proficiency and employee motivation) to achieve sustainable agility. The findings offer practical guidance for SMEs and policymakers seeking to foster resilience in dynamic markets through targeted investments in digital infrastructure, collaborative networks, and incentive-driven knowledge cultures.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于社会资本理论，探讨了巴基斯坦中小企业中社交网络通过知识共享影响组织敏捷性的双路径机制，并验证了数字素养和动机驱动的调节作用。
AI.research_question: 社交网络如何通过知识共享影响组织敏捷性？数字素养和动机驱动在其中起什么调节作用？
AI.motivation: 尽管组织敏捷性对应对环境变化和提升企业绩效至关重要，但其采纳机制的理论和实证研究仍然不足，特别是在资源受限的中小企业环境中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会资本理论，重点关注社交网络、知识共享与组织敏捷性之间的关系。
AI.method: 使用来自590家巴基斯坦中小企业的调查数据，采用结构方程模型进行分析。
AI.findings: 知识共享在社交网络与组织敏捷性之间起中介作用；数字素养强化了社交网络与知识共享的关系；动机驱动增强了知识共享与组织敏捷性的关联。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过提出双路径模型，深化了对组织敏捷性采纳机制的理解，展示了社会资本与数字-人力能力的协同作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中小企业和政策制定者提供了实践指导，建议投资数字基础设施、协作网络和激励驱动的知识文化来培养动态市场中的韧性。

title: Harnessing AI for Strategic Intelligence: The Impact of Customer Data Analytics on Amazon
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Harnessing AI for Strategic Intelligence: The Impact of Customer Data Analytics on Amazon
detail.abstract: The research explores artificial intelligence (AI) effects on Amazon's customer data analysis as the global e-commerce leader. The research used a mixed-methods approach to study how Amazon's 2023 AI-driven analytics platform affected customer experience and both operational efficiency and business performance. The research demonstrates how artificial intelligence (AI) improves personalization while optimizing supply chain logistics and elevating customer satisfaction through empirical data analysis combined with industry reports and theoretical models such as DIKW hierarchy and CRISP-DM framework. The research identifies important managerial consequences together with ethical issues and provides strategic guidance for the sustainable implementation of AI technology. The research findings advance the discussion about AI benefits within big data environments while offering a practical blueprint for customer-oriented businesses in the digital transformation process.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨AI对亚马逊客户数据分析的影响，通过混合方法分析2023年AI驱动分析平台对客户体验、运营效率和业务绩效的提升作用，发现AI能改善个性化服务、优化供应链并提高客户满意度，同时识别了管理影响和伦理问题。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何影响亚马逊的客户数据分析，以及对客户体验、运营效率和业务绩效产生什么影响？
AI.motivation: 作为全球电子商务领导者，亚马逊在AI驱动的客户数据分析方面的实践具有重要研究价值，可为其他企业提供数字化转型的参考。
AI.theoretical_framework: DIKW层次模型（数据-信息-知识-智慧）和CRISP-DM（跨行业数据挖掘标准流程）框架
AI.method: 混合研究方法，结合实证数据分析、行业报告和理论模型分析
AI.findings: AI技术显著提升个性化服务水平，优化供应链物流，提高客户满意度，同时带来运营效率和业务绩效的改善
AI.theory_contributions: 推进了大数据环境中AI效益的讨论，为AI在客户数据分析领域的理论发展做出贡献
AI.practical_contributions: 为面向客户的企业在数字化转型过程中提供实用的战略指导蓝图，识别了重要的管理影响和伦理考量

title: Artificial Intelligence in Cross-Border E-Commerce: From Value Chain Optimization to Compliance-as-a-Service
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence in Cross-Border E-Commerce: From Value Chain Optimization to Compliance-as-a-Service
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming cross-border e-commerce (CBEC) by improving personalization, operational efficiency, and compliance automation, while also presenting challenges related to data privacy, algorithmic transparency, and regulatory fragmentation. This study examines AI integration in CBEC through a systematic literature review, bibliometric analysis of 71 scholarly articles, case studies of major platforms (Alibaba, Amazon, JD Worldwide, and SHEIN), and a comparative analysis of multi-jurisdictional policy documents. Guided by the Technology–Organization–Environment (TOE) framework, Resource-Based Theory (RBT), and Diffusion of Innovation (DOI), the findings reveal three key contributions. First, AI adoption in CBEC is evolving from isolated applications to comprehensive optimization of the entire value chain. Second, compliance remains a significant obstacle, with privacy protection, algorithmic auditability, and legal differences across borders being central issues. Third, the study introduces the “Compliance-as-a-Service” (CaaS) framework, which redefines compliance as a platform-based, modular, and VRIN resource, especially valuable for SMEs lacking technical and financial resources. Theoretically, this research connects fragmented views on technology adoption, resource advantage, and innovation diffusion. Practically, it offers guidance for firms and policymakers to develop explainable, modular, and adaptive compliance systems that promote responsible and sustainable AI-enabled global trade.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过系统文献综述、文献计量分析、案例研究和政策比较，探讨AI在跨境电商中的整合应用，发现AI应用正从孤立工具转向全价值链优化，合规性是主要障碍，并提出了将合规性重新定义为平台化、模块化VRIN资源的CaaS框架。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何整合到跨境电商中，面临哪些挑战，以及如何通过合规即服务框架促进负责任的AI驱动全球贸易？
AI.motivation: AI正在改变跨境电商，提升个性化、运营效率和合规自动化，但也带来数据隐私、算法透明度和监管碎片化等挑战，需要系统性研究来指导实践。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术-组织-环境(TOE)框架、资源基础理论(RBT)、创新扩散理论(DOI)
AI.method: 系统文献综述、71篇学术文献的文献计量分析、主要平台案例研究(阿里巴巴、亚马逊、京东全球购、SHEIN)、多法域政策文件比较分析
AI.findings: 1) AI应用从孤立工具向全价值链优化演进；2) 合规性是主要障碍，隐私保护、算法可审计性和跨境法律差异是核心问题；3) 提出合规即服务(CaaS)框架，将合规重新定义为平台化、模块化的VRIN资源
AI.theory_contributions: 整合了技术采纳、资源优势和创新扩散的碎片化观点，建立了统一的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和管理者提供指导，开发可解释、模块化和自适应的合规系统，促进负责任和可持续的AI驱动全球贸易

detail.abstract: Following the outbreak of a regional war, the Israeli capital markets regulator, ISA, introduced a temporary regulatory exception allowing reporting corporations traded on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange (TASE) to postpone the filing of their quarterly reports at will. This intervention raises questions at the intersection of law and finance concerning the value of information, responses to withheld information, and opportunistic behaviors by market participants. By utilizing empirical methods, I find that even corporations unaffected by the war used the regulatory relief, and that market response was limited, raising doubts regarding the efficiency of the market under these circumstances. This paper aims to inform decision makers who consider how to provide regulatory response to external shocks such as wars or other catastrophes.

AI.tldr: 以色列资本市场监管机构在地区战争爆发后允许上市公司自愿推迟季度报告提交，研究发现即使未受战争影响的公司也利用此监管豁免，市场反应有限，对市场效率提出质疑
AI.research_question: 监管机构在外部冲击（如战争）下提供报告豁免的市场影响和公司行为反应
AI.motivation: 探讨战争等外部冲击下监管豁免政策的价值、市场对信息缺失的反应以及参与者的机会主义行为
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息经济学、市场效率理论、监管干预理论
AI.method: 实证研究方法
AI.findings: 即使未受战争影响的公司也利用监管豁免推迟报告，市场对此反应有限，表明市场效率在此情况下存在问题
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了外部冲击下监管干预与市场效率的理论研究，提供了信息价值与机会主义行为的新证据
AI.practical_contributions: 为决策者在战争等灾难情况下制定监管应对措施提供实证依据和政策建议

title: Which Drives Abnormal Returns, Over- or Under-Reaction? -Studies Applying Longitudinal Analysis
affiliations: Tamkang University and Chung Hua University

detail.title: Which Drives Abnormal Returns, Over- or Under-Reaction? -Studies Applying Longitudinal Analysis
detail.abstract: This paper combined both cross-sectional and time-series longitudinal analysis to identify that factor anomalies are driven by either over-reaction or under-reaction. The basic principle is, first, use a factor to form ten portfolios in the t quarter, then observe the average prices and returns of the ten portfolios for the previous four quarters and for the following four quarters as well. Samples in this study contain all stocks listed in the US from 1990 to 2010. The empirical evidence shows that the reason for the abnormal returns of value (book-to-price ratios, earnings-to-price ratios, sales-to-price ratios), scale, and liquidity factors is over-reaction. Meanwhile, the reason for the abnormal returns of growth factors (return on equity, return on assets, and revenue growth rate) is under-reaction. The results provide significant policy implications. The anomaly returns of the value, scale, and liquidity factors last longer and are more appropriate to be employed for long-run investment while the growth factors are better suited for short-run investment. Furthermore, a more profitable stock-selection strategy can be formed by simultaneously considering the above two types of factors to capture both of these two sources of anomaly returns.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文通过结合截面和时间序列分析，发现不同因子异常收益的驱动机制有异：价值、规模和流动性因子由过度反应驱动，而成长因子由反应不足驱动。这为投资策略提供了重要依据，建议长期投资采用前者，短期投资采用后者，且可组合两者获取更高收益。
AI.research_question: 不同因子异常收益的驱动机制是过度反应还是反应不足？
AI.motivation: 理解不同因子异常收益的本质源泄，以指导投资策略的制定和优化
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为金融学理论，特别是过度反应和反应不足理论
AI.method: 截面和时间序列线性分析，使用因子在t季度构建534个投资组合，观察前后四个季度的平均价格和收益变化
AI.findings: 价值因子（市净率、市盈率、市销率）、规模因子和流动性因子的异常收益由过度反应驱动；成长因子（净资产收益率、资产收益率、收入增长率）的异常收益由反应不足驱动
AI.theory_contributions: 证实了不同类型因子异常收益的异质性驱动机制，丰富了行为金融学理论在因子投资领域的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了明确的投资策略指导：长期投资适合采用价值、规模和流动性因子，短期投资适合采用成长因子，且组合两者可获得更高收益

title: Artificial Intelligence and Data Privacy: Emerging Legal Challenges, Regulatory Gaps, and Economic Opportunities
affiliations: Panjab University

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence and Data Privacy: Emerging Legal Challenges, Regulatory Gaps, and Economic Opportunities

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.

detail.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is transforming how data is collected, processed, and used. While AI promises efficiency and innovation, it raises serious concerns for data privacy and individual rights. Existing legal frameworks including EU GDPR, U.S. federal and state privacy laws, and India’s emerging data protection legislation struggle to keep pace with AI-driven technologies. This paper explores legal and regulatory challenges in AI data processing, opportunities for billion-dollar industries arising from privacy gaps, court and judicial system challenges in enforcing AI regulations, and emerging technological solutions, including encrypted legal-tech apps. Strategic legal and technological interventions can protect privacy and create substantial economic opportunities in AI compliance, privacy tech, and ethical AI industries.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文探讨人工智能对数据隐私的影响，分析了现有法律框架的不足，提出了解决方案和经济机遇。
AI.research_question: 人工智能数据处理中的法律和监管挑战是什么？如何通过战略性法律和技术干预来保护隐私并创造经济机遇？
AI.motivation: AI正在转变数据收集、处理和使用方式，虽然提供效率和创新，但也带来了严重的数据隐私和个人权利问题。现有法律框架追不上AI技术的发展速度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数据保护法律框架（包括EU GDPR、美国联邦和各州隐私法、印度数据保护立法）、监管理论、法律技术融合理论。
AI.method: 法律框架分析、监管挑战识别、技术解决方案研究、经济机遇分析。
AI.findings: 现有法律框架在AI数据处理方面存在显著缺口，隐私空白带来千亿级产业机遇，法院系统遇到执法挑战，加密法律技术应用提供了解决方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了AI时代数据保护的法律-技术融合理论框架，为监管理论提供新视角，推进了法律技术学研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了实用的法律和技术干预策略，指出了AI遵规、隐私技术和道德AI产业的重大经济机遇，为政府、企业和法院提供了具体建议。

title: The Dual-Play Challenge: Platform Strategies for Display and Shopping Ads in Social Media Ecosystem
affiliations: Temple University and Temple University - Department of Statistics, Operations, and Data Science

detail.title: The Dual-Play Challenge: Platform Strategies for Display and Shopping Ads in Social Media Ecosystem
detail.abstract: As social media platforms incorporate e-commerce capabilities, shopping ads have emerged as a key monetization tool, enabling users to make in-app purchases and generating commission revenue for the platform. Meanwhile, shopping ad creators can also earn a commission from suppliers (i.e., advertisers) for each purchase generated through their ads. Motivated by this, creators may pay ad fees to the platform to boost exposure and drive more sales. As a result, unlike traditional display ads that generate only ad revenue, shopping ads offer dual revenue streams for the platform: ad fees and commissions. However, how platforms should strategically manage these two ad formats remains unclear to them. Our study fills this critical gap by developing a framework that jointly optimizes platform profit from both display and shopping ads while endogenizing ad prices and the commission rate. We find that even when users exhibit a stronger aversion to shopping ads, interestingly, it is not always optimal to de-prioritize them. Additionally, platforms might, in fact, benefit from setting lower prices or allocating more volume to more aversive ads. Furthermore, unexpectedly, a higher product value sometimes leads to lower commission rates to sustain creator and supplier engagement. Finally, although stricter data privacy policies reduce targeting precision, they may help alleviate the welfare loss from higher commission rates by lowering supplier costs. Together, these findings provide strategic guidance for platform managers on ad pricing, commission setting, and allocation decisions and offer guidance for policymakers navigating privacy regulation and social welfare in the social commerce ecosystem.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了社交媒体平台如何同时优化展示广告和购物广告的收益，发现用户对购物广告的厌恶并不总是需要降低其优先级，平台可能通过降低价格或增加投放量来获益，产品价值提高时可能需要降低佣金率来维持创作者和供应商参与，数据隐私政策虽然降低精准度但可能通过降低供应商成本来缓解福利损失。
AI.research_question: 社交媒体平台应如何战略性地管理展示广告和购物广告这两种广告形式，以最大化平台利润？
AI.motivation: 随着社交媒体平台整合电商功能，购物广告成为重要变现工具，既能产生广告费收入又能获得佣金收入，但平台如何同时优化这两种收入来源尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 建立了一个联合优化框架，内生决定广告价格和佣金率，同时考虑展示广告和购物广告的双重收益流。
AI.method: 理论建模框架，通过数学优化方法分析平台利润最大化问题，考虑用户对广告的厌恶程度、产品价值、数据隐私政策等因素。
AI.findings: 1）即使用户对购物广告厌恶更强，也不总是最优降低其优先级；2）平台可能通过降低价格或增加投放量来从更令人厌恶的广告中获益；3）产品价值较高时可能需要降低佣金率来维持参与；4）严格的数据隐私政策可能通过降低供应商成本来缓解福利损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个同时考虑广告费和佣金双重收入流的平台广告管理理论框架，揭示了在用户厌恶、产品价值和隐私政策等多重因素下的最优决策机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台管理者提供广告定价、佣金设置和投放分配的战略指导，为政策制定者提供隐私监管和社会福利管理的实践建议。

title: Building Growth and Value Hybrid Valuation Model with Errors-in-Variables Regression
affiliations: National Taipei University of Technology, National Taipei University of Technology, Chung Hua University and Tamkang University

detail.title: Building Growth and Value Hybrid Valuation Model with Errors-in-Variables Regression
detail.abstract: Growth Value Model (GVM) considers stock intrinsic value as the synergy of book value and return on equity (ROE), which contains two parameters, value factor and growth factor. This study addresses the problem of independent variables having measurement errors by utilizing errors-invariables regression to estimate accurate model parameters. Research findings show: (1) The regression curve derived by traditional regression analysis exhibits severe bias. Errors-in-variables regression is capable of correcting the bias. (2) Large scale firms exhibit lower value factor and higher growth factor, which indicates that large scale firms possess better profit persistence.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用误差变量回归方法修正传统回归分析中的偏差，发现大公司具有更低的价值因子和更高的增长因子，表明大公司具有更好的盈利持续性。
AI.research_question: 如何通过误差变量回归方法准确估计增长价值模型（GVM）中的参数，以修正传统回归分析中的测量误差偏差？
AI.motivation: 传统回归分析在处理具有测量误差的自变量时会产生严重偏差，需要采用更准确的误差变量回归方法来估计增长价值模型的参数。
AI.theoretical_framework: 增长价值模型（GVM），将股票内在价值视为账面价值和净资产收益率（ROE）的协同作用，包含价值因子和增长因子两个参数。
AI.method: 误差变量回归（errors-in-variables regression）方法，用于处理自变量存在测量误差的情况。
AI.findings: 1）传统回归分析得出的回归曲线存在严重偏差，误差变量回归能够修正这种偏差；2）大规模公司表现出更低的价值因子和更高的增长因子，表明大规模公司具有更好的盈利持续性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了使用误差变量回归方法来准确估计增长价值模型参数的理论框架，修正了传统回归分析中的测量误差问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和财务分析师提供了更准确的股票估值方法，特别适用于分析大规模公司的盈利持续性和内在价值评估。

reference: American Journal of International Law, Vol 119, No. 3, 2025 Forthcoming
title: The 'America First Trade Policy' in Practice
affiliations: University of Michigan Law School, Georgetown University Law Center and Duke University School of Law

detail.title: The 'America First Trade Policy' in Practice

publicationDetails.detailsText: American Journal of International Law, Vol 119, No. 3, 2025 Forthcoming

detail.abstract: Tariffs are at the center of U.S. President Donald J. Trump’s “America First Trade Policy” in his second term. Citing emergency and national security concerns, the Trump Administration has imposed double- and triple-digit percent tariffs on imports from nearly every country in the world. By April 2025, the Trump tariffs had increased the average weighted U.S. tariff to 23 percent—a ten-fold increase from a year prior. In addition to the economic and business ramifications of this policy, two major legal and political moves have followed the president’s threats and unpredictable tariff policies: first, importers and other groups have sought relief from these policies in the U.S. courts, alleging that the president’s wholesale remaking of tariff rates violate U.S. law; and second, governments across the globe have entered into negotiations with the United States, pursuing agreements to shield them from the worst of the tariffs. Both moves have prompted questions about the reach of the president’s foreign commerce authority and the separation of trade law powers in U.S. foreign relations and constitutional law.

AI.tldr: 本文分析特朗普政府关税政策的合法性及其对美国总统外贸权力和贸易法权力分立的影响
AI.research_question: 特朗普政府大幅提高关税的政策是否符合美国法律？这些政策如何影响美国总统的外贸权力和贸易法权力分立？
AI.motivation: 特朗普政府以紧急情况和国家安全为由，对全球几乎所有国家征收两位数甚至三位数的关税，将美国加权平均关税提高至23%，引发了法律和政治层面的重大争议
AI.theoretical_framework: 美国宪法外贸权力分配理论、行政权力与司法权力分立理论、国际贸易法理论
AI.method: 法律文本分析、政策文件分析、司法案例研究
AI.findings: 进口商和其他团体已向美国法院寻求救济，指控总统全面改变关税税率违反美国法律；全球各国政府与美国进行谈判，寻求协议以避免最严重的关税影响
AI.theory_contributions: 深化对美国总统外贸权力边界和宪法权力分立的理解，为贸易法权力分配提供理论分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为进口商和政府应对关税政策提供法律策略参考，为未来贸易政策制定提供实践指导

reference: Maastricht Faculty of Law Working Paper No. 02/2025; Doi: 10.26481/mup.law.rps.2502; M.G. Faure, The Price of Meat in International Climate Change Law, Journal of Environmental Law and Litigation, forthcoming
title: The Price of Meat in International Climate Change Law

detail.title: The Price of Meat in International Climate Change Law

publicationDetails.detailsText: Maastricht Faculty of Law Working Paper No. 02/2025
publicationDetails.journalName: Maastricht Law Research Paper Series

publicationDetails.detailsText: M.G. Faure, The Price of Meat in International Climate Change Law, Journal of Environmental Law and Litigation, forthcoming

detail.abstract: The influence of food production and more particularly meat has been dramatically neglected from international climate change law. That is striking, as several reports indicate that livestock production creates 14,5% of all global greenhouse gas emissions and even 25% if land use is included as well. This paper argues that meat production should be included in the international climate change regime and examines a variety of instruments that could be employed to do so. Attention is paid to production changes and regulation of production as well as to a possible extension of the emission trading schemes. But it is argued that the most promising instrument is the introduction of a meat tax. The paper sketches how the optimal tax rate should be determined, what the effects of the tax are expected to be and how support for a meat tax could be achieved. However, it is equally argued that the meat tax should be one instrument among a smart mix of various instruments, including also behavioral policy. Given cross-border externalities, the meat tax should be mandated at at least a regional and preferably even international level. So far, the effects of meat production on climate change have been dramatically ignored as none of the G20 countries have referred to the effect of food production on global warming in their nationally determined contributions. That is dramatic as there is a great likelihood that the goals of the Paris Agreement cannot be reached without incorporating meat production into climate change policy. The only reason that this has so far not been done is that it has been prevented by effective lobbying from the meat industry. The paper therefore argues that the price of meat should take the negative external effects of meat production and consumption into account, more particularly on climate change.

AI.tldr: 本文主张将肉类生产纳入国际气候变化制度，认为肉类税是最有前景的政策工具，应通过区域或国际层面的强制实施来应对肉类生产对气候变化的重大影响。
AI.research_question: 如何将肉类生产纳入国际气候变化制度，以及采用何种政策工具最有效？
AI.motivation: 肉类生产占全球温室气体排放的14.5%（包括土地使用则达25%），但在国际气候变化法律中被严重忽视，G20国家在国家自主贡献中均未提及食品生产对全球变暖的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于外部性理论和环境经济学，主张通过价格机制内部化肉类生产的负面环境影响。
AI.method: 政策工具分析，包括生产变革、生产监管、排放交易体系扩展以及肉类税等方案的比较研究。
AI.findings: 肉类税是最有前景的政策工具，应通过最优税率确定、效果预期和支持机制设计来实施，并作为多种政策工具组合的一部分。
AI.theory_contributions: 将食品生产特别是肉类生产纳入气候变化政策框架，提出了基于外部性内部化的政策设计理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际社会提供了具体的政策实施方案，包括肉类税的设计和执行机制，有助于实现巴黎协定目标。

title: Artificial Intelligence Narratives and Stock Market Returns
affiliations: Queen’s University Belfast, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Lyon Catholic University and INSEEC

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence Narratives and Stock Market Returns
detail.abstract: This study examines the role of artificial intelligence (AI) media coverage on stock market returns. We employ an AI discourse index developed by Bandyopadhyay et al. (2023), which captures market attention to AI relatedness. Applying a new nonparametric time-varying coefficient models. Our findings indicate significant positive effects on stock market returns. Moreover, the AI index enhances forecasting performance when using a AI- based time-varying coefficient model compared to using historical values of stock market returns.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨人工智能媒体报道对股市收益的影响，使用AI话语指数和时变系数模型，发现AI关注度对股市收益有显著正向影响，且能提升预测性能。
AI.research_question: 人工智能媒体报道如何影响股票市场收益？
AI.motivation: 随着人工智能技术的快速发展，媒体对AI的报道日益增多，但AI媒体报道对金融市场的影响机制尚不明确，需要深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于市场注意力理论和行为金融学理论，媒体关注度通过影响投资者情绪和信息传播来影响资产价格。
AI.method: 采用Bandyopadhyay等人(2023)开发的AI话语指数，运用非参数时变系数模型进行分析。
AI.findings: AI媒体报道对股票市场收益具有显著正向影响；基于AI指数的时变系数模型相比历史收益数据能显著提升预测性能。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了媒体关注度对金融市场影响的理论框架，为AI技术相关的市场反应提供了新的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了基于AI媒体关注的预测工具，帮助市场参与者更好地把握AI技术发展带来的投资机会。

title: Small Countries in Times of Turbulence: The Case of Hungary
affiliations: MGIMO

detail.title: Small Countries in Times of Turbulence: The Case of Hungary
detail.abstract: The ongoing tectonic shifts of global world reorganization attract attention not only to the main global "locomotives" of the world economy and politics, which are considered to have a strong impact on the course of these processes, but also to small countries that are trying not only to adapt to these changes, but also to actively participate in them. In the list of small countries demonstrating success in this direction, Hungary is in the middle part, being neither a leader nor an outsider. Based on the understanding that Hungary during the reign of V. Orban in reality is an example of unconventional economic policy, which nevertheless contributed to many economic successes, the country deserves a more in-depth study. This article analyzes some features of the development model chosen by the country.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了匈牙利在欧尔班政府时期采取的非传统经济政策及其发展模式特征，探讨了小国在全球重组中的适应策略
AI.research_question: 匈牙利作为一个小国在全球重组过程中采取了什么样的非传统经济政策和发展模式？
AI.motivation: 全球格局重组不仅关注主要经济体，也需要研究小国如何适应并积极参与这些变化，匈牙利作为中等成功案例值得深入分析
AI.theoretical_framework: 小国适应理论、非传统经济政策理论、全球重组背景下的国家发展模式理论
AI.method: 案例分析法和政策分析法，基于匈牙利欧尔班政府时期的经济政策实践
AI.findings: 匈牙利采取了非传统的经济政策，这些政策虽然非传统但带来了许多经济成功，该国的发展模式具有独特特征
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了小国在全球重组中的适应策略理论，为非传统经济政策提供了实证支持
AI.practical_contributions: 为其他小国在全球变化中制定经济政策提供了参考案例，展示了非传统政策可能带来的成功

title: Learning via the Band of Brothers: Evidence of Entrepreneurial Spillover
affiliations: National Taiwan University - Department of Finance, Institute of Economics, Academia Sinica, National Taiwan University - Department of Finance and The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) - CUHK Business School

detail.title: Learning via the Band of Brothers: Evidence of Entrepreneurial Spillover
detail.abstract: We study whether and how entrepreneurial exposure to weak social ties—peers’ entrepreneurial parents—shapes entrepreneurial entry and performance for young adults. Our empirical setting exploits entrepreneurial exposure variation across randomly assigned peer groups during compulsory military service. We find that raising the share of peers’ entrepreneurial parents by one standard deviation increases individuals’ propensity to become entrepreneurs by 20 percent. The effect is stronger in smaller groups, where interaction is easier, and among individuals who would otherwise lack entrepreneurial connections. We show that the effect is primarily driven by successful peers’ parents and comprises a significant within-industry component, suggesting a knowledge spillover channel. Consistent with this notion, peers’ successful parents also lead to better performance in post-service entrepreneurship.

AI.tldr: 研究随机分配的同伴群体中创业父母的社会关系如何影响年轻人的创业选择和表现，发现同伴创业父母比例增加一个标准差会使个人创业倾向提高20%，且这种影响在小型群体和缺乏创业关系的人群中更强，主要通过知识溢出机制实现
AI.research_question: 弱社会关系（同伴的创业父母）如何影响年轻人的创业进入和表现
AI.motivation: 探索社会网络中的弱关系对创业行为的影响，特别是通过随机分配的同伴群体来识别因果效应
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会网络理论、弱关系理论、知识溢出理论
AI.method: 利用义务兵役期间随机分配的同伴群体作为自然实验，分析同伴创业父母比例对个人创业行为的影响
AI.findings: 同伴创业父母比例增加一个标准差使个人创业倾向提高20%；效应在小型群体和缺乏创业关系的人群中更强；主要由成功的同伴父母驱动，具有显著的行业内成分；成功的同伴父母还能改善创业后的表现

detail.title: Exploring the Roles of Agriculture, Natural Resources, and Disaggregated Energy Use in Abating Ecological Footprint: Evidence from South Asia[MR1]  1
detail.abstract: South Asia is under increasing environmental stress, as individual demands on nature, measured through the ecological footprint, have surpassed the region’s ecological renewal capacity. This study, therefore, explores the impacts of agriculture, natural resource rents, and disaggregated energy uses on  ecological footprints in South Asiausing  panel data from 1990 to 2021 The estimated results from the fixed and random effect models reveal three main findings: First, agricultural activity exhibits a statistically significant negative relationship with ecological footprint, thereby contradicting the conventional hypothesis. Second, renewable energy demonstrates a positive association with ecological footprint, likely due to reliance on biomass sources such as fuelwood and crop residues, while fossil fuel consumption also contributes to ecological deterioration.. Third, natural resource rents are generally associated with increased ecological pressure; however, their interaction with agriculture yields mixed effects. Furthermore,  stronger financial systems and higher GDP per capita are associated with reduced ecological footprints. Overall, the findings suggest that environment friendly agricultural practices can be beneficial, yet the environmental impact of renewable energy depends heavily on its source (e.g., biomass versus solar/wind). To mitigate ecological harm, policy interventions should prioritize a transition from biomass and fossil fuels to cleaner renewables such as solar and wind, promote sustainable agriculture, and mobilize green finance mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 南亚生态足迹研究：农业活动与生态足迹呈负相关，可再生能源（特别是生物质能）反而增加生态压力，自然资源租金加剧环境负担，金融发展和人均GDP有助于减少生态足迹

AI.findings: 1) 农业活动与生态足迹呈显著负相关；2) 可再生能源（生物质能）与生态足迹正相关；3) 自然资源租金增加生态压力；4) 金融发展和人均GDP减少生态足迹
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统假设，揭示了农业活动可能的环境友好性，区分了不同类型可再生能源的环境影响

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Greece Economic Bulletin, Issue No. 61

detail.abstract: Global geopolitical tensions have increased considerably in recent years. This has affected the economies primarily via prices on commodities. As a result, global inflation has risen in the aftermath of geopolitical shocks. Given the higher energy and food price shares in the consumer basket, Greek inflation has also risen significantly. Historically speaking, Greece has repeatedly experienced periods of inflationary pressure. Over the past 50 years, global supply-side shocks have triggered cost-push inflation, which was often accommodated by expansionary policies. This paper analyses the historical trajectory of inflationary shocks in Greece, aiming to document inflation trends from the early 1970s to the present. In particular, it identifies the underlying forces that have driven inflation, which in turn entails an examination of both domestic demand and supply shocks, as well as global supply shocks. We find that there is a direct interplay between domestic demand and supply shocks, global supply shocks driven by geopolitical tensions and Greek headline inflation.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了希腊从1970年代至今的通胀历史轨迹，发现国内供需冲击、地缘政治紧张引发的全球供应冲击与希腊整体通胀之间存在直接相互作用关系。
AI.research_question: 希腊通胀的历史轨迹及其驱动因素是什么？国内需求冲击、供应冲击和全球供应冲击如何影响希腊的通胀？
AI.motivation: 近年来全球地缘政治紧张加剧，主要通过大宗商品价格影响各国经济，导致全球通胀上升。希腊由于能源和食品在消费篮子中占比较高，通胀显著上升。历史上希腊多次经历通胀压力时期，需要系统分析其通胀驱动机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 成本推动型通胀理论、供需冲击理论、地缘政治风险对经济影响的理论框架
AI.method: 历史轨迹分析方法，时间跨度从1970年代早期至今，考察国内需求冲击、供应冲击和全球供应冲击对通胀的影响
AI.findings: 发现国内需求冲击与供应冲击、地缘政治紧张驱动的全球供应冲击与希腊整体通胀之间存在直接相互作用关系

title: EASFP: Efficient Auto-Searched Feature Pyramid for Object Detection
affiliations: Nanjing University of Information Science and Technology, Nanjing University of Information Science and Technology, RIKEN Center for Computational Science and Tampere University

detail.title: EASFP: Efficient Auto-Searched Feature Pyramid for Object Detection
detail.abstract: Multi-scale feature pyramid networks (FPNs) play a crucial role in enabling models to capture high-level semantic information in detection tasks. However, most existing methods are manually designed and primarily focus on interactions between adjacent layers. This not only requires extensive manual hyperparameter tuning but also limits feature fusion both within layers and across scales, resulting in substantial time consumption and decreased small object detection accuracy in complex scenarios. To address these issues, we propose an efficient auto-searched feature pyramid, named EASFP. Specifically, we first introduce the explicit visual center (EVC) module to refine input features before entering the pyramid. This module comprises a lightweight multilayer perceptron (LMLP) for capturing global features and a parallel learnable visual center (LVC) mechanism for enhancing local features. Second, we construct a supernet based on the asymptotic feature pyramid network (AFPN) and integrate it into the YOLOv9 model, replacing its original neck network to facilitate optimized model search. Finally, to reduce computational costs during the search process, we adopt differentiable architecture search (DARTS) with kernel reusing as our search strategy, which shares candidate convolution weights along the same edge and merges them into a single fused convolution. Compared to existing feature pyramids, our proposed method significantly reduces manual tuning efforts while enhancing feature extraction capability, particularly improving the detection accuracy of small objects. Experimental results on PASCAL VOC and MS COCO validate the effectiveness of our approach, demonstrating strong adaptability and transferability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为EASFP的高效自动搜索特征金字塔方法，通过引入显式视觉中心模块和可微分架构搜索技术，显著减少了手动调参工作并提升了小目标检测精度。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个能够自动优化特征金字塔结构、减少人工调参、同时提升小目标检测精度的有效方法？
AI.motivation: 现有特征金字塔方法多为人工设计，主要关注相邻层间交互，需要大量手动调参且限制了层内和跨尺度特征融合，导致时间消耗大和小目标检测精度下降。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多尺度特征金字塔网络理论，结合显式视觉中心模块和渐进式特征金字塔网络架构，采用可微分架构搜索技术进行自动化结构优化。
AI.method: 1) 引入EVC模块（包含轻量级多层感知器和并行可学习视觉中心机制）；2) 基于AFPN构建超网络并集成到YOLOv9中；3) 采用带核重用的DARTS搜索策略降低计算成本。
AI.findings: 在PASCAL VOC和MS COCO数据集上的实验表明，该方法显著减少了手动调参工作，增强了特征提取能力，特别是提高了小目标检测精度，展现出强大的适应性和可迁移性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了自动搜索特征金字塔的理论框架，将显式视觉中心机制与可微分架构搜索相结合，为特征金字塔网络的自动化设计提供了新的理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了EASFP实用系统，可有效减少人工调参工作量，提升小目标检测性能，在目标检测任务中具有实际应用价值。

title: Passthrough Of Food Inflation to Nonfood Inflation in India: Evidence from Aggregate and Disaggregated Data
affiliations: Ramjas College, University of Delhi

detail.title: Passthrough Of Food Inflation to Nonfood Inflation in India: Evidence from Aggregate and Disaggregated Data
detail.abstract: The question of whether the inflation-targeting central banks should target headline inflation or core inflation has been  debated a lot. The supporters of core inflation target argue that the food prices are highly volatile and are not affected by monetary policy; and therefore  should be excluded from the target inflation rate. The supporters of headline inflation target, on the other hand, highlight the second round effects of food prices on nonfood prices  through inflationary expectations and wages. In the light of this an attempt has  been made in this paper to investigate the passthrough of food prices inflation to nonfood prices in India. In addition to aggregate nonfood, core and headline inflation, we also study passthrough to the individual groups/subgroups in core inflation, in order to identify the groups through which the effect comes about, if at all. Using impulse responses estimated from vector autoregressive models and local projections, we find that a 1 % shock to food price inflation leads to roughly 0.2 % change in non-food, core and general inflation. Among the components, it is contributed by the Clothing and Footwear; Transport and Communication; Prepared meals and snacks; and Education. The  small magnitude of passthrough indicates that exclusive focus on headline inflation in monetary  policy may not be a good idea.

AI.tldr: 本文通过VAR模型和局部投影法研究印度食品价格通胀对非食品价格的传导效应，发现1%的食品通胀冲击仅导致约0.2%的非食品、核心和总体通胀变化，表明货币政策不应过度关注整体通胀。
AI.research_question: 印度食品价格通胀对非食品价格的传导效应如何？
AI.motivation: 关于通胀目标制央行应该以整体通胀还是核心通胀为目标的争论，需要实证证据来支持政策选择。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于通胀预期和工资传导机制的理论框架，探讨食品价格冲击对非食品价格的第二轮效应。
AI.method: 使用向量自回归(VAR)模型和局部投影法估计脉冲响应函数。
AI.findings: 1%的食品价格通胀冲击导致约0.2%的非食品、核心和总体通胀变化；主要传导渠道包括服装鞋类、交通通信、预制餐食和教育等细分领域。
AI.theory_contributions: 为食品价格传导机制提供了实证证据，支持核心通胀目标的理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度央行货币政策制定提供参考，建议不应过度关注波动性较大的整体通胀指标。

title: Kinky Europe: Evidence from the Regional Phillips Curve in the Euro Area
affiliations: Swiss National Bank and Swiss National Bank

detail.title: Kinky Europe: Evidence from the Regional Phillips Curve in the Euro Area

publicationDetails.detailsText: Swiss National Bank Working Paper No. 2025-12
publicationDetails.journalName: Swiss National Bank Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We estimate the slope of the Phillips curve in the euro area, allowing for nonlinearities - or kinks - in the relationship between labor market slack and inflation. We exploit cross-country variation in labor market conditions in the period 2001-2024, absorbing aggregate shocks and endogenous monetary policy reactions with time fixed effects. We find that while the Phillips curve is usually quite flat, it becomes at least three times as steep if the labor market is sufficiently tight. This kink is more pronounced in the euro area than in the United States, potentially because of more rigid labor markets. Our estimates imply, however, that despite this nonlinearity, the majority of the post-Covid inflation surge was due to factors other than tight labor markets.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析欧元区2001-2024年劳动力市场数据，发现菲利普斯曲线存在非线性特征：在劳动力市场紧张时，曲线斜率至少增加三倍，但新冠后通胀飙升主要归因于非劳动力市场因素。
AI.research_question: 欧元区菲利普斯曲线的斜率是否存在非线性特征？劳动力市场紧张程度如何影响通胀与失业率的关系？
AI.motivation: 理解欧元区通胀动态对于货币政策制定至关重要，特别是需要探究劳动力市场条件与通胀之间的非线性关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非线性菲利普斯曲线理论，允许劳动力市场松弛与通胀关系存在拐点（kinks）
AI.method: 利用2001-2024年欧元区跨国劳动力市场数据，通过时间固定效应控制总体冲击和内生货币政策反应
AI.findings: 1. 菲利普斯曲线通常较为平坦；2. 劳动力市场足够紧张时曲线斜率至少增加三倍；3. 欧元区的这种非线性特征比美国更明显，可能源于更刚性的劳动力市场；4. 新冠后通胀飙升主要来自非劳动力市场因素
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在欧元区实证验证了菲利普斯曲线的非线性特征，为理解通胀动态提供了新的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧洲央行货币政策制定提供重要参考，表明在劳动力市场紧张时需要更关注通胀风险，但同时也显示其他因素（如供给冲击）对通胀的重要影响

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI), broadly defined by John McCarthy in the mid-1950s as the "science and engineering of making intelligent machines" (Boalanin, 2019), has transcended its theoretical origins to become a profound transformative force across diverse sectors. Driven by the exponential growth of big data, remarkable advancements in high-powered computing, and the sophisticated development of deep learning systems, contemporary AI encompasses advanced capabilities such as natural language processing, intricate pattern recognition, and adaptive learning mechanisms (Miller, 2019; Sweijs et al., 2017). This rapid evolution holds significant implications for human resource (HR) management, presenting a duality of substantial opportunities for enhanced efficiency and strategic realignment, alongside considerable challenges pertaining to ethical considerations, the dynamics of human interaction, and the complexities of practical implementation. This assignment aims to critically analyze the evolving role of AI in HR, encompassing its impact on administrative automation, its multifaceted advantages and disadvantages, and the crucial considerations surrounding employee privacy and data security. A comprehensive review of existing literature will support the empirical discussions and provide a critical analysis of current scholarly perspectives.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性分析了人工智能在人力资源管理中的双重作用：既带来效率提升和战略重塑的机遇，也面临伦理、人机互动和实施复杂性的挑战。
AI.research_question: 人工智能在人力资源管理中的角色演变及其影响是什么？包括对行政自动化的影响、多方面的优缺点以及员工隐私和数据安全的关键考量。
AI.motivation: 人工智能已从理论发展为跨领域的变革力量，由大数据增长、高性能计算和深度学习系统推动，对人力资源管理产生重大影响，需要全面分析其机遇与挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人工智能理论（McCarthy定义）和人力资源管理理论，结合自然语言处理、模式识别和自适应学习等AI能力框架。
AI.method: 文献综述法，对现有文献进行全面回顾，支持实证讨论并提供对当前学术观点的批判性分析。
AI.findings: AI在HR中呈现双重性：一方面带来行政自动化效率提升和战略重新调整的机会，另一方面面临伦理考量、人机互动动态和实践实施复杂性的挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了AI在HR管理中的综合分析框架，明确了机遇与挑战的双重维度，为后续理论研究提供基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为HR从业者提供实施AI的实践指导，强调需要平衡效率提升与伦理隐私保护，为企业数字化转型提供参考。

title: A Wormhole Induction Model Based on Spiral Magnetic Tensor Coupling
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: A Wormhole Induction Model Based on Spiral Magnetic Tensor Coupling

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this theoretical study.

detail.abstract: This paper proposes a novel hypothesis for wormhole induction based on a spacetime fluid analogy and spiral magnetic perturbation. The model treats spacetime as a deformable medium, and introduces controlled spiral magnetic fields to locally distort spacetime geometry. By modifying the Einstein field equations with magnetic tensor terms, we examine whether wormhole-like throat conditions can be satisfied without exotic matter. Through metric modeling, energy tensor construction, and numerical simulations, the paper validates the feasibility of shape function compliance and analyzes thermal and dynamic consistency.

AI.tldr: 基于时空流体类比和螺旋磁扰动提出新型虫洞诱导假说，通过将时空视为可变形介质并引入螺旋磁场来局部扭曲时空几何，探索无需奇异物质实现虫洞条件的可能性。
AI.research_question: 能否通过螺旋磁场扰动在无需奇异物质的情况下诱导形成虫洞结构？
AI.motivation: 传统虫洞理论需要奇异物质维持，这在物理上难以实现。通过磁场扰动时空几何可能提供一种更可行的虫洞形成机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 爱因斯坦场方程修正（加入磁张量项）、时空流体类比理论、可变形介质几何理论
AI.method: 度规建模、能量张量构建、数值模拟分析
AI.findings: 验证了形状函数符合虫洞条件，分析了热力学和动力学一致性，证明该方法的可行性
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于磁场扰动的虫洞形成新机制，扩展了爱因斯坦场方程的应用范围

title: How Dwight D. Eisenhower's Childhood Trauma and Religious Experiences Influenced His Formation and Performance as President
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) and Grove City College

detail.title: How Dwight D. Eisenhower's Childhood Trauma and Religious Experiences Influenced His Formation and Performance as President
detail.abstract: This article examines how childhood trauma and various religious experiences influenced the intellectual and spiritual formation of Dwight D. Eisenhower. Although the lives of presidents are well documented, insufficient attention has been paid to the role played by religious mentors who assisted future presidents during the periods of trauma they endured as youth. Eisenhower's religious convictions significantly affected how he dealt with the loss of his younger brother Paul at age five, his almost dying from blood poisoning at fourteen, his mother Ida's efforts to curb his violent temper, his attempt to protect his sibling from being beaten by his father, his willingness to cook for the family during his sibling's scarlet fever, and his conflict with his mother's pacifism while he attended West Point. This article is based on autobiographies, biographies, interviews, and resources from the Dwight Eisenhower Presidential Library and Museum. Eisenhower's religious upbringing gave him a strong moral foundation. His mother's influence remained strong throughout his life.
